A baker borrowed funds from an investor to purchase a plot of land on which the baker planned to build a new bakery. In order to secure repayment of the loan, the baker signed a nonnegotiable promissory note and executed a mortgage to the investor.
Five years later, the investor sold her promissory note to a credit union by endorsing the note and promptly delivering it to the credit union. Due to a downturn in business, the baker was unable to make payments on the mortgage. The credit union now seeks to foreclose on the baker's plot of land.
If the court denies the credit union's foreclosure, what is the most likely reason?

questions.question:
A woman acquired title to a four-acre lot. Several years later, she executed a mortgage on the lot to a bank to secure repayment of a $100,000 loan. Subsequently, the woman executed a mortgage on the same four-acre lot to a finance company to secure repayment of a $50,000 loan. Both mortgages were promptly recorded.
The woman recently defaulted on both loans. The bank promptly initiated foreclosure proceedings and sent proper notice to all necessary parties. The current fair market value of the four-acre lot is $250,000.
The finance company has filed a timely motion in the foreclosure proceeding asking the court to require the bank to first foreclose on two of the four acres in the four-acre lot. The bank opposes this motion and insists that it has the right to subject the entire four-acre lot to the foreclosure sale.
Will the court grant the finance company's motion?

choices.a: No, because the bank holds a purchase-money mortgage.
choices.b: No, because the entire four-acre lot is subject to the bank's senior mortgage.
choices.c: Yes, because a pro rata foreclosure of the lot will not prejudice the rights of the bank.
choices.d: Yes, because of the "two funds" rule of marshalling.

Q86020

A woman acquired title to a four-acre lot. Several years later, she executed a mortgage on the lot to a bank to secure repayment of a $100,000 loan. Subsequently, the woman executed a mortgage on the same four-acre lot to a finance company to secure repayment of a $50,000 loan. Both mortgages were promptly recorded.

The woman recently defaulted on both loans. The bank promptly initiated foreclosure proceedings and sent proper notice to all necessary parties. The current fair market value of the four-acre lot is $250,000.

The finance company has filed a timely motion in the foreclosure proceeding asking the court to require the bank to first foreclose on two of the four acres in the four-acre lot. The bank opposes this motion and insists that it has the right to subject the entire four-acre lot to the foreclosure sale.

Will the court grant the finance company's motion?

一名女子获得了一块四英亩土地的所有权。几年后，她以该地块为抵押向一家银行贷款10万美元，并办理了抵押登记。随后，该女子又以同一块四英亩的土地为抵押，向一家金融公司贷款5万美元，并办理了抵押登记。两项抵押都及时进行了登记。

该女子近期对两笔贷款都违约了。银行迅速启动了止赎程序，并向所有必要方发出了适当的通知。这块四英亩土地目前的公平市价为25万美元。

金融公司在止赎程序中及时提出动议，请求法院要求银行首先对这四英亩土地中的两英亩进行止赎。银行反对该动议，并坚持其有权将整块四英亩土地进行止赎拍卖。

法院会批准金融公司的动议吗？
options:
A. No, because the bank holds a purchase-money mortgage.
不会，因为银行持有的是购房抵押贷款（purchase-money mortgage）。

B. No, because the entire four-acre lot is subject to the bank's senior mortgage.
不会，因为整块四英亩土地都受银行的优先抵押权约束。

C. Yes, because a pro rata foreclosure of the lot will not prejudice the rights of the bank.
会，因为按比例对该地块进行止赎不会损害银行的权利。

D. Yes, because of the "two funds" rule of marshalling.
会，因为适用“双重基金”聚合规则（marshalling a/k/a "two funds" rule）。
data.explanation:
The priority of mortgages and other liens in the foreclosure process is generally determined by their recording dates. However, a different rule applies to purchase-money mortgages (PMMs) - ie, mortgages granted to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property. PMMs have super-priority over all other mortgages or liens, whether or not recorded.

Here, both the bank and the finance company have mortgages on the entire four-acre lot. The woman already owned the lot when she executed the mortgages, so neither mortgage is a PMM (Choice A). Therefore, the order of recording determines priority. And since the bank received its mortgage first and promptly recorded it, the bank has the senior mortgage and is entitled to foreclose on the entire four-acre lot.

(Choice C) Mortgagees are entitled to foreclose on the entire property subject to the mortgage unless otherwise provided by law. Therefore, the bank has no obligation to foreclose on a smaller two-acre parcel. Additionally, such a pro rata foreclosure could prejudice the bank's rights since there is no guarantee that two acres would sell for an amount sufficient to satisfy the bank's interest.

(Choice D) The "two funds" rule of marshalling applies when a senior creditor has two funds available to satisfy a debt (eg, a mortgage on multiple properties), and a junior creditor also has an interest in one of those funds. It requires the senior creditor to first look for satisfaction from the fund that is not shared so as to preserve the junior creditor's interest in the shared fund. But here, both mortgages are secured by a single fund - the four-acre lot.

Educational objective: Priority of mortgages and other liens is generally based on the order in which they were recorded. Purchase-money mortgages, however, have super-priority over all other mortgages or liens, whether or not recorded.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 82%（正确选项），C选项 6%，D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在止赎程序中，抵押权和其他留置权的优先顺序通常由其登记日期决定。然而，购房抵押贷款（PMMs, purchase-money mortgages）适用不同的规则——即为担保抵押财产的购买价款而设定的抵押。PMMs 拥有绝对优先权，优于所有其他已登记或未登记的抵押权或留置权。

在本案中，银行和金融公司都对整块四英亩土地拥有抵押权。该女子在设立这两项抵押时已经拥有该地块，因此两项抵押都不是PMM（选项A）。因此，登记的顺序决定了优先权。并且，由于银行首先获得其抵押权并及时进行了登记，银行拥有优先抵押权，并有权对整块四英亩土地进行止赎。

（选项C）除非法律另有规定，抵押权人有权对抵押物下的全部财产进行止赎。因此，银行没有义务只对较小的两英亩地块进行止赎。此外，这种按比例的止赎可能会损害银行的权利，因为无法保证两英亩土地的售价足以清偿银行的债权。

（选项D）“双重基金”聚合规则（marshalling a/k/a "two funds" rule）适用于以下情况：当一个优先债权人有两个基金可用于清偿债务时（例如，对多个财产拥有抵押权），而一个次级债权人也对其中一个基金拥有权益。该规则要求优先债权人首先从非共享的基金中寻求清偿，以保护次级债权人在共享基金中的权益。但在本案中，两项抵押都是由单一基金——即这块四英亩的土地——作担保的。

教学目的：抵押权和其他留置权的优先顺序通常基于它们的登记顺序。然而，购房抵押贷款（Purchase-money mortgages）无论是否登记，都拥有优于所有其他抵押权或留置权的绝对优先权。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (priority of purchase-money mortgages).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
正确答案：B

法院不会批准该动议，因为整块四英亩土地都受银行的优先抵押权（Senior Mortgage）约束。

核心考点：资产聚合规则 (Marshalling of Assets)

本题最大的干扰项是关于 Marshalling（资产聚合/双重基金规则）。

规则定义：当优先债权人（Senior Creditor）拥有两个或以上的资金来源（Funds/Properties）来清偿债务，而次级债权人（Junior Creditor）只能依靠其中一个时，公平原则（Equity）要求优先债权人先执行次级债权人无法触及的那个资产。

适用情况
Senior: 拥有资产 A + B
Junior: 仅拥有资产 A
⬇️
Senior 必须先卖 B
本题情况
Senior: 拥有资产 X
Junior: 拥有资产 X
⬇️
规则不适用

关键点：本案中，虽然土地有4英亩，但在法律上它被视为单一基金（Single Fund）。两家银行的抵押权都覆盖整个地块。因此，不存在“两个基金”供优先债权人选择。

选项深度解析

选项 A 错误 Purchase-Money Mortgage (PMM)

理由：PMM 是指用于担保“购买该房产资金”的贷款。本题中，女子已经拥有土地多年后才进行抵押贷款。因此，这不是 PMM，不享有 PMM 的超级优先权。

选项 D 陷阱 "Two Funds" Rule

理由：这是本题设计的陷阱。虽然金融公司试图主张将土地“分割”看待，但法律上抵押物是整体的。除非有明确的分割条款，否则优先抵押权人（Bank）有权拍卖整个抵押物来受偿，无需为了照顾次级债权人而承担分割拍卖可能带来的风险（如售价降低）。

选项 C 错误 Pro Rata Foreclosure

理由：法院通常不会强迫优先债权人进行部分止赎（Partial Foreclosure），因为这会改变合同条款并可能损害其利益。优先债权人有权处置全部抵押物。

💡 MBE 考试技巧：
看到次级债权人要求优先债权人“先卖别的”或“只卖一部分”，立刻联想 Marshalling 规则。

但必须检查前提：是否有两个独立的资产（Two Funds）？ 如果只是同一个资产的不同部分，该规则通常不适用。

questions.question:
An investor purchased a tract of commercial land, financing a large part of the purchase price with a loan from a business partner that was secured by a mortgage. The investor made the installment payments on the mortgage regularly for several years. Then the investor persuaded a neighbor to buy the land, subject to the mortgage to his partner. They expressly agreed that the neighbor would not assume and agree to pay the investor's debt to the partner. The investor's mortgage to the partner contained a due-on-sale clause stating, "If Mortgagor transfers his or her interest without the written consent of Mortgagee first obtained, then at Mortgagee's option the entire principal balance of the debt secured by this Mortgage shall become immediately due and payable." However, without seeking his partner's consent, the investor conveyed the land to the neighbor, the deed stating that it was "subject to a mortgage to [the partner]" and giving details and recording data related to the mortgage. The neighbor took possession of the land and made several mortgage payments, which the partner accepted. Now, however, neither the neighbor nor the investor has made the last three mortgage payments. The partner has sued the neighbor for the amount of the delinquent payments.
In this action, for whom should the court render judgment?

choices.a: The neighbor, because she did not assume and agree to pay the investor's mortgage debt.
choices.b: The neighbor, because she is not in privity of estate with the partner.
choices.c: The partner, because the investor's deed to the neighbor violated the due-on-sale clause.
choices.d: The partner, because the neighbor is in privity of estate with the partner.

Q86021

An investor purchased a tract of commercial land, financing a large part of the purchase price with a loan from a business partner that was secured by a mortgage. The investor made the installment payments on the mortgage regularly for several years. Then the investor persuaded a neighbor to buy the land, subject to the mortgage to his partner. They expressly agreed that the neighbor would not assume and agree to pay the investor's debt to the partner. The investor's mortgage to the partner contained a due-on-sale clause stating, "If Mortgagor transfers his or her interest without the written consent of Mortgagee first obtained, then at Mortgagee's option the entire principal balance of the debt secured by this Mortgage shall become immediately due and payable." However, without seeking his partner's consent, the investor conveyed the land to the neighbor, the deed stating that it was "subject to a mortgage to [the partner]" and giving details and recording data related to the mortgage. The neighbor took possession of the land and made several mortgage payments, which the partner accepted. Now, however, neither the neighbor nor the investor has made the last three mortgage payments. The partner has sued the neighbor for the amount of the delinquent payments.

In this action, for whom should the court render judgment?

一位投资者购买了一块商业用地，其大部分购买价款来自一位商业伙伴的贷款，该贷款由一笔抵押担保。在数年间，该投资者定期支付抵押贷款的分期付款。之后，该投资者说服一位邻居购买此土地，但土地附有对其伙伴的抵押。他们明确约定，邻居不承担并同意支付投资者对其伙伴的债务。投资者对其伙伴的抵押合同中包含一项“售出即付条款”（due-on-sale clause），规定：“若抵押人未经抵押权人书面同意即转让其权益，则抵押权人可选择要求此抵押担保的全部债务本金余额立即到期并应付。”然而，在未征求其伙伴同意的情况下，投资者将土地转让给了邻居，地契中声明该土地“附有对[伙伴]的抵押”，并提供了与该抵押相关的详细信息和登记数据。邻居占有了该土地，并支付了几笔抵押贷款，其伙伴也接受了这些付款。但现在，邻居和投资者都未支付最近三期的抵押贷款。该伙伴已起诉邻居，要求其支付拖欠的款项。

在此诉讼中，法院应为谁作出判决？
options:
A. The neighbor, because she did not assume and agree to pay the investor's mortgage debt.
邻居，因为她没有承担并同意支付投资者的抵押债务。

B. The neighbor, because she is not in privity of estate with the partner.
邻居，因为她与该伙伴没有地产权的关联（privity of estate）。

C. The partner, because the investor's deed to the neighbor violated the due-on-sale clause.
伙伴，因为投资者转让给邻居的地契违反了售出即付条款（due-on-sale clause）。

D. The partner, because the neighbor is in privity of estate with the partner.
伙伴，因为邻居与该伙伴有地产权的关联（privity of estate）。
data.explanation:
Transfer of mortgaged property


Effect on buyerEffecton seller
Subject to mortgageDoes not agree to pay loan & is not liable for debtRemains solely liable for debt
Assumption of mortgageAgrees to pay loan & is primarily liable for debtBecomes secondarily liable as a surety
A mortgagor (typically a landowner) is generally free to transfer mortgaged property to another (eg, a buyer). However, the mortgage will remain attached to the property and the mortgagor will remain solely liable for the debt unless the buyer expressly agrees to assume the mortgage. If that occurs, the buyer becomes primarily liable for the debt and the mortgagor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.

Here, the investor's mortgage to the partner contained a due-on-sale clause that was breached when the investor sold the mortgaged land to the neighbor without the partner's consent. But since the neighbor did not agree to assume the investor's mortgage, the neighbor is not liable for the investor's delinquent mortgage payments (Choice C). Therefore, in the partner's action against the neighbor, the court should render judgment for the neighbor.

(Choices B & D) Privity of estate is a shared interest in property (eg, co-tenants or landlord/tenant). Here, the partner and the neighbor lack privity of estate because the neighbor's ownership interest is distinct from the partner's lien on the property. But the existence or lack of such privity has no bearing on the success of the partner's action.

Educational objective: If a mortgagor transfers mortgaged property to another, the mortgage will remain attached to the property and the mortgagor will remain solely liable for the debt unless the buyer expressly agrees to assume the mortgage.

选项正确率统计：A选项 67%（正确选项），B选项 5%，C选项 9%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押财产的转让


对买方的效力对卖方的效力
附有抵押（Subject to mortgage）不同意偿还贷款且不对债务负责仍为债务的唯一责任人
承担抵押（Assumption of mortgage）同意偿还贷款并对债务负主要责任成为次要责任人，作为保证人
抵押人（mortgagor，通常是土地所有者）通常可以自由地将抵押财产转让给他人（例如，买方）。但是，抵押将继续附着于该财产上，并且抵押人将仍然是债务的唯一责任人，除非买方明确同意承担该抵押。如果发生这种情况，买方将成为债务的主要责任人，而抵押人则作为保证人成为次要责任人。

在本案中，投资者对其伙伴的抵押包含一个售出即付条款（due-on-sale clause），当投资者未经伙伴同意将抵押土地出售给邻居时，该条款即被违反。但由于邻居没有同意承担投资者的抵押，因此邻居对投资者拖欠的抵押付款不承担责任（选项C）。因此，在伙伴对邻居的诉讼中，法院应作出对邻居有利的判决。

（选项B和D）地产权关联（Privity of estate）是指对财产的共同权益（例如，共有人或房东/租客）。在本案中，伙伴和邻居之间缺乏地产权关联，因为邻居的所有权权益与伙伴在该财产上的留置权（lien）是截然不同的。但是，这种关联的存在与否对伙伴诉讼的成败没有影响。

教学目的：如果抵押人将抵押财产转让给他人，抵押将继续附着于该财产，且抵押人仍为债务的唯一责任人，除非买方明确同意承担该抵押。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assumption of a mortgage).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析
抵押财产转让与个人责任

正确答案：A 法院应判决邻居胜诉，因为她仅仅是受让了附带抵押的土地（Subject to），并没有签署协议承担个人还款责任。
核心考点：Subject to vs. Assumption

在不动产法中，当买方购买已抵押的房产时，有两种主要方式，其法律后果截然不同：

类型 买方个人责任
(Personal Liability)		 原卖方责任
Subject to the Mortgage
(附带抵押转让)		 无责任
债权人不能起诉买方个人资产。		 主要责任人
仍需偿还债务。
Assume the Mortgage
(承担抵押债务)		 有责任
债权人可直接起诉买方。		 次要责任人
(作为保证人 Surety)

* 注：无论哪种情况，如果债务违约，银行都可以没收（Foreclose）土地，因为抵押权附着于土地之上。

案情逻辑推演

1. 关键事实认定：
题目明确指出：投资者（卖方）与邻居（买方）明确约定邻居不承担（would not assume）债务。地契中也仅声明土地是 "Subject to a mortgage"（附带抵押）。

2. 法律后果：
由于是 "Subject to" 交易，邻居虽然拥有土地所有权，且土地本身仍是债务的担保物，但邻居本人并没有与债权人（伙伴）建立合同债务关系。

3. 诉讼请求分析：
伙伴起诉的是“拖欠的款项” (amount of the delinquent payments)，即要求邻居承担个人金钱赔偿责任（Personal Judgment），而不是要求法拍土地（Foreclosure）。由于邻居没有承担债务，伙伴不能向邻居追讨金钱。

为什么其他选项是错误的？
关于选项 C (Due-on-sale clause)：
⚠️ 常见陷阱： “售出即付条款” (Due-on-sale clause) 赋予了抵押权人（伙伴）在未经同意转让时加速债务到期并取消抵押赎回权（Foreclose）的权利。

但是，违反该条款不会自动让买方承担个人债务责任。它只是给了债权人收回房子的理由，而不是起诉买方要钱的理由。
关于选项 B 和 D (Privity of Estate)：

地产权关联（Privity of Estate）通常用于分析房东与租客或契约（Covenants）随土地转移的问题。在抵押贷款的个人责任问题上，关键在于合同关系（Privity of Contract）。邻居没有签署借据（Note），也没有签署承担债务协议，因此没有合同关联。

MBE 快速解题技巧

看到抵押房产转让题目时，第一步先找关键词：

  • 如果是 "Subject to" ➡️ 买方无个人责任（银行只能拿房子，不能拿买方的钱）。
  • 如果是 "Assumes" ➡️ 买方有个人责任。

本题中，既然买方没有 assume，债权人就不能对其提起个人诉讼（Action on the debt/deficiency judgment）。

questions.question:
A credit card company obtained and properly filed a judgment against a man after he failed to pay a $10,000 debt. A statute in the jurisdiction provides as follows: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for 10 years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."
Two years later, the man purchased land for $200,000. He made a down payment of $20,000 and borrowed the remaining $180,000 from a bank. The bank loan was secured by a mortgage on the land. Immediately after the closing, the deed to the man was recorded first, and the bank's mortgage was recorded second.
Five months later, the man defaulted on the mortgage loan and the bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings. After receiving notice of the proceedings, the credit card company filed a motion to have its judgment lien declared to be the first lien on the land.
Is the credit card company's motion likely to be granted?

choices.a: No, because the bank's mortgage secured a loan used to purchase the land.
choices.b: No, because the man's down payment exceeded the amount of his debt to the credit card company.
choices.c: Yes, because the bank had constructive notice of the judgment lien.
choices.d: Yes, because the bank is a third-party lender and not the seller of the land.

Q86030

A credit card company obtained and properly filed a judgment against a man after he failed to pay a $10,000 debt. A statute in the jurisdiction provides as follows: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for 10 years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered."

Two years later, the man purchased land for $200,000. He made a down payment of $20,000 and borrowed the remaining $180,000 from a bank. The bank loan was secured by a mortgage on the land. Immediately after the closing, the deed to the man was recorded first, and the bank's mortgage was recorded second.

Five months later, the man defaulted on the mortgage loan and the bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings. After receiving notice of the proceedings, the credit card company filed a motion to have its judgment lien declared to be the first lien on the land.

Is the credit card company's motion likely to be granted?

一家信用卡公司在一名男子未能偿还10,000美元的债务后，获得了对该男子的判决并进行了适当的登记。该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何经过适当登记的判决，自登记之日起10年内，均构成对该判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或此后获得的房地产的留置权。”

两年后，该男子以200,000美元的价格购买了一块土地。他支付了20,000美元的首付款，并从一家银行借了余下的180,000美元。该银行贷款由该土地的抵押权作担保。交易结束后，该男子的地契首先被登记，银行的抵押权其次登记。

五个月后，该男子拖欠抵押贷款，银行启动了司法止赎程序。在收到程序通知后，信用卡公司提出动议，要求宣布其判决留置权为该土地上的第一顺位留置权。

信用卡公司的动议有可能被批准吗？
options:
A. No, because the bank's mortgage secured a loan used to purchase the land.
否，因为银行的抵押权担保的是用于购买该土地的贷款。

B. No, because the man's down payment exceeded the amount of his debt to the credit card company.
否，因为该男子的首付款超过了他欠信用卡公司的债务金额。

C. Yes, because the bank had constructive notice of the judgment lien.
是，因为银行对该判决留置权有推定通知。

D. Yes, because the bank is a third-party lender and not the seller of the land.
是，因为银行是第三方贷款人，而不是该土地的卖方。
data.explanation:
In foreclosure proceedings, lien priority is generally determined by the date a lien is recorded (ie, first in time, first in right). But purchase-money mortgages (PMMs) are an exception to this rule. These mortgages have super priority over all other liens - regardless of whether the PMM or those liens are recorded - because PMMs are granted to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property.

Here, the credit card company acquired a judgment lien to secure repayment of the man's $10,000 debt. Two years later, the bank acquired a PMM because it received a mortgage to secure the $180,000 loan used to purchase the land. Since that PMM has super priority over all other liens - including a judgment lien that was first in time - the court will likely deny the credit card company's motion to have its lien declared first on the land.

(Choice B) Whether the man could have paid off the judgment lien with the money that he used for the down payment is irrelevant to the bank's priority over the lien.

(Choice C) The bank likely had constructive (ie, record or inquiry) notice of the credit card company's judgment lien because that lien was properly filed. But this has no effect on the super priority of the bank's PMM.

(Choice D) PMMs can be given to third-party lenders (ie, third-party PMMs) and sellers of the land (ie, vendor PMMs). But any PMM executed at the same time as the purchase of the mortgaged real property has priority over any other claim, including the credit card company's previously filed judgment lien.

Educational objective: A purchase-money mortgage (PMM) has super priority over all other liens because it is granted to secure the purchase price of mortgaged property. As a result, PMMs trump the "first in time, first in right" rule that sets priority based on the date a lien is recorded.



选项正确率统计：A选项 74%（正确选项），B选项 0%，C选项 23%，D选项 1%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

在止赎程序中，留置权的优先顺序通常由留置权的登记日期决定（即，时间在先，权利在先）。但购买价款抵押权 (purchase-money mortgages, PMMs) 是此规则的一个例外。这些抵押权拥有相对于所有其他留置权的超级优先权——无论PMM或其他留置权是否已登记——因为授予PMM是为了担保被抵押财产的购买价款。

在本案中，信用卡公司获得了一项判决留置权，以确保该男子偿还10,000美元的债务。两年后，银行获得了PMM，因为它收到了一份抵押合同以担保用于购买土地的180,000美元贷款。由于该PMM对所有其他留置权——包括时间在先的判决留置权——拥有超级优先权，法院很可能会驳回信用卡公司要求宣布其留置权为土地第一顺位留置权的动议。

(选项 B) 该男子是否本可以用他支付首付的钱来偿还判决留置权，这与银行相对于该留置权的优先权无关。

(选项 C) 银行很可能对信用卡公司的判决留置权有推定通知（即，登记或查询通知），因为该留置权已进行适当登记。但这并不影响银行PMM的超级优先权。

(选项 D) PMMs可以授予第三方贷款人（即第三方PMMs）和土地卖方（即卖方PMMs）。但任何在购买被抵押房地产的同时设立的PMM，其优先权都高于任何其他权利主张，包括信用卡公司先前登记的判决留置权。

教学目的：购买价款抵押权 (A purchase-money mortgage, PMM) 对所有其他留置权拥有超级优先权，因为它的授予是为了担保被抵押财产的购买价款。因此，PMMs推翻了根据留置权登记日期确定优先顺序的“时间在先，权利在先”规则。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (purchase-money mortgages).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property & Mortgages

Topic: Priority of Liens (留置权优先顺位)
核心考点：购买价款抵押权 (PMM)

Purchase Money Mortgage (PMM) 指的是借款人为了购买该不动产而获得的贷款，并以该不动产作为抵押。

法律规则：PMM 享有超级优先权 (Super Priority)。它优先于该财产购买者之前设立的所有其他留置权（例如先前登记的判决留置权），即使其他留置权在时间上更早。

案情法律分析

本题考察的是典型的“判决留置权 vs. 购买价款抵押权”的优先顺位问题。

  1. 判决留置权 (Judgment Lien)：信用卡公司在两年前登记了判决。根据法规，这构成了对该男子“当时拥有或此后获得” (after-acquired) 的不动产的留置权。
  2. 购买价款抵押权 (PMM)：两年后，银行借钱给该男子用于购买土地，并设定了抵押。这就是典型的 PMM。
  3. 冲突解决：虽然信用卡公司的留置权在时间上更早（First in Time），但银行持有的是 PMM。法律为了鼓励贷款人提供资金帮助人们购买房产，赋予 PMM 优先于先前针对借款人的“一揽子”留置权的地位。

结论：银行的 PMM 优先于信用卡公司的判决留置权。

选项解析
✅ 选项 A 正确
"No, because the bank's mortgage secured a loan used to purchase the land."
这是对 PMM 超级优先权规则的直接应用。因为银行的抵押权担保的是用于购买该土地的资金，所以它自动获得了优先于先前判决留置权的地位。
❌ 选项 C 错误 (常见陷阱)
虽然银行确实对判决留置权有推定通知 (Constructive Notice)，但这在 PMM 的情境下不影响优先权。通常情况下，“通知”会破坏后续购买者的优先权，但 PMM 是一个特例。无论银行是否知道之前的判决，只要它是 PMM，它就优先。
❌ 选项 D 错误
虽然银行是第三方贷款人，但这并不是它获得优先权的原因。如果是卖方提供融资（Vendor PMM），卖方也会获得优先权。关键在于贷款的用途（用于购买土地），而不是贷款人的身份。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 房地产法题目中，看到“After-acquired property” (此后获得的财产) 条款和后来的购房贷款同时出现时，立刻联想 PMM Super Priority。

记住口诀：PMM 插队排第一。它能打败比它早登记的判决留置权。

A man borrowed $500,000 from a bank, securing the loan with a mortgage on a commercial building he owned.
The mortgage provided as follows: "No prepayment may be made on this loan during the first two years after the date of this mortgage. Thereafter, prepayment may be made in any amount at any time but only if accompanied by a prepayment fee of 5% of the amount prepaid."
One year later, the man received an unexpected cash gift of $1 million and wished to pay off the $495,000 principal balance still owed on the loan. Concerned that the bank might refuse prepayment—despite a rise in market interest rates in the year since the loan was made—or at least insist on the 5% prepayment fee, the man consulted an attorney concerning the enforceability of the above-quoted clause.
There is no applicable statute.
What is the attorney likely to say?

choices.a: The entire clause is unenforceable, because it violates a public policy favoring the prompt and early repayment of debt.
choices.b: The entire clause is unenforceable, because the rise in interest rates will allow the bank to reloan the funds without loss.
choices.c: The two-year prepayment prohibition and the prepayment fee provision are both valid and enforceable.
choices.d: The two-year prepayment prohibition is unenforceable, but the prepayment fee provision is enforceable.

What is the attorney likely to say? 一名男子从银行借款50万美元，并以其拥有的一栋商业建筑作为该贷款的抵押。

抵押合同规定如下：“自本抵押设立之日起的头两年内，不得对该贷款进行任何提前还款。此后，可在任何时间进行任何金额的提前还款，但必须同时支付所还款项5%的提前还款费。”

一年后，该男子意外收到一笔100万美元的现金赠与，希望偿还贷款中仍欠的49.5万美元本金余额。该男子担心银行可能会拒绝其提前还款——尽管自贷款发放以来的一年里市场利率有所上升——或者至少会坚持收取5%的提前还款费，因此就上述条款的可执行性咨询了一位律师。

没有适用的成文法。

律师可能会怎么说？
options:
A. The entire clause is unenforceable, because it violates a public policy favoring the prompt and early repayment of debt.
整个条款不可执行，因为它违反了鼓励及时和提前偿还债务的公共政策。

B. The entire clause is unenforceable, because the rise in interest rates will allow the bank to reloan the funds without loss.
整个条款不可执行，因为利率的上升将使银行能够在没有损失的情况下重新贷出这笔资金。

C. The two-year prepayment prohibition and the prepayment fee provision are both valid and enforceable.
两年内禁止提前还款的规定和提前还款费的条款均有效且可执行。

D. The two-year prepayment prohibition is unenforceable, but the prepayment fee provision is enforceable.

data.explanation:
Right to prepay mortgage


Common lawPrepayment barred unless mortgage documents provide otherwise
Majority rulePrepayment allowed unless mortgage documents provide otherwise
Under the common law "perfect tender in time" rule, a mortgagor (debtor) has no right to prepay a mortgage debt unless the mortgage documents provide otherwise. However, the prevailing modern trend reverses this presumption and allows prepayment unless the mortgage documents provide otherwise.

Prepayment prohibitions or penalties contained in a mortgage are generally valid and enforceable.† They do not violate public policy because they serve the beneficial purpose of:

allowing the mortgagee to maintain the financial yield intended under the mortgage agreement and

compensating the mortgagee for any losses suffered because of a prepayment (Choice A).

As a result, the two-year prepayment prohibition and prepayment fee provision in the man's mortgage are valid and enforceable, even if the bank could reloan the funds to another without loss (Choices B & D).

†Roughly half of all states prohibit or restrict prepayment penalties on mortgaged residential property (eg, by limiting the penalty rate or time in which the penalty can be imposed).

Educational objective: A debtor has the right to prepay a mortgage debt unless the mortgage provides otherwise. Prepayment prohibitions or penalties in a mortgage are generally valid and enforceable.

提前偿还抵押贷款的权利


普通法除非抵押文件另有规定，否则禁止提前还款
多数规则除非抵押文件另有规定，否则允许提前还款
根据普通法的“按期完全清偿”规则，除非抵押文件另有规定，否则抵押人（债务人）无权提前偿还抵押债务。然而，主流的现代趋势推翻了这一推定，允许提前还款，除非抵押文件另有规定。

抵押合同中包含的禁止提前还款或提前还款罚金的条款通常是有效且可执行的。† 它们不违反公共政策，因为它们服务于以下有益目的：

允许抵押权人维持抵押协议中预期的财务收益，并且

补偿抵押权人因提前还款而遭受的任何损失（选项A）。

因此，该男子抵押合同中两年内禁止提前还款的规定和提前还款费的条款是有效且可执行的，即使银行可以在没有损失的情况下将资金重新贷给他人（选项B和D）。

†大约一半的州禁止或限制对有抵押的住宅物业收取提前还款罚金（例如，通过限制罚款利率或可以施加罚款的期限）。

教学目标： 债务人有权提前偿还抵押债务，除非抵押合同另有规定。抵押合同中的禁止提前还款或提前还款罚金条款通常是有效且可执行的。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages §§ 6.1–6.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (right to prepay mortgage).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages
正确答案：C 两年内禁止提前还款的规定（Lock-out clause）和提前还款费条款（Prepayment penalty）均有效且可执行。
核心法律原则

本题考察的是抵押贷款中提前还款（Prepayment）的规则。在分析此类问题时，需掌握以下演变：

1. 普通法规则 (Common Law Rule)：
遵循 Perfect Tender in Time（按期完全清偿）原则。除非抵押文件明确允许，否则借款人无权提前还款。

2. 现代趋势 (Modern Trend)：
推定借款人有权提前还款，除非抵押文件明确禁止或限制。

3. 关键结论：
无论遵循哪种规则，合同条款（Contract Terms）通常是决定性的。如果合同明确规定了“禁止提前还款期”（Lock-out period）或“提前还款罚金”（Prepayment fee），法院通常会予以执行，特别是在商业贷款（Commercial Loan）背景下。

为何条款可执行？

虽然借款人想还钱是好事，但法律保护贷款人（Lender）的合同预期利益，主要基于以下两点：

  • 收益维持 (Yield Maintenance)： 银行发放贷款是作为一种投资，期望在特定期限内获得稳定的利息收入。
  • 商业背景： 本题明确指出是“商业建筑”（Commercial Building）。法院在处理商业贷款时，比处理住宅贷款（Residential Mortgage）更倾向于严格执行合同字面含义，因为双方被视为成熟的商业主体。
干扰项排除
排除选项 A (公共政策)：
虽然法律鼓励债务偿还，但并不禁止双方通过合同约定偿还的时间表。在商业背景下，限制提前还款并不违反公共政策（Public Policy）。
排除选项 B (利率上升)：
这是一个经典的MBE陷阱。题目提到利率上升，意味着银行收回资金再贷出会赚更多钱（没有实际损失）。
然而，合同的可执行性（Enforceability）通常在合同订立时判断，或者基于合同条款本身的有效性，而不是基于违约时银行是否受损。即使银行能获利，它也有权坚持履行原合同条款。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

1. 看主体： 注意题目是“商业贷款”还是“住宅贷款”。虽然本题中规则通用，但如果是住宅贷款，某些州可能有成文法（Statute）限制罚金。本题特意说明 "There is no applicable statute"，提示你应用普通法/合同法原则。
2. 看合同： 在抵押贷款法中，合同自由（Freedom of Contract）权重很高。如果合同白纸黑字写了罚金，除非有成文法禁止，否则通常有效。

questions.question:
A homebuyer financed the purchase of a new home by executing a promissory note and purchase-money mortgage to his credit union. The mortgage was promptly recorded. The next year, the home developed foundation problems. The homebuyer was forced to take out a second mortgage with a bank to finance the repairs. The mortgage was properly recorded, and file-stamped copies were sent to the homebuyer and the credit union.
After making consistent payments for five years, the homebuyer defaulted on both mortgages. The homebuyer agreed to execute a deed in lieu of foreclosure to the credit union in satisfaction of the debt. The deed was signed, delivered, and properly recorded. The credit union then initiated foreclosure proceedings on its first mortgage in order to eliminate the second mortgage held by the bank.
Is the credit union likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the credit union had actual knowledge of the second mortgage when it accepted the deed in lieu of foreclosure.
choices.b: No, because the deed in lieu of foreclosure automatically eliminated the second mortgage under the doctrine of merger.
choices.c: Yes, because the credit union impliedly retained the right to foreclose on the mortgage to eliminate junior liens.
choices.d: Yes, because the doctrine of merger does not apply to mortgages and the lender retains the right to foreclose.

一位购房者通过向其信用合作社签署一份本票（promissory note）和购房抵押合同（purchase-money mortgage），为其新房的购买进行了融资。该抵押权被及时登记。次年，该房屋出现地基问题。购房者被迫向一家银行申请了第二顺位抵押贷款，以资助维修费用。该抵押权被妥善登记，并且盖有归档印章的副本被发送给了购房者和信用合作社。

在连续还款五年后，该购房者对两项抵押贷款均发生了违约。购房者同意向信用合作社签署一份替代止赎的契约（deed in lieu of foreclosure），以清偿其债务。该契约经签署、交付并妥善登记。信用合作社随后对其第一顺位抵押权启动了止赎程序，以清除银行持有的第二顺位抵押权。

信用合作社是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the credit union had actual knowledge of the second mortgage when it accepted the deed in lieu of foreclosure.
否，因为信用合作社在接受替代止赎的契约时，已实际知晓存在第二顺位抵押权。

B. No, because the deed in lieu of foreclosure automatically eliminated the second mortgage under the doctrine of merger.
否，因为根据合并原则（doctrine of merger），替代止赎的契约自动清除了第二顺位抵押权。

C. Yes, because the credit union impliedly retained the right to foreclose on the mortgage to eliminate junior liens.
是，因为信用合作社默示地保留了通过止赎其抵押权以清除次顺位留置权的权利。

D. Yes, because the doctrine of merger does not apply to mortgages and the lender retains the right to foreclose.
是，因为合并原则（doctrine of merger）不适用于抵押权，且贷款人保留止赎的权利。
data.explanation:
The homebuyer (mortgagor) executed a deed in lieu of foreclosure , under which he conveyed all interest in the mortgaged property to the credit union (mortgagee) to avoid foreclosure. This gave the credit union the right to take immediate possession of the property without the formalities of a foreclosure sale.

However, by accepting the deed, the credit union may have lost the right to foreclose on its mortgage to eliminate the bank's junior mortgage, depending on the jurisdiction. A minority of jurisdictions apply the doctrine of merger when the same person (here, the credit union) acquires the mortgagee's interest in real property and the mortgagor's interest in that same property (Choice D). When this occurs, the mortgage merges into the fee estate and is thereby extinguished. As a result, the mortgagee has no lien on which to foreclose and any junior liens are promoted in status. Had the minority rule regarding merger applied, the deed in lieu of foreclosure would have automatically eliminated the credit union's first mortgage - not the bank's second mortgage.

However, most jurisdictions have adopted the Restatement's position that the merger doctrine does not apply to mortgages (default rule on the MBE). Instead, a mortgagee that receives a deed in lieu of foreclosure is treated as having impliedly retained the right to foreclose on its mortgage - unless it had actual knowledge of a junior lien. If so, then the mortgagee cannot foreclose on its mortgage to eliminate that junior lien (Choices C & D).

Here, the credit union received a file-stamped copy of the bank's mortgage, so the credit union had actual knowledge of this junior lien when it received the homebuyer's deed in lieu of foreclosure. As a result, the credit union is not likely to prevail in foreclosure proceedings on its first mortgage to eliminate the bank's junior mortgage. (Choice B)

Educational objective: A mortgagee that receives a deed in lieu of foreclosure generally retains the right to foreclose on its mortgage. But if the mortgagee had actual knowledge of a junior lien, then it cannot foreclose on its mortgage to eliminate that lien.



选项正确率统计：A选项 51%（正确选项），B选项 18%，C选项 23%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

购房者（抵押人）签署了一份替代止赎的契约（deed in lieu of foreclosure），据此他将抵押财产中的全部权益转让给信用合作社（抵押权人），以避免止赎。这使得信用合作社有权立即占有该财产，而无需经过止赎拍卖的正式程序。

然而，通过接受该契约，信用合作社可能已经丧失了通过止赎其抵押权来清除银行的次顺位抵押权的权利，这取决于所在的司法管辖区。少数司法管辖区适用合并原则（doctrine of merger），即当同一人（此处为信用合作社）同时获得了不动产的抵押权人权益和同一不动产的抵押人权益时(选项 D)。当此情况发生时，抵押权并入完全保有地产权（fee estate）中并因此而消灭。结果是，抵押权人不再拥有可以进行止赎的留置权，而任何次顺位留置权的顺位都会被提升。如果适用了关于合并原则的少数派规则，替代止赎的契约将会自动清除信用合作社的第一顺位抵押权，而不是银行的第二顺位抵押权。

然而，大多数司法管辖区采纳了《法律重述》（Restatement）的立场，即合并原则不适用于抵押权（这是MBE考试中的默认规则）。相反，收到替代止赎契约的抵押权人被视为默示地保留了对其抵押权进行止赎的权利——除非其实际知晓存在次顺位留置权。如果是这样，那么抵押权人不能通过止赎其抵押权来清除该次顺位留置权(选项 C & D)。

在本案中，信用合作社收到了银行抵押合同的盖有归档印章的副本，因此，当其收到购房者的替代止赎契约时，它已实际知晓这一次顺位留置权的存在。因此，信用合作社在其第一顺位抵押权的止赎程序中，为清除银行的次顺位抵押权而提起的诉讼不太可能胜诉。(选项 B)

教学目标：收到替代止赎契约的抵押权人通常保留对其抵押权进行止赎的权利。但如果抵押权人实际知晓存在次顺位留置权，那么它就不能通过止赎其抵押权来清除该留置权。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 8.5 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (discussing deeds in lieu of foreclosure). Copyright © Tomato. All rights reserved.

MBE 考点解析：替代止赎与混同原则

本题考察的是不动产法中关于抵押权（Mortgages）的一个核心难点：当第一顺位抵押权人接受“替代止赎契约”时，次顺位抵押权的命运如何？

核心概念：替代止赎契约
Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure

这是借款人（Mortgagor）为了避免正式的止赎程序（Foreclosure），自愿将房产产权直接转让给贷款人（Mortgagee）的行为。

⚖️ 法律规则解析

1. 混同原则 (Doctrine of Merger)
传统普通法认为，当同一人同时拥有土地的“完全所有权”（Fee Simple）和该土地上的“抵押权”（Mortgage）时，抵押权会“并入”所有权中而消灭。

后果：如果第一顺位抵押权因混同而消灭，第二顺位抵押权就会自动升级为第一顺位。这对债权人非常不利。
2. 现代规则 (Modern/Restatement Rule)
为了保护债权人，大多数法院（及MBE默认规则）认为：如果混同对债权人不利，则不推定发生混同。

这意味着债权人通常保留其抵押权，可以通过止赎（Foreclosure）来清除次顺位留置权（Junior Liens）。
⚠️ 关键例外 (The Exception)
这是本题的解题关键：
如果债权人在接受“替代止赎契约”时，对次顺位留置权有实际知情 (Actual Knowledge)，法院通常会判定债权人接受了该房产及其附带的所有债务。

在这种情况下，债权人不能再通过止赎自己的抵押权来清除次顺位抵押权。

🔍 案情分析

1
信用社的地位：持有第一顺位抵押权。
2
银行的地位：持有第二顺位抵押权（Junior Lien）。
3
关键事实：信用社收到了银行抵押权的副本。这意味着信用社有实际知情 (Actual Knowledge)。
4
行为：信用社接受了购房者的替代止赎契约 (Deed in Lieu)。
5
结论：由于信用社在知情的情况下接受了契约，它被视为接受了带有第二顺位抵押权的房产。它丧失了通过止赎来清除银行抵押权的权利。

💡 为什么选 A？

选项 A 正确指出了实际知情 (Actual Knowledge) 是阻碍信用社胜诉的关键因素。因为信用社知道有第二顺位抵押权还选择接受契约，法律推定其意图是保留该次顺位抵押权，或者其接受的房产价值已经扣除了该债务。

🚫 为什么其他选项错误？

  • 选项 B (错误)：如果适用混同原则，信用社的第一顺位抵押权会消灭，银行的抵押权会升级，而不是被清除。
  • 选项 C & D (错误)：虽然通常债权人保留止赎权，但“实际知情”是一个强有力的例外，使得这一保留权利失效。
正确答案：A

questions.question:
A builder sold a new house to a buyer for use as the buyer's residence. The buyer paid 10% of the purchase price and financed the rest by executing a promissory note and purchase-money mortgage to the builder.
A year later, the buyer missed several mortgage payments to the builder and became unable to make payments. During that year, property values in the neighborhood declined substantially. The builder suggested that the buyer deed the house back to the builder to settle all claims and avoid the costs and other disadvantages of foreclosure. The buyer deeded the house back to the builder.
Does the builder now own fee simple title to the house?

choices.a: No, because the deed back to the builder constitutes a disguised mortgage.
choices.b: No, because the owner of a personal residence cannot waive the right to foreclosure.
choices.c: Yes, because of the doctrine of equitable redemption.
choices.d: Yes, because the transaction was reasonable and fair under the circumstances.

Q86814 A builder sold a new house to a buyer for use as the buyer's residence. The buyer paid 10% of the purchase price and financed the rest by executing a promissory note and purchase- money mortgage to the builder.

A year later, the buyer missed several mortgage payments to the builder and became unable to make payments. During that year, property values in the neighborhood declined substantially. The builder suggested that the buyer deed the house back to the builder to settle all claims and avoid the costs and other disadvantages of foreclosure. The buyer deeded the house back to the builder.

Does the builder now own fee simple title to the house? 一个建筑商将一栋新房卖给一个买方，供其作为住宅使用。买方支付了10%的购买价款，并通过向建筑商出具本票和购房抵押贷款来为余款融资。

一年后，买方拖欠了数期应付给建筑商的抵押贷款，并且无力继续支付。在那一年里，该社区的房产价值大幅下跌。建筑商建议买方将房屋契据交还给建筑商，以了结所有索赔，并避免止赎的成本和其他不利因素。买方将房屋契据交还给了建筑商。

建筑商现在是否拥有该房屋的完全所有权？
options:
A. No, because the deed back to the builder constitutes a disguised mortgage.
否，因为将契据交还给建筑商的行为构成了变相抵押。

B. No, because the owner of a personal residence cannot waive the right to foreclosure.
否，因为个人住宅的所有者不能放弃止赎权。

C. Yes, because of the doctrine of equitable redemption.
是，因为衡平法上的赎回权原则。

D. Yes, because the transaction was reasonable and fair under the circumstances.
是，因为在当时的情况下，该交易是合理和公平的。

Ways to avoid foreclosure


Equitable
redemption†		Mortgagor pays full amount of outstanding debt (as increased by acceleration clause) plus any accrued interest
Deed in lieu of
foreclosure		Mortgagor conveys all interest in mortgaged property to mortgagee
Renegotiating debtParties renegotiate terms of promissory note & mortgage
†Many states also recognize a statutory right of redemption that permits a mortgagor to reclaim the property after a foreclosure sale.

In lieu of foreclosure, the mortgagor may convey title to the mortgaged property to the mortgagee ("deed in lieu of foreclosure"). This allows the grantee-mortgagee to take immediate possession of the property without the formalities of a foreclosure sale. Deed-in-lieu transactions are generally valid so long as they are fair to the grantor-mortgagor. However, they run the risk of being labeled as an equitable or "disguised" mortgage (as opposed to a title conveyance) if it appears that the deed was intended only as security for the original mortgage.

Here, the buyer deeded the house back to the builder to avoid foreclosure. That transaction was reasonable and fair under the circumstances—particularly since property values had declined so much that any foreclosure sale might have resulted in a deficiency that the buyer would have been obligated to pay out of personal assets. And since there is no indication that the deed was intended only as security for the original mortgage (eg, had the buyer remained indebted to the builder or retained possession of the house), the builder owns the house in fee simple (Choice A).

(Choice B) The right to foreclose is held by the mortgagee (eg, builder)—not the mortgagor (eg, buyer)-and the mortgagee can waive this right by accepting a deed in lieu of foreclosure.

(Choice C) The doctrine of equitable redemption allows a mortgagor to prevent foreclosure by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt (as increased by an acceleration clause) plus interest. Had this doctrine been invoked, however, the buyer (not the builder) would own the home.

Educational objective: A mortgagor can avoid foreclosure by conveying title to the mortgaged property to the mortgagee ("deed in lieu of foreclosure"). Deed-in-lieu transactions are generally valid so long as they are fair to the grantor-mortgagor and not simply a means of continuing the original mortgage (ie, equitable or "disguised" mortgage).

避免止赎的方式


衡平法上的
赎回权†		抵押人支付全部未偿债务（根据加速到期条款增加后的金额）及任何应计利息
以契据代替
止赎		抵押人将其在抵押财产中的所有权益转让给抵押权人
重新协商债务双方重新协商本票和抵押贷款的条款
†许多州也承认法定赎回权，该权利允许抵押人在止赎拍卖之后赎回财产。

为替代止赎，抵押人可将抵押财产的所有权转让给抵押权人（“以契据代替止赎”）。这使得受让人-抵押权人能够立即占有该财产，而无需经过止赎拍卖的正式程序。只要对出让人-抵押人公平，以契据代替止赎的交易通常是有效的。然而，如果契据仅意图作为原始抵押的担保，那么该交易就有被认定为衡平法上的或“变相”抵押（而非所有权转让）的风险。

在本案中，买方将房屋契据交还给建筑商以避免止赎。在当时的情况下，该交易是合理和公平的——特别是因为房产价值已大幅下跌，任何止赎拍卖都可能导致差额，而买方将有义务用其个人资产来偿付该差额。并且，由于没有迹象表明该契据仅意图作为原始抵押的担保（例如，买方是否仍对建筑商负有债务或保留对房屋的占有），建筑商以完全所有权拥有该房屋（选项A）。

(选项B) 止赎权由抵押权人（如建筑商）而非抵押人（如买方）持有，并且抵押权人可以通过接受以契据代替止赎的方式来放弃此权利。

(选项C) 衡平法上的赎回权原则允许抵押人通过支付全部未偿债务（根据加速到期条款增加后的金额）及利息来阻止止赎。然而，如果援引了该原则，那么拥有房屋的将是买方（而不是建筑商）。

教学目的： 抵押人可以通过将抵押财产的所有权转让给抵押权人（“以契据代替止赎”）来避免止赎。只要对出让人-抵押人公平，并且不单纯是延续原始抵押的一种方式（即衡平法上的或“变相”抵押），以契据代替止赎的交易通常是有效的。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages & 8.5 cmt. b (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (discussing deeds in lieu of foreclosure).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages
🔑 核心考点：以契据代替止赎 (Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure)

当借款人（Mortgagor）违约时，为了避免正式的止赎程序（Foreclosure），可以将抵押房产的所有权直接转让给贷款人（Mortgagee）。这种交易被称为 Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure。

⚖️ 法律分析与推理

本题考察的是贷款人接受“以契据代替止赎”的有效性。根据普通法规则：

  1. 有效性原则： 只要交易是公平且合理 (Fair and Reasonable) 的，且没有欺诈、胁迫或显失公平的情况，法院通常会承认这种转让的有效性。
  2. 所有权转移： 一旦契据交付并被接受，贷款人（本题中的建筑商）即获得该房产的完全所有权 (Fee Simple Title)，原始债务通常随之消灭。
  3. 本案事实：
    • 买方违约且无力支付。
    • 房产价值大幅下跌（意味着如果进行止赎拍卖，买方可能面临巨额的差额判决 Deficiency Judgment）。
    • 建筑商提议以此方式“了结所有索赔”。
    • 买方自愿同意。

由于该交易在当时的情况下对双方都是合理的（买方免除了债务责任，卖方避免了止赎成本），因此建筑商获得了完全的所有权。

✅ 为什么选 D？
选项 D 正确：
"Yes, because the transaction was reasonable and fair under the circumstances."

这是判断 Deed in Lieu 是否有效的核心标准。法院会审查交易是否压榨了借款人。鉴于房产贬值严重，买方通过交还房产免除了潜在的个人债务（Deficiency），这被视为公平的对价。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误 (Disguised Mortgage)：
虽然法院有时会将契据认定为“变相抵押” (Equitable Mortgage)，但这通常发生在债务未被免除或借款人保留占有权的情况下。本案中，双方意图是“了结所有索赔”并转移所有权，而非将其作为新的担保。
选项 B 错误 (Waiver of Foreclosure)：
法律禁止的是在抵押设立时就放弃赎回权（Clogging the Equity of Redemption）。但在违约发生后，借款人完全有权通过新协议（如 Deed in Lieu）放弃房产以抵债。
选项 C 错误 (Equitable Redemption)：
衡平法赎回权 (Equitable Redemption) 是指借款人在止赎前通过还清全款来保住房子的权利。如果应用此原则，结果应该是买方拥有房子（前提是他还钱），而不是建筑商拥有房子。
💡 MBE 考试技巧：
遇到 Deed in Lieu 的题目，首先检查是否存在“压榨”借款人的迹象。

如果题目中提到房产价值低于债务金额（Under water），且借款人借此免除了债务，这通常被视为有效的 Fee Simple 转让。

如果房产价值远高于债务，而贷款人强迫借款人交出房产，法院才可能介入将其视为无效或变相抵押。

questions.question:
The owner of a residence entered into a contract of sale with a couple. After a down payment, the remaining purchase price of the residence was $500,000. The couple was only able to secure a mortgage loan from a bank for $400,000, so the owner-seller agreed to advance the couple the difference in exchange for a mortgage on the residence. At closing, the couple paid the owner-seller $400,000 from the proceeds of their bank loan. The couple also signed notes that obligated them to pay $400,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the owner-seller, and to give the bank and the owner-seller mortgages on the residence to secure those notes. The owner-seller, agreeing to the bank's demand, subordinated her mortgage to the bank's mortgage. The bank recorded its mortgage one day after the owner-seller recorded her mortgage.
Several years later, the couple stopped paying on both notes at a time when the principal balances of their obligations were $350,000 to the bank and $85,000 to the owner-seller. The owner-seller has filed a complaint for foreclosure on her mortgage.
The recording act of the applicable jurisdiction reads, "No conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice who shall first record."
Is the owner-seller required to make the bank a party to this action?

choices.a: No, because the owner-seller subordinated her mortgage to the bank's mortgage.
choices.b: No, because the remaining principal amount of the couple's obligation to the bank exceeds that of the owner-seller.
choices.c: Yes, because the owner-seller recorded her mortgage before the bank recorded its mortgage.
choices.d: Yes, because the owner-seller's purchase-money mortgage has priority over the bank's mortgage.

一位住宅所有者与一对夫妇签订了销售合同。支付首付款后，该住宅的剩余购买价款为50万美元。这对夫妇只能从一家银行获得40万美元的抵押贷款，因此，卖方所有者同意为这对夫妇垫付差额，以换取该住宅的抵押权。在过户时，这对夫妇用其银行贷款所得向卖方所有者支付了40万美元。这对夫妇还签署了票据，使他们有义务向银行支付40万美元，向卖方所有者支付10万美元，并向银行和卖方所有者提供该住宅的抵押权以担保这些票据。卖方所有者同意了银行的要求，将其抵押权置于银行的抵押权之后。银行在卖方所有者登记其抵押权一天后，也登记了自己的抵押权。

几年后，这对夫妇停止偿还两份票据，当时他们对银行的债务本金余额为35万美元，对卖方所有者的债务本金余额为8.5万美元。卖方所有者已就其抵押权提起止赎诉讼。

该适用司法管辖区的登记法规定：“任何不动产的转让或抵押，对于首先登记的、有偿且无通知的后续购买者，均不具有对抗效力。”

卖方所有者是否必须将银行列为此诉讼的当事方？
options:
A. No, because the owner-seller subordinated her mortgage to the bank's mortgage.
否，因为卖方所有者已将其抵押权置于银行的抵押权之后。

B. No, because the remaining principal amount of the couple's obligation to the bank exceeds that of the owner-seller.
否，因为这对夫妇对银行的剩余本金债务超过了对卖方所有者的债务。

C. Yes, because the owner-seller recorded her mortgage before the bank recorded its mortgage.
是，因为卖方所有者在银行登记其抵押权之前登记了自己的抵押权。

D. Yes, because the owner-seller's purchase-money mortgage has priority over the bank's mortgage.
是，因为卖方所有者的购房抵押权优先于银行的抵押权。
data.explanation:
The owner-seller has filed a complaint for foreclosure on her mortgage, thereby seeking a foreclosure conducted by a judicially supervised sale. Under this method of foreclosure, the foreclosing mortgagee (ie, lender):
  • must give notice to the holders of any junior interests in the property so that they can participate or send a representative - otherwise, the junior-interest holder's interest will remain after the sale
  • may, but need not, join others who have an interest in the property (eg, senior-mortgage holder) or who are liable on the debt (eg, guarantor) as proper, but not necessary, parties†
In foreclosure proceedings, lien priority is determined by the "first in time, first in right" rule unless the jurisdiction has a recording act - eg, a race- notice act (as seen here). Additionally, mortgages given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property (ie, purchase-money mortgages) have super priority over all other liens. However, a senior-mortgage holder can always agree to subordinate his/her interest to that of a junior- mortgage holder, in which case the junior mortgage receives priority.

Here, the owner-seller and the bank acquired purchase-money mortgages because their loan proceeds were used to purchase the residence. Although the facts do not indicate which mortgage was created first, a seller's purchase-money mortgage generally has priority over a lender's purchase-money mortgage - regardless of who recorded first. But since the owner-seller agreed to subordinate her mortgage, the bank has the senior mortgage (Choices C & D). Therefore, the bank need not be made a party to this foreclosure action.

†That is because a valid foreclosure only terminates interests in the foreclosed property that are junior to the interest being foreclosed. It has no effect on any other interests.

(Choice B) The size of the obligation secured by a mortgage does not determine its priority with regard to other mortgages on the same property.

Educational objective: For a judicially supervised foreclosure sale, the foreclosing mortgagee must give notice to the holders of any junior interests in the property. Any others who have an interest in the property (eg, senior-mortgage holder) or who are liable on the debt (eg, guarantor) may be joined as proper but unnecessary parties.



选项正确率统计：A选项 55%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 21%，D选项 21%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方所有者已就其抵押权提起止赎诉讼，从而寻求通过司法监督下的拍卖进行止赎。根据此种止赎方法，行使止赎权的抵押权人（即贷款人）：
  • 必须向财产上的任何次级权益持有人发出通知，以便他们可以参与或派代表出席——否则，次级权益持有人的权益在拍卖后仍将存续
  • 可以（但非必须）将对该财产享有权益的其他人（例如，高级抵押权持有人）或对债务负有责任的人（例如，担保人）作为适当但非必要的当事方加入诉讼†
在止赎程序中，除非司法管辖区有登记法——例如，一个竞赛-通知法案（如本案所示），否则留置权的优先顺序由“先占先得”规则决定。此外，为担保被抵押财产的购买价款而设立的抵押权（即，购房抵押权）享有相对于所有其他留置权的超级优先权。但是，高级抵押权持有人始终可以同意将其权益置于次级抵押权持有人的权益之后，在这种情况下，次级抵押权获得优先权。

在本案中，卖方所有者和银行都获得了购房抵押权，因为他们的贷款所得被用于购买该住宅。尽管案件事实并未指明哪个抵押权先设立，但卖方的购房抵押权通常优先于贷款人的购房抵押权——无论谁先登记。但由于卖方所有者同意将其抵押权顺位置后，银行拥有了高级抵押权（选项C和D）。因此，银行无需被列为此止赎诉讼的当事方。

†这是因为一次有效的止赎仅终止被止赎财产上劣后于正在被行使止赎权的权益。它对任何其他权益没有影响。

（选项B）由抵押权担保的债务规模，并不决定其相对于同一财产上其他抵押权的优先顺序。

教学目标：对于司法监督下的止赎拍卖，行使止赎权的抵押权人必须向财产上任何次级权益的持有人发出通知。对该财产享有权益的任何其他人（例如，高级抵押权持有人）或对债务负有责任的人（例如，担保人）可以作为适当但非必要的当事方被加入诉讼。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 592 (2019) (discussing the requirement to notify junior lienholders of the foreclosure action).

抵押止赎与当事方

Mortgage Foreclosure & Parties
正确答案：A 不需要，因为卖方所有者（Owner-Seller）已将其抵押权从属（Subordinated）于银行的抵押权。
优先权顺序 (Priority)

本案的关键在于从属协议 (Subordination Agreement)。尽管卖方拥有购房抵押权（PMM），通常享有优先权，但她自愿签署协议将自己置于次级地位。

1. 银行 (Bank)
高级抵押权 (Senior Mortgage)
⬇️
2. 卖方 (Owner-Seller)
次级抵押权 (Junior Mortgage)
正在止赎 (Foreclosing)
必要当事方规则 (Necessary Parties)

在司法止赎（Judicial Foreclosure）中，谁必须被加入诉讼？

  • 必须加入 (Necessary)： 次级权益持有人 (Junior Lienholders)。
    原因：止赎会消灭次级权益。为了正当程序（Due Process），必须通知他们以保护其权益（如参与竞拍或主张剩余款项）。
  • 无需加入 (Not Necessary)： 高级权益持有人 (Senior Lienholders)。
    原因：次级抵押权的止赎不会影响高级抵押权。买家买到的房产仍背负着高级抵押权（Subject to the senior mortgage）。

结论：由于卖方是次级（Junior），银行是高级（Senior），银行的权益不会被这次止赎消灭，因此银行不是必要当事方。

排除干扰项
  • 选项 B 错误：债务金额的大小（Principal Amount）与抵押权的优先顺位无关。
  • 选项 C 错误：虽然卖方先登记，但从属协议（Subordination Agreement）是当事人之间的合同，它推翻了默认的“先登记先得”规则。
  • 选项 D 错误：虽然卖方的PMM通常优先于银行的PMM，但同样因为从属协议的存在，卖方放弃了这种优先权。
💡 MBE 破题技巧

警惕“红鲱鱼” (Red Herrings)：

题目给出了详细的登记法 (Recording Act) 条文和登记时间。这是典型的干扰信息！

一旦你看到当事人之间签署了从属协议 (Subordination Agreement)，登记的先后顺序和PMM的默认优先权规则通常就不再重要了。合同约定优先于默认的法定排序规则。

A man owned land. He took out a loan that was secured by a mortgage on the land. The man had personal liability on the loan.
The man sold the land to a purchaser, who expressly assumed the mortgage debt. The purchaser failed to make two installment payments. To prevent default and foreclosure, the man paid the overdue installments. After making the payments, the man sued the purchaser for reimbursement.
Is the man likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because the man did not initiate foreclosure proceedings before seeking reimbursement.
choices.b: No, because the man was personally liable on the loan.
choices.c: Yes, because the law of suretyship permits the man to seek reimbursement.

一名男子拥有一块土地。他通过该土地的抵押担保获得了一笔贷款。该男子对该贷款承担个人责任。

该男子将土地出售给一名购买者，购买者明确承担了该抵押债务。购买者未能支付两期分期付款。为防止违约和止赎，该男子支付了逾期的分期付款。付款后，该男子起诉购买者要求偿还。

该男子是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because the man did not initiate foreclosure proceedings before seeking reimbursement.
不会，因为该男子在寻求偿还之前没有提起止赎程序。

B. No, because the man was personally liable on the loan.
不会，因为该男子对该贷款承担个人责任。

C. Yes, because the law of suretyship permits the man to seek reimbursement.
会，因为保证法允许该男子寻求求偿。

D. Yes, because the man's transfer of the land discharged him from any personal liability on the loan.
会，因为该男子转让土地的行为免除了其对贷款的任何个人责任。
data.explanation:
Suretyship rights (recourse for secondary obligor)


Specific performanceCourt order requiring primarily obligor to specifically perform all or part of his/her contractual duties
ReimbursementRepayment for secondary obligor fulfilling all or part of primary obligor's underlying contractual duties
RestitutionRepayment to secondary obligor to avoid unjust enrichment to primary obligor even when no duty exists
SubrogationSecondary obligor given rights of primary obligor & is protected as though an assignment of rights occurred
A mortgagor (ie, borrower) is generally free to transfer mortgaged property to another (ie, transferee). After the sale, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the mortgagor remains personally liable for the mortgage debt in the absence of a release by the mortgagee (eg, bank). However, the transferee's obligations with respect to that debt depend on whether the transferee:

  • took subject to the mortgage - in which case, the transferee is not personally liable for the debt or
  • agreed to assume the mortgage - in which case, the transferee becomes primarily liable for the debt and the mortgagor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.


If a transferee defaults on an assumed mortgage and the mortgagor then pays that debt, the mortgagor can seek reimbursement from the transferee under the law of suretyship.

Here, the purchaser expressly assumed the man's mortgage debt, so the purchaser became primarily liable for the debt and the man became secondarily liable as a surety (Choice D). The purchaser then defaulted by failing to make two installment payments. Since the man paid the overdue installments, the law of suretyship permits him to seek reimbursement from the purchaser. As a result, the man is likely to prevail.

(Choice A) A foreclosure proceeding can be initiated only by the mortgagee or the current holder of the mortgagee's security interest - not the mortgagor (eg, the man).

(Choice B) The right to seek reimbursement under the law of suretyship requires that the man be personally liable on the loan, which he was as a surety. Therefore, the man's personal liability provides a basis for him to prevail .

Educational objective: When a mortgagor transfers mortgaged property to someone who assumes the mortgage, the transferee becomes primarily liable for the mortgage and the mortgagor becomes secondarily liable as a surety. So if the mortgagor pays the mortgage debt after the transferee defaults, the mortgagor can seek reimbursement.

选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 37%，C选项 37%（正确选项），D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

保证权（次级债务人的追索权）


特定履行 (Specific performance)法院命令，要求主债务人特定履行其全部或部分合同义务
求偿权 (Reimbursement)为次级债务人履行主债务人全部或部分基本合同义务后的偿还
不当得利返还 (Restitution)为避免主债务人不当得利而向次级债务人进行的偿还，即使在没有合同义务存在的情况下
代位求偿权 (Subrogation)次级债务人被赋予主债务人的权利，并如同发生权利转让一样受到保护
抵押人（即借款人）通常可以自由地将附抵押权的财产转让给他人（即受让人）。出售后，抵押权依然附着于该财产，并且在抵押权人（例如银行）未免除其责任的情况下，抵押人仍对抵押债务承担个人责任。然而，受让人对该债务的义务取决于受让人是：

  • 承受附抵押权负担的财产 (took subject to the mortgage) - 在这种情况下，受让人对债务不承担个人责任；或者
  • 同意承担抵押债务 (agreed to assume the mortgage) - 在这种情况下，受让人成为债务的主债务人，而抵押人则成为作为保证人的次级债务人。


如果受让人对一笔已承担的抵押债务违约，而抵押人随后偿付了该债务，则抵押人可以根据保证法向受让人寻求求偿。

在本案中，购买者明确承担了该男子的抵押债务，因此购买者成为债务的主债务人，而该男子则成为作为保证人的次级债务人（选项D）。随后，购买者因未能支付两期分期付款而违约。由于该男子支付了逾期的分期付款，保证法允许他向购买者寻求求偿。因此，该男子可能胜诉。

（选项A） 止赎程序只能由抵押权人或抵押权人担保权益的当前持有人提起——而不是由抵押人（例如，该男子）提起。

（选项B） 根据保证法寻求求偿的权利，要求该男子对贷款承担个人责任，而他作为保证人确实承担此责任。因此，该男子的个人责任为他胜诉提供了依据。

教学目标：当抵押人将附抵押权的财产转让给承担该抵押债务的人时，受让人成为抵押债务的主债务人，抵押人则成为作为保证人的次级债务人。因此，如果受让人违约后，抵押人偿付了抵押债务，抵押人可以寻求求偿。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assumption of a mortgage).

Restatement (Third) of Suretyship & Guaranty § 22 (Am. Law Inst. 1996) (surety's right to reimbursement).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

抵押贷款的承担与保证责任

本题考察的核心法律原则是：当买方“承担”抵押贷款时，原借款人（卖方）与新买方之间的法律关系变化。

核心结论 该男子（卖方）可能胜诉。因为买方明确承担了债务，买方成为主债务人，卖方转变为保证人。保证人代为偿还债务后，有权向主债务人求偿 (Reimbursement)。

法律逻辑详解

在不动产交易中，当附带抵押权的房产被转让时，通常有两种情况：

  1. 受让 (Subject to the Mortgage)： 买方不承担个人责任，仅房产本身作为担保。
  2. 承担 (Assumption of the Mortgage)： 买方承诺对债务承担个人责任。

本题明确指出购买者 "expressly assumed"（明确承担）了抵押债务。这导致了法律关系的重组：

银行 (Mortgagee)
⬇️ 贷款关系
购买者 (Purchaser)
主债务人 (Primary Obligor)
卖方 (Man)
保证人 (Surety)

根据 保证法 (Law of Suretyship)：

  • 卖方虽然对银行仍有责任（除非银行免除），但在他与买方之间，他变成了次级债务人 (Secondary Obligor)。
  • 当主债务人（买方）违约，次级债务人（卖方）为了保护自己的利益（避免信用受损或被起诉）而支付债务时，他拥有向主债务人追偿的权利。这被称为 Right of Reimbursement。

选项分析

选项 C (正确)

Yes, because the law of suretyship permits the man to seek reimbursement.
这是正确答案。基于上述的保证关系，卖方作为保证人代偿后，有权要求主债务人（买方）全额偿还。

选项 A (错误)

止赎 (Foreclosure) 是抵押权人（银行）的权利，不是抵押人（卖方）的义务。卖方寻求的是金钱偿还，无需先启动止赎。

选项 D (错误陷阱)

...discharged him from any personal liability...
这是一个常见的误区。单纯的转让和承担并不会自动免除原借款人对银行的责任。除非银行签署了债务更替 (Novation) 协议，否则卖方对银行仍负有连带责任。但本题问的是卖方能否赢买方，而不是卖方是否对银行免责。

💡 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Assume the mortgage" 时，立即画出三角关系：
1. 买方 = 主债务人 (Primary)
2. 卖方 = 保证人 (Surety)
3. 卖方付钱 = 可以向买方追偿 (Reimbursement)

注意区分：如果是 "Subject to"，买方没有个人责任，卖方无法基于保证法追偿个人债务（虽然卖方可能基于买卖合同有其他救济，但不是保证责任）。

一名男子拖欠了以其住房作抵押的贷款。贷款人提起了适当的诉讼以对该抵押物行使止赎权，并且在司法止赎拍卖中，该住房被出售给了一位买家。此后不久，该男子继承了足够的资金，使其能够从买家手中重新购回该住房，但买家拒绝出售。

下列哪项能为该男子提起强制履行之诉，以迫使买家将住房所有权转让给他提供法律依据？
options:
A. The jurisdiction adheres to the doctrine of equitable redemption.
该司法管辖区遵循衡平法上的赎回权（equitable redemption）原则。

B. The jurisdiction does not follow the doctrine of merger.
该司法管辖区不遵循合并（merger）原则。

C. The jurisdiction has enacted a statute that permits redemption.
该司法管辖区已颁布一项允许赎回（redemption）的法规。

D. The jurisdiction recognizes the lien theory of mortgages.
该司法管辖区承认抵押权的留置权理论（lien theory of mortgages）。
data.explanation:
Right of redemption (regaining title after default on loan)


TimingAssertion of right
Equitable right
(always exists)		At any time prior to foreclosure salePay full amount of debt due (including interest) to lender
Statutory right
(if statute exists)		Statutory period after property has been sold in foreclosurePay foreclosure sale price to purchasing party
When a debtor (here, the man) defaults on mortgage payments, the creditor can initiate foreclosure proceedings to force the sale of the mortgaged property to satisfy the unpaid debt. Once the property has been sold, jurisdictions with a statutory right of redemption allow the debtor to reclaim the property by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchaser within a fixed period of time (typically between three months and two years).

Therefore, if the jurisdiction has enacted a statute that provides this right, the man would have legal justification for pursuing an action for specific performance to compel the buyer to transfer ownership of the home to the man.

(Choice A) The doctrine of equitable redemption allows a debtor to reclaim mortgaged property at any time before a foreclosure sale by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt, plus any accrued interest. But a debtor can only reclaim mortgaged property after a foreclosure sale if the jurisdiction has enacted a statute providing this right.

(Choice B) The doctrine of merger applies in the mortgage context when the same person acquires ownership of both the mortgage and the mortgaged property. When this occurs, the mortgage merges into fee simple ownership of the property. But the fact that the jurisdiction does not follow this doctrine would not affect the outcome of this dispute.

(Choice D) Regardless of which mortgage theory the jurisdiction recognizes, the man will have the right to redeem his home from the buyer only if the jurisdiction has a statutory right of redemption.

Educational objective: In jurisdictions with a statutory right of redemption, a debtor can reclaim property after a foreclosure sale by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchaser within a fixed period of time.

选项正确率统计：A选项 28%，B选项 0%，C选项 67%（正确选项），D选项 2%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

赎回权 (在贷款违约后重新获得所有权)


时间权利主张
衡平法上的权利
(始终存在)		止赎拍卖前的任何时间向贷款人支付全部到期债务（包括利息）
法定权利
(如果法规存在)		财产在止赎中被出售后的法定期限内向买方支付止赎拍卖价格
当债务人（此处指该男子）拖欠抵押贷款时，债权人可以启动止赎程序，强制出售抵押财产以清偿未付债务。一旦财产被出售，拥有法定赎回权的司法管辖区允许债务人在固定期限内（通常为三个月至两年）通过向买家支付止赎拍卖价格来收回财产。

因此，如果该司法管辖区已颁布一项提供此权利的法规，该男子将有法律依据提起强制履行之诉，以迫使买家将住房所有权转让给他。

(选项A) 衡平法上的赎回权原则允许债务人在止赎拍卖之前的任何时间，通过支付全部未偿债务及任何应计利息来收回抵押财产。但是，只有在该司法管辖区颁布了提供此项权利的法规时，债务人才能在止赎拍卖之后收回抵押财产。

(选项B) 在抵押权背景下，当同一人同时获得抵押权和抵押财产的所有权时，适用合并原则。当这种情况发生时，抵押权并入财产的完全所有权（fee simple ownership）。但是，该司法管辖区不遵循此原则这一事实，不会影响本争议的结果。

(选项D) 无论该司法管辖区承认何种抵押理论，只有在该司法管辖区存在法定赎回权的情况下，该男子才有权从买家手中赎回其住房。

教学目标：在拥有法定赎回权的司法管辖区，债务人可以在止赎拍卖之后的固定期限内，通过向买家支付止赎拍卖价格来收回财产。

References

30 Am. Jur. 2d Executions and Enforcement of Judgments § 291 (2020) (statutory right of redemption).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

核心考点：赎回权 (Redemption)

本题考察的是抵押贷款违约后，债务人重新获得房产所有权的两种不同机制：衡平法赎回权与法定赎回权的区别。

违约 (Default)
债务人停止付款，贷款人开始止赎程序。
衡平法赎回权 (Equitable Redemption)
时间段：止赎拍卖之前。
权利：普通法赋予的固有权利，不可剥夺。
条件：向贷款人支付全部欠款 + 利息。
止赎拍卖 (Foreclosure Sale)
关键分界点！
拍卖锤落下，衡平法赎回权终止。
法定赎回权 (Statutory Redemption)
时间段：止赎拍卖之后（通常6-12个月）。
权利：仅当州法律明确规定时才存在。
条件：向买家支付拍卖成交价。
✅ 正确答案：C

法律依据：题目明确指出房产已经被出售给买家 ("the home was sold to a buyer")。此时，衡平法上的赎回权已经消灭。

债务人想要在拍卖后从买家手中拿回房产，唯一的法律途径是该司法管辖区制定了法定赎回权 (Statutory Right of Redemption)。这种权利允许原房主在拍卖后的一定期限内，以拍卖价格赎回房产。

❌ 选项 A：衡平法赎回权 (Equitable Redemption)

这是所有司法管辖区都承认的权利，但它仅存在于止赎拍卖之前。一旦拍卖完成，此权利即告终止。由于本案中拍卖已结束，该原则无法帮助债务人。

❌ 选项 B & D：合并原则与留置权理论

合并原则 (Merger) 和 留置权理论 (Lien Theory) 属于干扰项。它们涉及抵押权的性质和所有权结构，但与止赎拍卖后是否能强行买回房产（赎回权）没有直接的因果关系。

💡 MBE 解题技巧

在处理赎回权问题时，首先看时间点：

  • 如果是 Before Sale → 选 Equitable Redemption (向银行还钱)。
  • 如果是 After Sale → 选 Statutory Redemption (向买家付钱，且必须有法规支持)。

questions.question:
A businessman owned a hotel, subject to a mortgage securing a debt he owed to a bank. The businessman later acquired a nearby parking garage, financing part of the purchase price with a loan from a financing company, secured by a mortgage on the parking garage. Two years thereafter, the businessman defaulted on the loan owed to the bank, which caused the full amount of that loan to become immediately due and payable. The bank decided not to foreclose the mortgage on the hotel at that time, but instead properly sued for the full amount of the defaulted loan. The bank obtained and properly filed a judgment for that amount.
A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for 10 years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." There is no other applicable statute, except the statute providing for judicial foreclosure of mortgages, which places no restrictions on deficiency judgments.
Shortly thereafter, the bank brought an appropriate action for judicial foreclosure of its mortgage on the hotel and of its judgment lien on the parking garage. The financing company was joined as a party defendant and appropriately sued for foreclosure of its mortgage on the parking garage, which was also in default. All procedures were properly followed, and the confirmed foreclosure sales resulted in the following: The net proceeds of the sale of the hotel to a third party were $200,000 less than the bank's mortgage balance. The net proceeds of the sale of the parking garage to a fourth party were $200,000 more than the financing company's mortgage balance.
How should the $200,000 surplus arising from the sale of the parking garage be distributed?

choices.a: It should be paid to the bank.
choices.b: It should be paid to the businessman.
choices.c: It should be paid to the financing company.
choices.d: It should be split equally between the bank and the financing company.

一名商人拥有一家酒店，该酒店受制于一份抵押，以担保其拖欠银行的债务。该商人随后收购了附近的一个停车库，部分购买价款由一家融资公司提供贷款，并以该停车库的抵押作为担保。两年后，该商人拖欠了银行的贷款，导致该笔贷款的全部金额立即到期并应予偿付。银行当时决定不对酒店的抵押进行强制拍卖，而是就拖欠贷款的全部金额提起了适当的诉讼。银行获得了该金额的判决，并对该判决进行了适当的登记。

该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何经适当登记的判决，自登记之日起10年内，均构成对判决所针对的任何人当时拥有或随后获得的不动产的留置权。”除规定抵押权司法强制拍卖的法规外，没有其他适用的法规，而该法规对差额判决不设任何限制。

此后不久，银行提起适当的诉讼，要求对酒店的抵押及其在停车库上的判决留置权进行司法强制拍卖。融资公司作为共同被告被卷入诉讼，并就其在停车库上的抵押（该抵押也已违约）适当地提起了强制拍卖诉讼。所有程序均得到妥善遵守，经确认的强制拍卖结果如下：将酒店出售给第三方的净收益比银行的抵押贷款余额少20万美元。将停车库出售给第四方的净收益比融资公司的抵押贷款余额多20万美元。

停车库出售产生的20万美元盈余应如何分配？
options:
A. It should be paid to the bank.
应支付给银行。

B. It should be paid to the businessman.
应支付给该商人。

C. It should be paid to the financing company.
应支付给融资公司。

D. It should be split equally between the bank and the financing company.
应在银行和融资公司之间平分。
data.explanation:
Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order of priority :

  • Expenses from the sale (eg, attorneys' fees, court costs)
  • Mortgage being foreclosed
  • Junior liens, in order of lien priority
  • Debtor, if any surplus remains


Here, the financing company had the senior lien on the garage since its mortgage was placed on the property first. The bank later acquired a judgment lien on all the businessman's property - including a junior lien on the garage - when the businessman defaulted on the bank's loan. And since the foreclosure sale of the garage satisfied the financing company's entire mortgage and resulted in a $200,000 surplus, the bank (as the junior lienholder) should receive the surplus to cover the balance still owed for its mortgage on the hotel (Choices B, C & D).

Educational objective: The proceeds from a foreclosure sale are distributed in the following order of priority: (1) the expenses from the foreclosure sale, (2) the mortgage being foreclosed, (3) junior liens in order of priority, and (4) the debtor.



选项正确率统计：A选项 72%（正确选项），B选项 13%，C选项 10%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

强制拍卖销售所得通常按以下优先顺序进行分配：

  • 销售费用（例如，律师费、诉讼费）
  • 被强制拍卖的抵押权
  • 按留置权顺位排序的次级留置权
  • 如有任何盈余，则归债务人


在此案中，融资公司对停车库拥有优先留置权，因为其抵押权是首先在该财产上设立的。当该商人拖欠银行贷款时，银行随后获得了对该商人所有财产的判决留置权——包括对停车库的次级留置权。并且，由于停车库的强制拍卖销售清偿了融资公司的全部抵押贷款并产生了20万美元的盈余，银行（作为次级留置权人）应获得该盈余，以弥补其酒店抵押贷款仍未偿还的余额（选项 B、C 和 D）。

教学目标：强制拍卖销售所得按以下优先顺序进行分配：（1）强制拍卖销售的费用，（2）被强制拍卖的抵押权，（3）按优先顺位排序的次级留置权，以及（4）债务人。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 705 (2019) (distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds).

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (effect of priority on distribution of foreclosure surplus).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
正确答案：A 停车库出售产生的 $200,000 盈余应支付给银行。
核心考点：止赎收益分配

在房地产止赎（Foreclosure）销售中，销售所得款项必须严格按照以下优先顺序（Priority）进行分配：

  • 1
    销售费用
    Expenses of the sale, court costs, attorney fees
  • 2
    被止赎的抵押债权
    The mortgage being foreclosed
  • 3
    次级留置权 (按顺位)
    Junior liens in order of priority
  • 4
    债务人 (仅当有剩余时)
    The Debtor / Mortgagor
案情深度解析

本题的关键在于理清停车库（Parking Garage）上的权利负担顺序。

1. 权利顺位分析：

第一顺位：融资公司抵押
(Senior Lien - Purchase Money Mortgage)
第二顺位：银行的判决留置权
(Junior Lien - Judgment Lien)
??? 盈余归谁 ???

2. 银行是如何获得停车库留置权的？
题目中提到，银行先就债务起诉并获得了判决（Judgment）。根据当地法规，判决一经登记，即成为债务人所有不动产（包括停车库）上的判决留置权（Judgment Lien）。因为这是后来发生的，所以它排在融资公司的抵押权之后，属于次级留置权（Junior Lien）。

3. 分配计算：
停车库被强制拍卖。

  • 所得款项首先偿还第一顺位的融资公司（已全额偿付）。
  • 剩余 $200,000 盈余（Surplus）。
  • 根据分配规则，盈余应流向次级留置权人。
  • 银行作为次级留置权人，且其在酒店拍卖中尚有 $200,000 的亏空（Deficiency），因此有权获得这笔盈余以清偿债务。

为什么其他选项错误？

选项 B (给商人/债务人)： 错误。
债务人只有在所有针对该财产的留置权（包括次级留置权）都得到清偿后，才能获得剩余款项。因为银行的判决留置权尚未满足，债务人无权拿钱。

选项 C (给融资公司)： 错误。
融资公司是第一顺位，题目明确说明其债务已被全额偿付（net proceeds were $200,000 more than the balance）。债权人不能获得超过其债权金额的款项。

选项 D (平分)： 错误。
法律遵循“时间在先，权利在先”（First in time, first in right）的原则，不存在平分规则。融资公司拿满后，剩下的全部给下一顺位，直到分完为止。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊

识别“双重身份”：
本题中银行有两个身份： 1. 酒店的抵押权人（Mortgagee）。 2. 停车库的判决留置权人（Judgment Lienholder）。

做题时务必将不同房产上的权利分开画图。对于停车库而言，银行只是一个普通的次级债权人。只要记住“瀑布式分配”（Waterfall Distribution）：先付费用，再付主债，再付次债，最后给房主。

questions.question:
A man borrowed money from a bank and executed a promissory note for the amount secured by a mortgage on an office building that he owned. Several years later, the man sold the building. As specified in the contract of sale, the deed to the buyer provided that the buyer agreed "to assume the existing mortgage debt" on the building.
Subsequently, the buyer defaulted on the mortgage loan to the bank, and appropriate foreclosure proceedings were initiated. The foreclosure sale resulted in a deficiency.
There is no applicable statute.
Is the buyer liable for the deficiency?

choices.a: No, because even if the buyer assumed the mortgage, the man is solely responsible for any deficiency.
choices.b: No, because the buyer did not sign a promissory note to the bank and therefore has no personal liability.
choices.c: Yes, because the buyer assumed the mortgage and therefore became personally liable for the mortgage loan and any deficiency.
choices.d: Yes, because the transfer of the mortgage debt to the buyer resulted in a novation of the original mortgage and loan and rendered the buyer solely responsible for any deficiency.

一名男子向银行借款，并签署了一份本票，该笔款项由他所拥有的一栋办公楼的抵押权作担保。几年后，该男子出售了这栋大楼。根据销售合同的规定，转让给买方的契据中约定，买方同意“承担该大楼上现有的抵押债务”。

随后，买方对银行的抵押贷款违约，银行启动了相应的止赎程序。止赎拍卖产生了不足额。

本案无适用法规。

买方是否应对该不足额承担责任？
options:
A. No, because even if the buyer assumed the mortgage, the man is solely responsible for any deficiency.
不会，因为即使买方承担了抵押，原业主仍是任何不足额的唯一责任人。

B. No, because the buyer did not sign a promissory note to the bank and therefore has no personal liability.
不会，因为买方没有向银行签署本票，因此不承担个人责任。

C. Yes, because the buyer assumed the mortgage and therefore became personally liable for the mortgage loan and any deficiency.
会，因为买方承担了抵押，因此对抵押贷款和任何不足额承担个人责任。

D. Yes, because the transfer of the mortgage debt to the buyer resulted in a novation of the original mortgage and loan and rendered the buyer solely responsible for any deficiency.
会，因为将抵押债务转让给买方导致了对原始抵押和贷款的债务更新，并使买方成为任何不足额的唯一责任人。
data.explanation:
Mortgage documents are used to convey a lender (ie, mortgagee) an interest in real property to secure a debt. The debtor (ie, mortgagor) can freely transfer mortgaged property unless the parties agree otherwise. After the transfer, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the debtor remains personally liable for the mortgage debt. But the grantee's obligations depend on whether the grantee:
  • took subject to the mortgage - in which case, the grantee does not agree to pay and is not personally liable for the debt or
  • assumed the mortgage - in which case, the grantee expressly agrees to pay and becomes personally liable for the debt, while the debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.
When a grantee assumes the mortgage (as seen here) and defaults on the mortgage loan, the grantee is primarily liable for any deficiency from the foreclosure sale (Choice B). Therefore, the buyer (grantee) is primarily liable for the deficiency here (Choice A).

(Choice D) A novation is a separate agreement between a lender and debtor in which (1) the lender agrees to substitute a new party for the debtor and (2) the debtor is excused from liability for the debt. Therefore, merely transferring the mortgage debt to another does not create a novation.

Educational objective: A party who assumes a mortgage expressly agrees to become personally liable for the mortgage debt. That means the party assuming the mortgage is primarily liable for paying any deficiency resulting from a foreclosure sale and the debtor is secondarily liable as a surety.



选项正确率统计：A选项 7%，B选项 2%，C选项 87%（正确选项），D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押文件用于向贷款人（即抵押权人 mortgagee）转让不动产权益，以担保一笔债务。债务人（即抵押人 mortgagor）可以自由转让已抵押的财产，除非当事人另有约定。转让后，抵押权仍然附着于该财产之上，而原债务人仍然对抵押债务承担个人责任。但是，受让人（grantee）的义务取决于受让人是：
  • 在抵押权负担下受让财产（took subject to the mortgage）—— 在此情况下，受让人不同意偿还债务，且对该债务不承担个人责任；或者
  • 承担抵押（assumed the mortgage）—— 在此情况下，受让人明确同意偿还并对债务承担个人责任，而原债务人则作为保证人（surety）承担第二性责任（secondarily liable）。
当受让人承担抵押（如本案所示）并对抵押贷款违约时，该受让人对止赎拍卖产生的任何不足额承担主要责任（选项B）。因此，此处的买方（受让人）对该不足额承担主要责任（选项A）。

（选项D）债务更新（novation）是贷款人与债务人之间的一项独立协议，其中（1）贷款人同意用一个新的当事人替代原债务人，并且（2）原债务人被免除债务责任。因此，仅仅将抵押债务转让给另一方并不构成债务更新。

教学目的：承担抵押的一方明确同意对抵押债务承担个人责任。这意味着，承担抵押的一方对支付因止赎拍卖产生的任何不足额负有主要责任，而原债务人作为保证人负有第二性责任。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assuming a mortgage debt).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

⚖️ 核心考点：抵押债务的承担

当抵押财产被转让时，买方（Grantee）对现有抵押债务的责任取决于契据中的措辞。这是 MBE 考试中关于不动产抵押的高频考点。

1. Subject to the Mortgage
(在抵押权负担下受让)
买方不承担个人责任。如果违约，银行可以止赎（卖房），但不能追究买方的个人财产来填补差额（Deficiency）。
2. Assume the Mortgage
(承担抵押)
买方承担个人责任。买方成为主要债务人（Primary Liable），原卖家成为保证人（Surety）。如果止赎后有差额，买方需赔偿。
🔍 题目逻辑分析

案情关键点：契据中明确写明买方同意 "to assume the existing mortgage debt"（承担现有抵押债务）。

法律后果：一旦买方签署或接受了包含“Assume”条款的契据，他就明确同意对债务负责。因此，当止赎拍卖所得不足以偿还银行贷款时（Deficiency），买方必须自掏腰包补足差额。

✅ 选项详解
选项 C (正确)

"Yes, because the buyer assumed the mortgage..."
这是对法律规则的直接应用。因为买方“承担”（Assumed）了抵押，所以他成为了主要责任人，必须对不足额（Deficiency）负责。

选项 A (错误)

该选项错误地认为原业主（卖家）是唯一的责任人。事实上，在“承担抵押”的情况下，买方变成主要责任人，卖家变成次要责任人（Surety）。只有在买方无法赔偿时，银行才会找卖家。

选项 B (错误陷阱)

陷阱点：“买方没有签署本票（Promissory Note）”。
虽然买方没有签原始的借条，但他通过接受包含承担条款的契据（Deed）这一行为，已经构成了承担债务的合同义务。不需要重新签署本票即可产生个人责任。

选项 D (错误概念)

该选项提到了 Novation（债务更新/更替）。
Novation 需要银行（Lender）、卖家和买方三方共同达成协议，明确免除卖家的责任并由买方替代。仅仅是买卖双方之间的转让和承担，并不构成 Novation，卖家并未被银行完全免责（只是退居次位）。

💡 考场实战技巧 在阅读 MBE 抵押权转让题目时，请立即寻找关键词：
  • 如果是 "Subject to" ➡️ 买方无个人责任 (No Personal Liability)。
  • 如果是 "Assume" ➡️ 买方有个人责任 (Personal Liability)。
注意：除非题目明确说银行签署了 Release 或 Novation，否则原卖家（Original Mortgagor）永远保持连带或次要责任，不会完全脱身。

questions.question:
A businessman executed a promissory note for $200,000 to a bank, secured by a mortgage on commercial real estate owned by the businessman. The promissory note stated that the businessman was not personally liable for the mortgage debt.
One week later, a finance company obtained a judgment against the businessman for $50,000 and filed the judgment in the county where the real estate was located. At the time the judgment was filed, the finance company had no actual notice of the bank's mortgage.
Two weeks after that filing, the bank recorded its mortgage on the businessman's real estate.
The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "Unless the same be recorded according to law, no conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice or against judgment creditors without notice."
The finance company sued to enforce its judgment lien against the businessman's real estate. The bank intervened in the action, contending that the judgment lien was a second lien on the real estate and that its mortgage was a first lien.
Is the bank's contention correct?

choices.a: No, because the businessman was not personally liable for the mortgage debt, and the mortgage was therefore void.
choices.b: No, because the judgment lien was recorded before the mortgage, and the finance company had no actual notice of the mortgage.
choices.c: Yes, because a mortgage prior in time has priority over a subsequent judgment lien.
choices.d: Yes, because the recording of a mortgage relates back to the date of execution of the mortgage note.

Q86023

A businessman executed a promissory note for $200,000 to a bank, secured by a mortgage on commercial real estate owned by the businessman. The promissory note stated that the businessman was not personally liable for the mortgage debt.

One week later, a finance company obtained a judgment against the businessman for $50,000 and filed the judgment in the county where the real estate was located. At the time the judgment was filed, the finance company had no actual notice of the bank's mortgage.

Two weeks after that filing, the bank recorded its mortgage on the businessman's real estate.

The recording act of the jurisdiction provides: "Unless the same be recorded according to law, no conveyance or mortgage of real property shall be good against subsequent purchasers for value and without notice or against judgment creditors without notice."

The finance company sued to enforce its judgment lien against the businessman's real estate. The bank intervened in the action, contending that the judgment lien was a second lien on the real estate and that its mortgage was a first lien.

Is the bank's contention correct?

一名商人向一家银行出具了一张20万美元的本票，并以其拥有的商业房地产进行抵押担保。该本票载明，该商人对抵押债务不承担个人责任。

一周后，一家金融公司获得了一项针对该商人的5万美元的判决，并将该判决在该房地产所在的郡进行了备案。在判决备案时，该金融公司并未实际知悉银行的抵押权。

在该备案两周后，银行才将其对该商人房地产的抵押权进行了登记。

该司法管辖区的登记法案规定：“除非根据法律进行登记，否则不动产的任何转让或抵押，均不得对抗善意有偿的后续购买人或善意的判决债权人。”

该金融公司提起诉讼，要求对该商人的房地产执行其判决留置权。银行参与了该诉讼，主张判决留置权是第二顺位的留置权，而其抵押权是第一顺位的留置权。

银行的主张是否正确？
options:
A. No, because the businessman was not personally liable for the mortgage debt, and the mortgage was therefore void.
否，因为该商人对抵押债务不承担个人责任，因此该抵押无效。

B. No, because the judgment lien was recorded before the mortgage, and the finance company had no actual notice of the mortgage.
否，因为判决留置权在抵押权之前登记，并且金融公司并未实际知悉该抵押权。

C. Yes, because a mortgage prior in time has priority over a subsequent judgment lien.
是，因为在先设立的抵押权优先于后续的判决留置权。

D. Yes, because the recording of a mortgage relates back to the date of execution of the mortgage note.
是，因为抵押权的登记效力可追溯至抵押票据的签署日期。
data.explanation:
The priority of mortgages and other liens is generally determined by their recording dates - not by the order in which those interests were created (Choices C & D). Purchase-money mortgages (PMMs), however, have super priority over all other liens - whether or not the PMM or those liens are recorded - because PMMs secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property.

Here, the businessman mortgaged commercial real estate he already owned to the bank (not a PMM). One week later, the finance company filed a judgment lien against the real estate in a jurisdiction whose recording act expressly protects judgment creditors who lack notice.† Since the judgment lien was recorded before the mortgage, the finance company lacked constructive (ie, record or inquiry) notice. Therefore, the judgment lien has first priority because the finance company also lacked actual notice of the bank's prior mortgage.

†Most recording acts protect only subsequent purchasers for value who lack notice of prior competing interests in the property - not judgment creditors since they do not pay value for an interest in the property.

(Choice A) A mortgage is enforceable even if no one is personally liable for payment of the mortgage debt.

Educational objective: The priority of mortgages (and other liens) is generally determined by the order of recording unless the mortgage enjoys super priority as a purchase-money mortgage.



选项正确率统计：A选项 2%，B选项 78%（正确选项），C选项 15%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押权及其他留置权的优先顺位通常由其登记日期决定——而非由这些权利设立的顺序决定（选项C和D）。然而，Purchase-money mortgages (PMMs)享有超级优先权，优于所有其他留置权——无论该PMMs或其他留置权是否登记——因为PMMs担保了抵押财产的购买价款。

在本案中，商人将其已经拥有的商业房地产抵押给银行（并非PMM）。一周后，金融公司在该房地产上备案了一项判决留置权，而该司法管辖区的登记法案明确保护善意（即不知情）的判决债权人。† 由于判决留置权在抵押权之前登记，金融公司缺乏推定通知（即登记通知或查询通知）。因此，判决留置权具有第一优先顺位，因为金融公司也并未实际知悉银行的在先抵押权。

†大多数登记法案仅保护对财产上在先的冲突权利不知情的善意有偿后续购买人——而不保护判决债权人，因为他们并未为获得财产权利而支付对价。

（选项A）即使无人对抵押债务的偿还承担个人责任，抵押权依然是可执行的。

教学目标：抵押权（及其他留置权）的优先顺位通常由登记顺序决定，除非该抵押权是享有超级优先权的purchase-money mortgage。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.1 cmt. a (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (noting that recording acts may alter the priority of mortgages differently than their chronological creation).
