data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Recording Acts
✅ 正确答案：B 银行的主张不正确。判决留置权（Judgment Lien）优先于银行的抵押权（Mortgage）。

⚖️ 法律逻辑解析

本题的核心考点在于登记法案（Recording Acts）如何改变普通法下的优先顺位规则。

时间点 1
银行获得抵押权（未登记）
时间点 2 (一周后)
金融公司备案判决（Judgment Filed）
⚠️ 此时不知悉银行抵押权
时间点 3 (再两周后)
银行登记抵押权（Recorded）
关键法规解读：
题目中给出的法规明确规定：
"Unless the same be recorded... no mortgage... shall be good against... judgment creditors without notice."

（除非依法登记，否则抵押权不得对抗不知情的判决债权人。）

虽然普通法遵循“时间在先，权利在先”（First in time, first in right）的原则，但登记法案旨在保护特定的后续利益相关者。

在此案中：

  1. 金融公司是判决债权人（Judgment Creditor）。
  2. 金融公司在备案判决时对银行的抵押权不知情（Without Notice）。
  3. 银行未在金融公司备案前进行登记。

因此，根据该司法管辖区的特定法规，未登记的抵押权对金融公司无效（即金融公司享有优先权）。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A (无效抵押) 错误：
本票中规定商人不承担个人责任（Non-recourse loan），这并不影响抵押权的有效性。抵押权是对物的权利，即使债权人不能追索借款人的个人资产，抵押权依然有效。
选项 C (时间优先) 错误：
这是普通法规则。但在有登记法案（Recording Act）的情况下，如果后续权利人满足法案保护的条件（如本题中的不知情判决债权人），普通法规则会被覆盖。
选项 D (追溯效力) 错误：
抵押权的登记日期就是登记当天，通常不会“追溯”（Relate back）到签署日期来对抗中间出现的善意第三人。
🎓 MBE 备考贴士

仔细阅读法规文本！

通常情况下，许多州的登记法案不保护判决债权人（因为他们没有支付对价，不是“Purchaser for value”）。

但是，本题明确给出了保护“judgment creditors”的法规条文。在MBE中，如果题目给出了具体的法规文本，必须严格依据该文本进行推理，而不是仅仅依赖记忆中的通用规则。

© MBE Property Law Study Guide

questions.question:
A landowner needed money. His land was fairly worth $100,000, so the landowner tried to borrow $60,000 from a lender on the security of the land. The lender agreed, but only if the landowner would convey the land to the lender outright by warranty deed, with the lender agreeing orally to reconvey to the owner once the loan was paid according to its terms. The landowner agreed, conveyed the land to the lender by warranty deed, and received $60,000 cash from the lender. The lender promptly and properly recorded the landowner's deed.
Now, the landowner has defaulted on repayment with $55,000 still due on the loan. The landowner is still in possession.
Which of the following best states the parties' rights in the land?

choices.a: The attempted security arrangement is null as an unknown creature to the law, so the lender has only a personal right to $55,000 from the landowner.
choices.b: The landowner, having defaulted, has no further rights in the land, so the lender may obtain summary eviction.
choices.c: The lender may bring whatever foreclosure proceeding is appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction.
choices.d: The lender's oral agreement to reconvey is invalid under the statute of frauds, so the lender owns the land outright.

data.questionStem:
Q86013

A landowner needed money. His land was fairly worth $100,000, so the landowner tried to borrow $60,000 from a lender on the security of the land. The lender agreed, but only if the landowner would convey the land to the lender outright by warranty deed, with the lender agreeing orally to reconvey to the owner once the loan was paid according to its terms. The landowner agreed, conveyed the land to the lender by warranty deed, and received $60,000 cash from the lender. The lender promptly and properly recorded the landowner's deed.

Now, the landowner has defaulted on repayment with $55,000 still due on the loan. The landowner is still in possession.

Which of the following best states the parties' rights in the land?

一位土地所有者需要钱。他的土地公允价值为100,000美元，因此该土地所有者试图以土地作担保，向一位贷款人借款60,000美元。贷款人同意了，但条件是土地所有者必须通过附带担保的契据（warranty deed）将土地完全转让给贷款人，同时贷款人口头同意，一旦贷款按其条款偿还完毕，便将土地重新转让给所有者。土地所有者同意了，通过附带担保的契据将土地转让给贷款人，并从贷款人处收到了60,000美元现金。贷款人及时并适当地登记了土地所有者的契据。

现在，土地所有者拖欠还款，尚有55,000美元贷款未偿还。土地所有者仍占有该土地。

以下哪项最能说明各方在该土地上的权利？
options:
A. The attempted security arrangement is null as an unknown creature to the law, so the lender has only a personal right to $55,000 from the landowner.
该拟议的担保安排因法律上不存在此种形式而无效，因此贷款人仅对土地所有者拥有55,000美元的个人索偿权。

B. The landowner, having defaulted, has no further rights in the land, so the lender may obtain summary eviction.
土地所有者已经违约，因此在该土地上不再拥有任何权利，贷款人可以获得即决驱逐令。

C. The lender may bring whatever foreclosure proceeding is appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction.
贷款人可以根据该司法管辖区的法律，提起任何适当的止赎程序。

D. The lender's oral agreement to reconvey is invalid under the statute of frauds, so the lender owns the land outright.
根据《防止欺诈法》（statute of frauds），贷款人关于重新转让的口头协议无效，因此贷款人完全拥有该土地。
data.explanation:
Mortgage alternatives


Absolute deedDebtor gives deed to creditor with intent to secure loan (ie, equitable mortgage)
Deed of trustDebtor gives deed of trust to third-party trustee as collateral for debt, & creditor can instruct trustee to foreclose upon default
Installment land contractDebtor agrees to buy land through installment payments & gets immediate possession, but seller keeps legal title until paid in full
Sale-leasebackSeller leases property from buyer immediately after sale, & seller's rental payments function as repayments on loan
Equitable vendor's lienSeller finances buyer's purchase with equitable vendor's lien when seller transfers title to buyer but purchase price not fully paid
A mortgage is a lien against real property that is given to secure a debt and is often memorialized in two documents:

  • Mortgage deed - a writing that conveys an interest in the real property to secure the debt
  • Promissory note - a formal "IOU" in which the borrower promises to repay the debt according to the listed terms (eg, interest rate, payment schedule, acceleration clause)


But an equitable mortgage can be established by an absolute deed (or other alternative means) that was intended to secure a debt. As a result, the deed recipient (like any other lender) may bring a foreclosure action if the debtor defaults on repaying the loan.

Here, the landowner conveyed his land to the lender outright by warranty deed. And since the lender agreed to reconvey the land once the loan was paid, the deed was intended to secure the landowner's debt. As a result, the deed will be treated as an equitable mortgage (ie, an absolute deed) (Choice A). This means that the lender can bring an appropriate foreclosure proceeding to recover the $55,000 still due on the loan.

(Choice B) A summary eviction is a legal procedure that allows a landlord to quickly remove a tenant from leased property without the formalities of a full trial. But it does not allow a lender (mortgagee) to remove a borrower (mortgagor) from mortgaged land.

(Choice D) A mortgage is subject to the statute of frauds, so it must be in writing, signed by the parties against whom it is to be enforced, and contain all essential terms. Therefore, the lender's oral agreement to reconvey the land is invalid under this statute. But the written warranty deed is valid under the statute, and extrinsic evidence (eg, the oral agreement) can be used to show the parties' intent to create a mortgage.

Educational objective:
A mortgage is typically evidenced by a mortgage deed and a promissory note. But an equitable mortgage can also be created when an absolute deed is made with the intent that it secure a debt.

选项正确率统计：A选项 8%，B选项 17%，C选项 53%（正确选项），D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押替代方案


绝对契据债务人将契据交给债权人，意图担保贷款（即衡平法上的抵押）
信托契据债务人将信托契据交给第三方受托人作为债务的抵押品，债权人可在债务人违约时指示受托人进行止赎
土地分期付款合同债务人同意通过分期付款购买土地并立即占有，但卖方保留法定所有权，直到款项全部付清
售后回租卖方在出售后立即从买方处租回该房产，卖方的租金支付相当于偿还贷款
衡平法上的卖方留置权当卖方将所有权转让给买方但购买价款未完全支付时，卖方通过衡平法上的卖方留置权为买方的购买提供融资
抵押是为担保债务而对不动产设定的留置权，通常通过两份文件来证明：

  • 抵押契据 - 一份为担保债务而转让不动产权益的书面文件
  • 本票 - 一份正式的“欠条”，借款人承诺按照所列条款（如利率、还款计划、加速清偿条款）偿还债务


但是，衡平法上的抵押可以通过意图用以担保债务的绝对契据（或其他替代方式）来设立。因此，契据的受让人（如同任何其他贷款人）可以在债务人拖欠还款时提起止赎诉讼。

在本案中，土地所有者通过附带担保的契据将土地完全转让给了贷款人。由于贷款人同意在贷款偿还后重新转让土地，该契据意在担保土地所有者的债务。因此，该契据将被视为衡平法上的抵押（即绝对契据）（选项 A）。这意味着贷款人可以提起适当的止赎程序，以追回尚欠的55,000美元贷款。

（选项 B）即决驱逐令是一种法律程序，允许房东在没有完整审判程序的情况下，迅速将租客从租赁物业中驱逐出去。但它不允许贷款人（抵押权人）将借款人（抵押人）从抵押土地上驱逐。

（选项 D）抵押受《防止欺诈法》（statute of frauds）的约束，因此必须采用书面形式，由将被强制执行的一方签署，并包含所有基本条款。因此，贷款人关于重新转让土地的口头协议在该法下是无效的。但是，书面的附带担保的契据在该法下是有效的，并且可以使用外部证据（例如口头协议）来证明双方意图设立抵押。

教学目标：
抵押通常由抵押契据和本票来证明。但是，当一份绝对契据的订立意图是担保债务时，也可以创设衡平法上的抵押。

References

Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Mortgages § 3.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (absolute deed as mortgage).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages
📚 核心概念：衡平法抵押 (Equitable Mortgage)

当债务人为了担保债务，将土地的绝对契据 (Absolute Deed) 交付给债权人，而非签署标准的抵押文件时，法院会将此交易视为抵押 (Mortgage)，而非直接的买卖。

1. 交易的实质 (Substance over Form)

虽然表面上土地所有者签署了 Warranty Deed（担保契据，通常用于买卖），但双方的意图非常明确：

  • 存在借贷关系（借 $60k）。
  • 有口头协议：还清贷款后归还土地。
  • 价值差异：土地值 $100k，但只拿了 $60k（这通常暗示是贷款而非低价出售）。
  • 占有权：原土地所有者仍占有土地。
2. 法律后果

因为这在法律上被视为衡平法抵押 (Equitable Mortgage)：

  • 贷款人 (Lender) = 抵押权人 (Mortgagee)。
  • 土地所有者 (Landowner) = 抵押人 (Mortgagor)。

贷款人并不拥有土地的完全所有权 (Fee Simple)，而只是拥有土地的担保权益 (Security Interest)。

正确答案 C 贷款人必须提起止赎程序

既然该交易被视为抵押，当债务人违约时，债权人不能直接没收土地（这会违反 "Cluttering/Clogging the Equity of Redemption" 原则）。债权人必须遵循该司法管辖区的法律，通过正式的止赎 (Foreclosure) 程序来变卖土地并受偿。

⚠️ 常见陷阱与错误选项

❌ 选项 A (Nullity)：
这种安排并非“法律未知的”，相反，它是普通法中非常经典的衡平法原则。

❌ 选项 B (Summary Eviction)：
即决驱逐 (Summary Eviction) 适用于房东驱逐租客。这里是抵押关系，必须走止赎流程。

❌ 选项 D (Statute of Frauds)：
这是最大的干扰项！虽然《防止欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds) 要求土地转让必须书面，但在衡平法抵押案件中，口头证据 (Parol Evidence) 是允许被引入以证明契据的“担保意图”的。否则，允许贷款人利用书面契据侵吞土地将构成不当得利和欺诈。

MBE 备考策略：透过形式看本质。
Absolute Deed + Debt Intent = Mortgage

questions.question:
A carpenter decided to start a business with his friend. In order to fund the business, the carpenter took out a loan from a local bank. The carpenter signed a 30-year promissory note to the bank and secured the note with a mortgage on his cabin, which served as his primary residence. The mortgage included a due-on-sale clause and was promptly recorded by the bank.
After running a successful business together for 10 years, the carpenter wanted to reward his friend for all of his hard work. As a result, the carpenter conveyed the cabin by quitclaim deed as a gift to the friend. When the bank received notice that the cabin had been transferred to the friend, the bank demanded full payment of the remaining mortgage debt. When neither the carpenter nor the friend made the required payment, the bank initiated foreclosure proceedings.
Will the bank likely prevail?

choices.a: No, because a due-on-sale clause can only be enforced when the mortgaged property is sold to another.
choices.b: No, because a due-on-sale clause cannot be enforced against a mortgage on a primary residence.
choices.c: Yes, because the due-on-sale clause made the friend personally liable for the mortgage debt.
choices.d: Yes, because the transfer of the mortgaged property triggered the due-on-sale clause.

一名木匠决定与他的朋友创业。为了给公司提供资金，该木匠从当地一家银行获得了一笔贷款。木匠向银行签署了一份为期30年的本票，并用其作为主要住所的小木屋设定抵押以担保该本票。该抵押合同包含一条“售出即付条款”(due-on-sale clause)，并由银行及时进行了登记。

在共同成功经营了10年后，木匠想奖励他朋友的辛勤工作。因此，木匠通过一份免责契据（quitclaim deed）将小木屋作为礼物转让给了他的朋友。当银行收到小木屋已转让给该朋友的通知时，银行要求全额偿还剩余的抵押贷款债务。当木匠和朋友均未支付所要求的款项时，银行启动了止赎程序。

银行是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because a due-on-sale clause can only be enforced when the mortgaged property is sold to another.
不会，因为“售出即付条款”仅在抵押财产被出售给他人时才能强制执行。

B. No, because a due-on-sale clause cannot be enforced against a mortgage on a primary residence.
不会，因为“售出即付条款”不能对作为主要住所的抵押物强制执行。

C. Yes, because the due-on-sale clause made the friend personally liable for the mortgage debt.
会，因为“售出即付条款”使得该朋友对抵押贷款债务承担个人责任。

D. Yes, because the transfer of the mortgaged property triggered the due-on-sale clause.
会，因为抵押财产的转让触发了“售出即付条款”。
data.explanation:
Common mortgage provisions


Acceleration clauseAllows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults
Due-on-sale clauseAllows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission
Due-on-encumbrance clauseAllows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property
Defeasance clauseRequires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made
Mortgage documents are used to convey a lender (mortgagee) an interest in real property to secure repayment of a debt. These documents may contain a due-on-sale clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor (mortgagor) transfers the mortgaged property without the lender's consent (absent limited exceptions). If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can initiate foreclosure proceedings to recover any remaining debt.

Here, the carpenter gave the bank a mortgage on his residence, the cabin, to secure a loan. The mortgage contained a due-on-sale clause, which was triggered when the carpenter transferred the cabin to the friend by quitclaim deed and allowed the bank to demand full payment of the remaining loan balance. The fact that the cabin was gifted (not sold) has no impact on the bank's ability to enforce this clause (Choice A). And since the carpenter did not make the required payment, the bank will prevail in its foreclosure proceedings.

(Choice B) A due-on-sale clause can be enforced on a primary residence or any other real property used to secure repayment of a debt.

(Choice C) The due-on-sale clause made the carpenter (mortgagor) personally liable on the debt if the mortgaged property was conveyed without the bank's consent. The friend would be personally liable only if he agreed to assume the mortgage debt (not seen here).

Educational objective: A due-on-sale clause allows a lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor transfers the mortgaged property without the lender's permission. Although labeled a "due on sale" clause, the clause is triggered by most transfers - including gifts.

选项正确率统计：A选项 21%，B选项 1%，C选项 2%，D选项 74%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的抵押条款


加速到期条款 (Acceleration clause)如果债务人违约，允许债权人要求全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付
售出即付条款 (Due-on-sale clause)如果债务人未经许可出售抵押财产，允许债权人要求全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付
设立负担即付条款 (Due-on-encumbrance clause)如果债务人获得第二顺位抵押或以其他方式为财产设立负担，允许债权人加速抵押债务的履行
废止条款 (Defeasance clause)要求债权人在所有款项付清后，将财产的法定所有权交予债务人，并解除抵押权
抵押文件用于向贷款人（抵押权人）转让不动产的权益，以担保债务的偿还。这些文件可能包含一条售出即付条款，该条款允许贷款人在债务人（抵押人）未经贷款人同意的情况下转让抵押财产时（除少数例外情况外），要求全额偿付剩余的抵押贷款债务。如果债务人无法偿付，贷款人则可以启动止赎程序以收回任何剩余债务。

在本案中，木匠将其住所，即小木屋，抵押给银行以担保一笔贷款。该抵押合同包含一条“售出即付条款”，当木匠通过免责契据将小木屋转让给朋友时，该条款被触发，并允许银行要求全额偿还剩余的贷款余额。小木屋是赠与（而非出售）这一事实，对银行强制执行该条款的能力没有影响（选项A）。并且，由于木匠未按要求付款，银行将在其止赎程序中胜诉。

（选项B）“售出即付条款”可以对主要住所或任何其他用于担保债务偿还的不动产强制执行。

（选项C）“售出即付条款”规定，如果抵押财产未经银行同意而被转让，木匠（抵押人）需对该债务承担个人责任。只有当朋友同意承担（assume）抵押贷款债务时，他才需承担个人责任（本案中未出现此情况）。

教学目的：“售出即付条款”允许贷款人在债务人未经其许可转让抵押财产时，要求全额偿还剩余的抵押贷款债务。尽管名为“售出即付”条款，但该条款可由大多数转让行为触发——包括赠与。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 415 (2019) (due-on-sale clauses).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

✅ 正确答案：D 银行可能会胜诉。因为抵押财产的转让（即使是赠与）触发了“售出即付条款” (Due-on-sale clause)。
核心法律规则

售出即付条款 (Due-on-sale clause) 是一种允许贷款人在借款人未经同意转让房产权益时，要求立即全额偿还贷款余额的合同条款。

根据美国联邦法律《加恩-圣日耳曼存款机构法案》(Garn-St. Germain Depository Institutions Act of 1982)，此类条款通常是可强制执行的 (Enforceable)，即使州法有相反规定。

案件逻辑流

木匠 (Mortgagor)
⬇️
赠与转让 (Quitclaim Deed)
⬇️
朋友 (Transferee)
⬇️
触发 Due-on-sale 条款
⬇️
银行要求全额还款 (Acceleration)
⬇️
未付款 ➡️ 止赎 (Foreclosure)
为什么选 D？(考点分析)

MBE 经常测试考生对“Sale”（出售）一词的字面理解与法律实际适用范围的区别。

  • 误区： 认为只有“卖钱”才算 Sale。
  • 真相： 该条款针对的是任何权益的转让 (Transfer of interest)。无论是出售、赠与 (Gift) 还是其他形式的产权变更，只要不动产权益发生了转移，通常都会触发该条款。

在本案中，木匠通过免责契据 (Quitclaim Deed) 将房屋赠与朋友，这构成了法律上的转让，因此银行有权加速贷款到期并进行止赎。

🚫 避坑指南 (Distractor Analysis)
  • 选项 A 错误： 赠与 (Gift) 同样属于转让行为，会触发该条款。条款名称虽叫 "Due-on-sale"，但法律效力覆盖大多数 "Transfers"。
  • 选项 B 错误： 该条款完全可以适用于主要住所 (Primary Residence)。联邦法律并未豁免主要住所。
  • 选项 C 错误（高干扰项）： 虽然银行能胜诉，但理由不对。转让本身不会自动让朋友承担个人还款责任 (Personal Liability)。朋友只是“受让了附带抵押的房产” (Subject to the mortgage)，除非他明确签署协议承担债务 (Assumption)，否则银行只能拍卖房子，不能追究朋友的个人财产。
💡 MBE 拿分技巧

遇到 Due-on-sale Clause 的题目，请按以下步骤思考：

  1. 是否有转让？ (本题：有，赠与)。
  2. 是否属于法定豁免？ (如：配偶间转让、离婚、继承、设立信托等)。
    *注：赠与给“朋友”不在豁免之列。
  3. 结论： 如果有转让且非豁免 ➡️ 银行可以强制执行。

questions.question:
A farmer borrowed $100,000 from a bank and gave the bank a promissory note secured by a mortgage on the farm that she owned. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage, which contained an acceleration clause and a due-on-sale provision.
A few years later, the farmer borrowed $5,000 from a second bank and gave that bank a promissory note secured by a mortgage on her farm. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage.
Subsequently, the farmer defaulted on her obligation to the first bank, which then validly accelerated the debt and instituted nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings as permitted by the jurisdiction. The second bank received notice of the foreclosure sale but did not send a representative to the sale. At the foreclosure sale, a buyer who was not acting in collusion with the farmer outbid all other bidders and received a deed to the farm.
Several months later, the original farmer repurchased her farm from the buyer, who executed a warranty deed transferring the farm to her. After the farmer promptly recorded that deed, the second bank commenced foreclosure proceedings on the farm. The farmer denied the validity of the second bank's mortgage.
Does the second bank continue to have a valid mortgage on the farm?

choices.a: No, because of the due-on-sale provision in the farmer's mortgage to the first bank.
choices.b: No, because the purchase at the foreclosure sale by the buyer under these facts eliminated the second bank's junior mortgage lien.
choices.c: Yes, because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.
choices.d: Yes, because the original owner reacquired title to the farm.

Subsequently, the farmer defaulted on her obligation to the first bank, which then validly accelerated the debt and instituted nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings as permitted by the jurisdiction. The second bank received notice of the foreclosure sale but did not send a representative to the sale. At the foreclosure sale, a buyer who was not acting in collusion with the farmer outbid all other bidders and received a deed to the farm.

Several months later, the original farmer repurchased her farm from the buyer, who executed a warranty deed transferring the farm to her. After the farmer promptly recorded that deed, the second bank commenced foreclosure proceedings on the farm. The farmer denied the validity of the second bank's mortgage.

Does the second bank continue to have a valid mortgage on the farm?

一位农场主从一家银行借款10万美元，并向该银行出具了一张以其拥有的农场作抵押担保的本票。该银行立即登记了该抵押权，该抵押合同中包含加速到期条款和到期出售条款。

几年后，该农场主从第二家银行借款5000美元，并向该银行出具了一张以其农场作抵押担保的本票。该银行立即登记了该抵押权。

随后，该农场主对第一家银行的债务违约，第一家银行因此合法地宣布债务加速到期，并启动了该司法管辖区所允许的非司法止赎程序。第二家银行收到了止赎拍卖的通知，但并未派代表参加拍卖。在止赎拍卖中，一位与农场主并无串通的买方出价高于所有其他竞标人，并获得了该农场的地契。

几个月后，原农场主从买方处回购了她的农场，买方签署了一份担保地契将农场转让给她。在农场主立即登记了该地契后，第二家银行启动了对该农场的止赎程序。农场主否认第二家银行抵押权的有效性。

第二家银行是否仍然对该农场拥有有效的抵押权？
options:
A. No, because of the due-on-sale provision in the farmer's mortgage to the first bank.
否，因为农场主向第一家银行设定的抵押合同中存在到期出售条款。

B. No, because the purchase at the foreclosure sale by the buyer under these facts eliminated the second bank's junior mortgage lien.
否，因为在本案事实下，买方在止赎拍卖中的购买行为消除了第二家银行的次级抵押留置权。

C. Yes, because of the doctrine of estoppel by deed.
是，因为禁止反言地契原则(doctrine of estoppel by deed)。

D. Yes, because the original owner reacquired title to the farm.
是，因为原所有者重新获得了该农场的所有权。
data.explanation:
Foreclosure methods


Judicial saleJudicially supervised public sale of mortgaged property (all states)
Nonjudicial salePrivately conducted public sale of mortgaged property (permitted only if mortgage contains power-of-sale clause) (half of all states)
Strict foreclosureForeclosure without sale of mortgaged property (few states)
About half of all states permit nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings - ie, a privately conducted public sale of the mortgaged property (as in this case). The foreclosure sale generally destroys all interests that are junior to the mortgage being foreclosed. As a result, junior interest holders are necessary parties who must be given notice of the foreclosure so that they can participate (or send a representative). Failure to notify a junior interest holder results in the preservation of that party's interest despite the foreclosure sale.

Here, the first bank instituted nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings after the farmer defaulted on her mortgage. The second bank (junior interest holder) received notice of the foreclosure sale but did not participate in or send a representative to the sale. This means that when the buyer purchased the farm in the foreclosure sale, the second bank's junior mortgage lien was eliminated. Accordingly, the second bank does not have a valid mortgage on the farm.

(Choice A) A due-on-sale provision allows the mortgagee to declare the entire loan balance due and payable if the mortgagor sells the property without the mortgagee's permission. This provision is not implicated here because the farmer never sold the farm.

(Choice C) The doctrine of estoppel by deed (ie, after-acquired title) applies when a person conveys unowned property to another by warranty deed. If that person later acquires title to the property, it automatically passes to the grantee. But this doctrine is clearly inapplicable here since the farmer owned the farm when she executed both mortgages.

(Choice D) The fact that the farmer reacquired title to the farm would matter only if the buyer and the farmer had been acting in collusion. In that case, the second bank could claim that the foreclosure sale was a fraud intended to eliminate its interest in the farm.

Educational objective: A foreclosure sale destroys all interests that are junior to the foreclosing mortgage, so the junior interest holders are necessary parties who must be given notice of the foreclosure. Otherwise, their interests are preserved post-sale.

选项正确率统计：A选项 1%，B选项 89%（正确选项），C选项 3%，D选项 5%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

止赎方法


司法拍卖 (Judicial sale)在司法监督下对抵押财产进行的公开拍卖（所有州）
非司法拍卖 (Nonjudicial sale)私下进行的对抵押财产的公开拍卖（仅在抵押合同包含出售权条款时允许）（半数州）
严格止赎 (Strict foreclosure)不通过拍卖抵押财产而进行的止赎（少数州）
大约一半的州允许非司法止赎程序 (nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings)——即私下进行的对抵押财产的公开拍卖（如本案所示）。止赎拍卖通常会消灭所有劣后于被止赎抵押权的权益。因此，次级权益持有人是必要当事人，他们必须收到止赎通知，以便他们能够参与（或派遣代表）。若未能通知次级权益持有人，将导致该方的权益在止赎拍卖后得以保留。

在本案中，在农场主对其抵押贷款违约后，第一家银行启动了非司法止赎程序。第二家银行（次级权益持有人）收到了止赎拍卖的通知，但没有参与也未派代表参加拍卖。这意味着，当买方在止赎拍卖中购买该农场时，第二家银行的次级抵押留置权即被消除。因此，第二家银行对该农场不拥有有效的抵押权。

(选项A) 到期出售条款(due-on-sale provision)允许抵押权人在抵押人未经其许可出售财产时，宣布全部贷款余额到期应付。本案不涉及此条款，因为农场主从未（主动）出售过该农场。

(选项C) 禁止反言地契原则(doctrine of estoppel by deed)（即，事后获得的所有权）适用于一个人通过担保地契将自己不拥有的财产转让给另一个人的情况。如果该转让人之后获得了该财产的所有权，则所有权会自动转移给受让人。但该原则在本案中显然不适用，因为农场主在签署两份抵押合同时拥有该农场。

(选项D) 农场主重新获得农场所有权这一事实，仅在买方和农场主存在串通行为时才具有重要性。在这种情况下，第二家银行可以主张该止赎拍卖是一场旨在消灭其在农场上权益的欺诈。

教学目标：止赎拍卖会消灭所有劣后于被止赎抵押权的权益，因此次级权益持有人是必要当事人，必须收到止赎通知。否则，他们的权益在拍卖后将得以保留。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 592 (2019) (requirement to notify junior lienholders of foreclosure action).

MBE 考点解析

抵押权止赎与次级权益
(Mortgages & Foreclosure)

本题考察的核心是止赎对次级留置权的影响以及原业主回购房产后的法律后果。

核心法则 (General Rule) 止赎拍卖（Foreclosure Sale）会消灭所有次级权益 (Junior Interests)，前提是该次级权益持有人收到了止赎通知。

⚖️ 法律逻辑推演

1 优先顺位确定 (Priority)
第一家银行的抵押权先登记，属于优先抵押权 (Senior Mortgage)。第二家银行的抵押权后登记，属于次级抵押权 (Junior Mortgage)。
2 止赎的效力 (Effect of Foreclosure)
第一家银行因债务违约启动了非司法止赎。关键点在于：第二家银行收到了通知 (Notice)。
  • 一旦止赎拍卖完成，且次级债权人已获通知，该次级抵押权即被消灭 (Extinguished)。
  • 买方 (Buyer) 获得的是“干净”的地契，不再附带第二家银行的抵押权。
3 回购的效力 (Effect of Repurchase)
这是本题最容易混淆的地方。原农场主从买方手中回购了农场。
  • 买方在拍卖中获得了无负担的所有权。
  • 根据庇护原则 (Shelter Principle)，买方可以将这个无负担的所有权转让给任何人，包括原业主。
  • 关键例外排除：如果原业主与买方存在串通 (Collusion) 以欺诈次级债权人，抵押权可能会“复活” (Revive)。但题目明确指出“并无串通” (not acting in collusion)。
⚠️ 常见陷阱解析

为什么选项 D (Revival) 是错的？

有些考生认为原业主买回房产，之前的抵押权就该自动恢复。这被称为 Revival of Junior Liens。

但在 MBE 中，这一原则通常仅适用于原业主通过欺诈或串通手段清洗产权的情况。既然题目排除了串通，买方的“干净产权”就成功传递给了原业主。第二家银行的抵押权已在拍卖时彻底终结。

为什么选项 C (Estoppel by Deed) 是错的？

Estoppel by Deed 适用于：A 把不属于自己的地卖给 B，后来 A 真的拥有了这块地，法律视为 A 当初的转让有效。本案中，农场主抵押时确实拥有该农场，所以此原则不适用。

✅ 正确答案：B
止赎拍卖消灭了次级抵押权，且因无串通行为，原业主回购后该抵押权不会复活。

🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在做抵押权题目时，请按以下顺序检查：

  1. 确定顺位：谁是 Senior，谁是 Junior？（通常看登记时间）。
  2. 检查通知：Junior 是否收到了止赎通知？（没收到则权益保留，收到了则权益消灭）。
  3. 检查欺诈：如果原业主买回房产，是否有“Collusion”或“Fraud”字眼？如果没有，产权通常是干净的。

questions.question:
A man borrowed money from a lender and mortgaged land that he owned to secure repayment of the loan. Before he had completely repaid the loan, the man conveyed the land to an investor, who expressly assumed the loan. The note and mortgage did not contain a due-on-sale clause.
After the investor had made several payments on the loan, she defaulted on two payments. The lender notified the man and the investor of its intention to accelerate the loan pursuant to the terms of the note and mortgage unless the default was cured within 60 days. When neither the man nor the investor made the required payment, the lender accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings, naming both the man and the investor as party defendants. The foreclosure sale resulted in a deficiency. The lender has sought a deficiency judgment against only the man, because the investor has become insolvent in the meantime.
Will the court likely find the man liable for the deficiency?

choices.a: No, because the investor's express assumption of the loan released the man from liability.
choices.b: No, because the lender must first seek to obtain a deficiency judgment against the investor.
choices.c: Yes, because even after the assumption, the man remains liable as a surety of the investor in the absence of a release from the lender.
choices.d: Yes, because the note and mortgage did not contain a due-on-sale clause.

After the investor had made several payments on the loan, she defaulted on two payments. The lender notified the man and the investor of its intention to accelerate the loan pursuant to the terms of the note and mortgage unless the default was cured within 60 days. When neither the man nor the investor made the required payment, the lender accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings, naming both the man and the investor as party defendants. The foreclosure sale resulted in a deficiency. The lender has sought a deficiency judgment against only the man, because the investor has become insolvent in the meantime.

Will the court likely find the man liable for the deficiency? 一名男子向贷款人借款，并抵押了他拥有的土地以担保贷款的偿还。在他完全偿还贷款之前，该男子将土地转让给了一位投资者，该投资者明确承担了该笔贷款。借据和抵押合同中不包含“售出即付”条款。

在投资者偿还了几期贷款后，她拖欠了两期付款。贷款人通知该男子和投资者，其打算根据借据和抵押合同的条款宣布贷款加速到期，除非违约在60天内得到补救。当该男子和投资者均未支付所需款项时，贷款人宣布贷款加速到期并启动了止赎程序，将该男子和投资者均列为被告。止赎拍卖产生了差额。贷款人仅对该男子寻求差额判决，因为投资者在此期间已无力偿债。

法院是否可能认定该男子对该差额负有责任？
options:
A. No, because the investor's express assumption of the loan released the man from liability.
否，因为投资者对贷款的明确承担免除了该男子的责任。

B. No, because the lender must first seek to obtain a deficiency judgment against the investor.
否，因为贷款人必须首先寻求对投资者获得差额判决。

C. Yes, because even after the assumption, the man remains liable as a surety of the investor in the absence of a release from the lender.
是，因为即使在承担之后，在没有贷款人免除责任的情况下，该男子仍然作为投资者的保证人承担责任。

D. Yes, because the note and mortgage did not contain a due-on-sale clause.
是，因为借据和抵押合同中不包含“售出即付”条款。
data.explanation:
A mortgage is an interest in real property given to a lender (mortgagee) to secure a debt. The debtor (mortgagor) can freely transfer mortgaged property to a grantee unless the mortgage states otherwise. After the transfer, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the debtor remains personally liable for the mortgage debt. But the grantee will become liable for the debt only if the grantee expressly agrees to assume the mortgage.

Assumption of a mortgage makes the grantee primarily liable for the debt and the debtor secondarily liable as a surety in the absence of a release from the lender (Choice A). This means a lender can sue the grantee, the debtor, or both for any deficiency resulting from a foreclosure sale (Choice B). If the debtor pays any amount of the deficiency, the debtor can seek reimbursement from the grantee.

(Choice D) A due-on-sale clause allows a lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor sells the mortgaged property without the lender's permission. However, this type of clause (or the absence thereof) does not affect the debtor's liability to the lender for a deficiency judgment after a foreclosure sale.

Educational objective: A grantee who assumes a mortgage is primarily responsible for a deficiency from a foreclosure sale, and the debtor is secondarily liable as a surety in the absence of a release from the lender. The lender can sue the grantee, the debtor, or both to recover the deficiency amount, and the debtor can seek reimbursement from the grantee.

抵押是在不动产上为担保债务而给予贷款人（抵押权人）的一种权益。债务人（抵押人）可以自由地转让已抵押的财产给受让人，除非抵押合同另有规定。转让后，抵押权仍然附着于该财产，并且债务人仍然对抵押债务承担个人责任。但受让人只有在明确同意承担抵押债务的情况下，才会对该债务承担责任。

承担抵押使得受让人对债务承担主要责任，而在没有贷款人免除责任的情况下，债务人作为保证人承担次要责任（选项A）。这意味着贷款人可以就止赎拍卖产生的任何差额起诉受让人、债务人或两者（选项B）。如果债务人支付了任何差额款项，债务人可以向受让人寻求补偿。

(选项D) “售出即付”条款允许贷款人在债务人未经其许可出售已抵押财产时，要求全额支付剩余的抵押债务。然而，这类条款（或其缺失）不影响债务人在止赎拍卖后对贷款人承担差额判决的责任。

教学目标： 承担抵押的受让人对止赎拍卖产生的差额负有主要责任，而在没有贷款人免除责任的情况下，债务人作为保证人负有次要责任。贷款人可以起诉受让人、债务人或两者以追回差额，而债务人可以向受让人寻求补偿。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：抵押承担与差额责任

正确答案：C

是的，因为即使在受让人承担（Assume）抵押贷款后，原债务人（The Man）在没有获得贷款人豁免的情况下，仍作为投资者的保证人（Surety）承担责任。

核心法律规则解析

本题考察的是不动产法中关于抵押转让（Transfer of Mortgage）的核心规则，特别是当受让人“承担”债务时，原债务人的责任状态。

1. 承担抵押 (Assumption of Mortgage)

当买方（受让人）明确同意承担（Assume）抵押贷款时：

  • 买方（Investor）： 成为该债务的主要责任人 (Primarily Liable)。
  • 卖方（Original Mortgagor）： 变为次要责任人 (Secondarily Liable)，即充当保证人 (Surety) 的角色。
2. 保证人责任 (Suretyship Liability)

除非贷款人（Lender）签署了债务更替/更新（Novation）协议明确释放原债务人，否则原债务人永远不会自动免除责任。

这意味着：如果主要责任人（买方）违约且无法偿还，贷款人完全有权向原债务人追偿差额（Deficiency）。

责任关系图解

投资者 (Investor)
主要责任 (Primary)
⬆️ 承担债务 (Assumed)
原债务人 (The Man)
次要责任/保证人 (Surety)
⬆️ 原始借据 (Note)
贷款人 (Lender)
有权起诉上述任一方

为什么其他选项是错误的？

  • 选项 A 错误： Assumption（承担）本身并不构成 Release（免除）。只有贷款人明确签署 Release 或 Novation 才能免除原债务人的责任。
  • 选项 B 错误： 虽然投资者负主要责任，但这只是投资者和原债务人之间的内部关系。对贷款人而言，他可以选择起诉任何一方或双方。贷款人不需要先耗尽对投资者的法律程序才能起诉原债务人（尽管在公平原则下通常先找主要责任人，但在法律上原债务人仍有连带责任）。
  • 选项 D 错误： Due-on-sale clause（售出即付条款）的存在与否，只决定贷款人能否在转让时立即要求还清全款。它不影响止赎后谁对差额判决（Deficiency Judgment）负责的问题。

MBE 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在处理抵押转让题目时，请寻找以下关键词：

  1. "Assumed the mortgage"（承担抵押）：
    买方主要责任，卖方次要责任（保证人）。
  2. "Took subject to the mortgage"（承受/附带抵押）：
    买方无个人责任（Personal Liability），卖方仍负唯一责任。如果止赎后有差额，贷款人只能找卖方，不能找买方。
  3. "Novation" / "Release"（债务更替/免除）：
    只有看到这些词，卖方才彻底脱身。
Reference: Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.1

questions.question:
A seller conveyed residential land to a buyer by a warranty deed that contained no exceptions and recited that the full consideration had been paid. To finance the purchase, the buyer borrowed 80% of the necessary funds from a bank. The seller agreed to finance 15% of the purchase price, and the buyer agreed to provide cash for the remaining 5%.
At the closing, the buyer signed a promissory note to the seller for 15% of the purchase price but did not execute a mortgage. The bank knew of the loan made by the seller and of the promissory note executed by the buyer to the seller. The buyer also signed a note to the bank, secured by a mortgage, for the 80% advanced by the bank.
The buyer has now defaulted on both loans. There are no applicable statutes.
Which loan has priority?

choices.a: The bank's loan, because it was secured by a purchase-money mortgage.
choices.b: The bank's loan, because the seller can finance a part of the purchase price only by use of an installment land contract.
choices.c: The seller's loan, because a promissory note to a seller has priority over a bank loan for residential property.
choices.d: The seller's loan, because the bank knew that the seller had an equitable vendor's lien.

data.questionStem:
Q86032

A seller conveyed residential land to a buyer by a warranty deed that contained no exceptions and recited that the full consideration had been paid. To finance the purchase, the buyer borrowed 80% of the necessary funds from a bank. The seller agreed to finance 15% of the purchase price, and the buyer agreed to provide cash for the remaining 5%.

At the closing, the buyer signed a promissory note to the seller for 15% of the purchase price but did not execute a mortgage. The bank knew of the loan made by the seller and of the promissory note executed by the buyer to the seller. The buyer also signed a note to the bank, secured by a mortgage, for the 80% advanced by the bank.

The buyer has now defaulted on both loans. There are no applicable statutes.

Which loan has priority?

一名卖方通过一份不含任何例外条款且声明全部对价已付清的担保契约，将一块住宅用地转让给一名买方。为给此次购买提供资金，买方从一家银行借了所需资金的80%。卖方同意为购买价格的15%提供融资，买方同意为剩余的5%提供现金。

在交割时，买方向卖方签署了一张金额为购买价格15%的本票，但并未签署抵押协议。银行知晓卖方提供的贷款以及买方为卖方签署的本票。买方还为银行预付的80%资金签署了一份由抵押担保的票据。

买方现在两笔贷款均已违约。本案没有适用的成文法。

哪笔贷款具有优先权？
options:
A. The bank's loan, because it was secured by a purchase-money mortgage.
银行的贷款，因为它由购买价款抵押权担保。

B. The bank's loan, because the seller can finance a part of the purchase price only by use of an installment land contract.
银行的贷款，因为卖方只能通过使用分期付款土地合同来为部分购买价格提供融资。

C. The seller's loan, because a promissory note to a seller has priority over a bank loan for residential property.
卖方的贷款，因为就住宅物业而言，向卖方出具的本票优先于银行贷款。

D. The seller's loan, because the bank knew that the seller had an equitable vendor's lien.
卖方的贷款，因为银行知晓卖方拥有衡平法上的卖方留置权。
data.explanation:
The seller received a promissory note - ie, a legal document that creates or memorializes a debt - but no lien or mortgage to secure the debt. But when a seller transfers title to a buyer and any portion of the purchase price remains unpaid, an equitable vendor's lien may be implied by law. Therefore, the seller may have an equitable vendor's lien, but the deed recites that the full consideration was paid.

The bank received a promissory note secured by a mortgage - ie, a lien against real property given to secure a debt. Since the mortgage was given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property, it is a purchase-money mortgage (PMM). PMMs have super priority over all prior liens regardless of whether the PMM or those liens are recorded. Therefore, the bank's loan has priority - regardless of whether it knew of the seller's lien (Choices C & D).

(Choice B) A seller can finance the purchase of land through several means - including a PMM, equitable vendor's lien, and installment land contract. An installment land contract is an agreement where the debtor promises to make regular installment payments until the full contract price is paid (not seen here).

Educational objective: An equitable vendor's lien is implied by law when a seller transfers title to a buyer and any portion of the purchase price remains unpaid. In contrast, a purchase-money mortgage is created when a mortgage is given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property, thereby giving it super priority over all other mortgages and liens.



选项正确率统计：A选项 78%（正确选项），B选项 1%，C选项 11%，D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

卖方收到了一张本票——即一份创设或记录债务的法律文件——但没有留置权或抵押权来担保该债务。但是，当卖方将所有权转移给买方且购买价款的任何部分未付清时，法律可以默示创设一项 equitable vendor's lien（衡平法上的卖方留置权）。因此，卖方可能拥有衡平法上的卖方留置权，但契约中声明全部对价已付清。

银行收到了一张由抵押担保的本票——即为担保债务而设定的针对不动产的留置权。由于该抵押是为了担保被抵押财产的购买价款而设定的，因此它是一种 purchase-money mortgage (PMM)。PMMs 具有绝对优先权，优先于所有在先的留置权，无论该PMM或那些留置权是否已登记。因此，银行的贷款具有优先权——无论其是否知晓卖方的留置权（选项C和D）。

（选项B）卖方可以通过多种方式为土地购买提供融资——包括 PMM、equitable vendor's lien 和 installment land contract。分期付款土地合同是一种协议，债务人承诺定期分期付款，直至全部合同价款付清为止（本案中未出现）。

教学目的：当卖方将所有权转移给买方且购买价款的任何部分未付清时，法律默示创设一项 equitable vendor's lien。相比之下，当为担保被抵押财产的购买价款而设定抵押时，便创设了 purchase-money mortgage，从而使其具有优先于所有其他抵押和留置权的绝对优先权。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (priority of purchase-money mortgages)

MBE 考点解析
Mortgages Priority

正确答案：选项 A

银行的贷款具有优先权，因为它是购买价款抵押权 (Purchase-Money Mortgage, PMM)。

核心考点：PMM 的超级优先权

Purchase-Money Mortgage (PMM) 是指为了担保购买不动产的资金而设立的抵押权。

在房地产法律中，PMM 享有“超级优先权” (Super Priority)，即它通常优先于该财产上的其他先前留置权或判决留置权。

本案逻辑推演：

1. 银行的地位 (The Bank):
银行借出资金用于购买房产，并获得了买方签署的抵押协议 (Mortgage)。因此，银行持有的是一个合法的 Purchase-Money Mortgage。

2. 卖方的地位 (The Seller):
卖方虽然也提供了部分融资，但没有签署抵押协议。卖方仅持有买方的本票 (Promissory Note)。
虽然法律可能赋予卖方一种默示的 Equitable Vendor's Lien（衡平法上的卖方留置权），但这是一种基于衡平法的、未登记的利益。

3. 优先权之争 (Priority Battle):
这是一场“有担保的抵押权” vs. “无担保权益/衡平法留置权”的较量。
银行拥有合法的 PMM。根据物权法规则，合法的 PMM 优先于卖方未登记的、隐蔽的衡平法留置权。即使银行知晓卖方的贷款，银行通过设立正式抵押权确立了其物权优先性，而卖方未能通过设立抵押权来保护自己。

为什么排除其他选项？
  • 选项 B 错误：卖方完全可以通过 PMM 来融资，并非只能使用分期付款土地合同 (Installment Land Contract)。
  • 选项 C 错误：并没有法律规则规定“针对住宅的卖方本票”自动优先于银行贷款。优先权通常取决于担保物权的类型和登记顺序。
  • 选项 D 错误：虽然银行知情 (Notice)，但在本案中，银行持有的是法律上的物权 (Legal Interest)，而卖方仅有衡平法上的利益 (Equitable Interest)。且契约中声明“全款已付”，这削弱了卖方对第三方的对抗力。更重要的是，PMM 的性质使其优先于一般的衡平法留置权。
💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理抵押权优先权问题时，请遵循以下层级：

  1. PMM (Purchase-Money Mortgage) 通常是王者，优先于其他留置权。
  2. 如果是 Seller PMM vs. Bank PMM（即卖方和银行都拿了抵押权），通常 Seller PMM 优先。
  3. 但在本题中，卖方没有拿抵押权 (No Mortgage)！这是陷阱。没有抵押权的债权人（Unsecured Creditor）几乎总是输给有抵押权的债权人（Secured Creditor）。
Subject: Real Property / Mortgages
Source: NCBE (2013)

questions.question:
A man borrowed $150,000 from a bank to remodel his home and executed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan over a 10-year period. The loan was secured by a mortgage on the home. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage, which was the only lien on the home at that time. Several months later, the man borrowed $40,000 from his mother in order to purchase a new truck and gave his mother a mortgage on the home to secure repayment of the debt. The mother promptly recorded the mortgage.
The man later lost his job and was struggling to make loan payments to both the bank and his mother. To accommodate the man's financial situation, the bank extended the amortization period of its loan to substantially reduce the amount of each monthly payment. The bank did not alter the interest rate or increase the principal amount of the loan. At the time of the modification of the bank loan, the man was not in default in his payments to his mother. Neither the bank nor the man informed the mother of the modification of the bank loan.
After the man later missed five payments to his mother, she commenced a foreclosure action. While the action was pending, the mother learned of the bank's loan modification. The mother asserted that her mortgage had become a first lien on the home and that the bank's mortgage had become a second lien.
Is the mother's assertion correct?

choices.a: No, because the bank's loan modification was not detrimental to the rights of the mother.
choices.b: No, because the man was not in default in his payments to his mother at the time of the bank's loan modification.
choices.c: Yes, because the bank's loan modification was made without the mother's prior consent.
choices.d: Yes, because the bank's loan modification was material.

data.questionStem:
Q86804 A man borrowed $150,000 from a bank to remodel his home and executed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan over a 10-year period. The loan was secured by a mortgage on the home. The bank promptly recorded the mortgage, which was the only lien on the home at that time. Several months later, the man borrowed $40,000 from his mother in order to purchase a new truck and gave his mother a mortgage on the home to secure repayment of the debt. The mother promptly recorded the mortgage.

The man later lost his job and was struggling to make loan payments to both the bank and his mother. To accommodate the man's financial situation, the bank extended the amortization period of its loan to substantially reduce the amount of each monthly payment. The bank did not alter the interest rate or increase the principal amount of the loan. At the time of the modification of the bank loan, the man was not in default in his payments to his mother. Neither the bank nor the man informed the mother of the modification of the bank loan.

After the man later missed five payments to his mother, she commenced a foreclosure action. While the action was pending, the mother learned of the bank's loan modification. The mother asserted that her mortgage had become a first lien on the home and that the bank's mortgage had become a second lien.

Is the mother's assertion correct? 一名男子为装修房屋从银行贷款15万美元，并签署了一份本票，同意在10年内偿还贷款。该贷款以其房屋的抵押权作为担保。银行及时登记了该抵押权，当时这是该房屋上唯一的留置权。几个月后，该男子为了购买一辆新卡车向其母亲借款4万美元，并以其房屋的抵押权作为该债务偿还的担保。母亲及时登记了该抵押权。

后来，该男子失业，难以向银行和母亲偿还贷款。为了迁就该男子的财务状况，银行延长了其贷款的摊销期，以大幅减少每月的还款额。银行没有改变贷款的利率，也没有增加贷款的本金金额。在银行贷款变更时，该男子并未拖欠对其母亲的还款。银行和该男子均未将银行贷款变更一事告知其母亲。

之后，在该男子拖欠了五期对其母亲的还款后，她提起了止赎诉讼。在诉讼进行期间，母亲得知了银行的贷款变更。母亲主张她的抵押权已成为该房屋的第一顺位留置权，而银行的抵押权已成为第二顺位留置权。

母亲的主张是否正确？
options:
A. No, because the bank's loan modification was not detrimental to the rights of the mother.
否，因为银行的贷款变更并未损害母亲的权利。

B. No, because the man was not in default in his payments to his mother at the time of the bank's loan modification.
否，因为在银行贷款变更时，该男子并未拖欠对其母亲的还款。

C. Yes, because the bank's loan modification was made without the mother's prior consent.
是，因为银行的贷款变更未经母亲事先同意。

D. Yes, because the bank's loan modification was material.
是，因为银行的贷款变更具有实质性。
data.explanation:
When a senior mortgage (ie, first in time) is modified by the parties, it will retain its priority against junior interests so long as the modification does not materially prejudice the holders of the junior interests. There is a strong presumption that a time extension on repayment is not materially prejudicial because the debtor is less likely to default on the senior mortgage and force a foreclosure.

Here, the bank's mortgage was recorded first, so it is senior to the mother's mortgage. The bank later modified the mortgage by extending the amortization period of its loan. But since it is presumed that this time extension did not materially prejudice the mother's junior interest, the bank's mortgage retained its senior priority. As a result, the mother's assertion that her mortgage had become a first lien on the home is incorrect.

(Choice B) Whether the man was in default on the mother's loan at the time of the modification is irrelevant. The default would merely give the mother the right to foreclose on her junior mortgage, but the foreclosure would not extinguish the bank's senior mortgage.

(Choice C) A junior interest holder's consent is not needed to modify a senior mortgage.

Educational objective: A modified senior mortgage will retain its priority against junior interests so long as the modification does not materially prejudice the junior interest holders. It is strongly presumed that a time extension is not materially prejudicial.



当顺位在先的抵押权（即，时间上在先的）由当事人变更时，只要该变更不会对顺位在后的权益持有人造成实质性损害，该抵押权将保留其相对于顺位在后权益的优先权。有一个强有力的推定，即延长还款期限不具有实质性损害，因为债务人因此不太可能对顺位在先的抵押权违约并迫使进行止赎。

在本案中，银行的抵押权首先登记，因此其顺位优先于母亲的抵押权。银行后来通过延长其贷款的摊销期来变更抵押权。但由于推定此延期并未对母亲的顺位在后权益造成实质性损害，银行的抵押权保留了其优先顺位。因此，母亲关于其抵押权已成为房屋第一顺位留置权的主张是不正确的。

(选项B) 该男子在贷款变更时是否拖欠母亲的贷款是无关紧要的。违约只会赋予母亲对其顺位在后的抵押权行使止赎的权利，但该止赎不会消灭银行的顺位在先的抵押权。

(选项C) 变更顺位在先的抵押权无需顺位在后的权益持有人的同意。

教学目标： 只要变更不会对顺位在后的权益持有人造成实质性损害，变更后的顺位在先的抵押权将保留其相对于顺位在后权益的优先权。有一个强有力的推定，即延长还款期限不具有实质性损害。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.3(b) (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (effect of modifying senior mortgages on junior interests).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages & Priority
正确答案：A

否，因为银行的贷款变更并未损害母亲的权利。
(No, because the bank's loan modification was not detrimental to the rights of the mother.)

核心考点：高级抵押权的变更

在不动产法中，抵押权的优先顺位通常遵循“时间在先，权利在先” (First in Time, First in Right) 的原则。

当顺位在先的抵押权人 (Senior Mortgagee) 与债务人修改贷款条款时，其优先权是否受影响取决于该变更是否对顺位在后的抵押权人 (Junior Mortgagee) 造成了实质性损害 (Material Prejudice)。

  • 无损害 (No Prejudice)： 顺位在先的抵押权完全保留其优先地位。
  • 有损害 (Prejudice)： 仅在变更导致债务增加的部分，顺位在先的抵押权可能会丧失相对于后顺位抵押权的优先权（即从属化）。
本题案情分析

1. 变更的内容：
银行（第一顺位）延长了还款期限 (Extended amortization period)，从而降低了每月的还款额。利率和本金均未增加。

2. 是否造成实质性损害？
没有。 延长还款期限通常被视为对后顺位抵押权人有利。因为每月的还款压力减小，债务人违约并导致第一顺位抵押权止赎 (Foreclosure) 的风险降低了。

3. 结论：
由于变更没有损害母亲（第二顺位）的利益，银行的抵押权依然完整地保留其第一顺位优先权。母亲关于其抵押权升为第一顺位的主张是错误的。

为什么其他选项错误？
  • 选项 B (违约状态)： 债务人是否对母亲违约与银行抵押权的优先顺位无关。
  • 选项 C (同意权)： 修改高级抵押权不需要征得低级抵押权人的同意 (Consent)。只要不损害低级权益，高级权益人可以自由变更条款。
  • 选项 D (实质性变更)： 仅仅是“实质性” (Material) 变更不足以改变优先顺位，必须是“实质性损害” (Materially Prejudicial)。
MBE 备考锦囊

在遇到 Mortgage Modification 题目时，请记住以下判断标准：

  • 🚫 损害后顺位权益的情况： 增加本金 (Increasing Principal)、提高利率 (Increasing Interest Rate)。
    后果：增加的部分失去优先权。
  • ✅ 不损害后顺位权益的情况： 延长还款期限 (Extending Time)、仅仅改变付款日期。
    后果：完全保留优先权。
Reference: Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.3

questions.question:
A landowner mortgaged her land to a nationally chartered bank as security for a loan. The mortgage provided that the bank could, at its option, declare the entire loan due and payable if all or any part of the land, or an interest therein, was sold or transferred without the bank's prior written consent.
Subsequently, the landowner wanted to sell the land to a neighbor by an installment land contract, but the bank refused to consent. The neighbor's credit was good, and all mortgage payments to the bank were fully current.
The landowner and the neighbor consulted an attorney about their proposed transaction, their desire to complete it, and the bank's refusal to consent.
What would the attorney's best advice be?

choices.a: By making the transfer in land contract form, the landowner will prevent enforcement of the due-on-sale clause if the mortgage payments are kept current.
choices.b: Even if the landowner transfers to the neighbor by land contract, the bank may accelerate the debt and foreclose if the full amount is not paid.
choices.c: The due-on-sale clause is void as an illegal restraint on alienation of the fee simple, so they may proceed.
choices.d: The only effect of the due-on-sale clause is that the proposed transfer will automatically make the neighbor personally liable on the debt, whether or not the neighbor specifically agrees to assume it.

data.questionStem:
Q86007

A landowner mortgaged her land to a nationally chartered bank as security for a loan. The mortgage provided that the bank could, at its option, declare the entire loan due and payable if all or any part of the land, or an interest therein, was sold or transferred without the bank's prior written consent.

Subsequently, the landowner wanted to sell the land to a neighbor by an installment land contract, but the bank refused to consent. The neighbor's credit was good, and all mortgage payments to the bank were fully current.

The landowner and the neighbor consulted an attorney about their proposed transaction, their desire to complete it, and the bank's refusal to consent.

What would the attorney's best advice be?

一位土地所有者将其土地抵押给一家全国性特许银行，作为一笔贷款的担保。该抵押合同规定，如果土地所有者未经银行事先书面同意，出售或转让全部或部分土地或其中任何权益，银行可选择宣布全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付。

之后，该土地所有者希望通过分期付款土地合同将土地出售给一位邻居，但银行拒绝同意。该邻居的信用良好，且所有向银行支付的抵押贷款均已按时足额偿付。

土地所有者和邻居就他们提议的交易、完成交易的意愿以及银行拒绝同意一事咨询了一位律师。

律师的最佳建议会是什么？
options:
A. By making the transfer in land contract form, the landowner will prevent enforcement of the due-on-sale clause if the mortgage payments are kept current.
通过以土地合同的形式进行转让，如果抵押贷款能保持按时偿付，土地所有者将能阻止“出售即到期”条款的执行。

B. Even if the landowner transfers to the neighbor by land contract, the bank may accelerate the debt and foreclose if the full amount is not paid.
即使土地所有者通过土地合同将土地转让给邻居，如果全额贷款未被偿付，银行仍可要求加速清偿债务并进行止赎。

C. The due-on-sale clause is void as an illegal restraint on alienation of the fee simple, so they may proceed.
“出售即到期”条款因构成对 fee simple 土地所有权的非法转让限制而无效，因此他们可以继续交易。

D. The only effect of the due-on-sale clause is that the proposed transfer will automatically make the neighbor personally liable on the debt, whether or not the neighbor specifically agrees to assume it.
“出售即到期”条款的唯一后果是，提议的转让将自动使邻居对该债务承担个人责任，无论邻居是否明确同意承担该债务。
data.explanation:
Common mortgage provisions


Acceleration clauseAllows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults
Due-on-sale clauseAllows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission
Due-on-encumbrance clauseAllows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property
Defeasance clauseRequires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made
Mortgage documents are used to convey a lender an interest in real property to secure debt. These documents may contain a due-on-sale clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor transfers the mortgaged property without the lender's consent. If the debtor is unable to pay, the lender can bring a foreclosure action to force the sale of the property to satisfy any remaining debt.

Here, the landowner seeks to transfer the mortgaged property to the neighbor through an installment land contract without the bank's consent. However, the method used to transfer the mortgaged property has no effect on the enforceability of a due-on-sale clause - even if mortgage payments are kept current (Choice A). The attorney should therefore advise the parties that the bank may accelerate the debt and foreclose if the full amount is not paid.

(Choice C) Due-on-sale clauses are restraints on alienation because they restrict a debtor's ability to transfer the mortgaged property. However, these restraints are considered reasonable and can be challenged only if the lender engaged in unconscionable conduct when exercising the clause.

(Choice D) Under the due-on-sale clause, the unauthorized transfer will make the landowner personally liable on the debt, but it would make the neighbor liable only if he specifically agreed to assume it.

Educational objective: A due-on-sale clause allows a lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt if the debtor transfers the mortgaged property without permission. If the debtor is unable to pay, the lender may bring a foreclosure action to force the sale of the property to satisfy any remaining debt.

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 80%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的抵押条款


加速清偿条款 (Acceleration clause)允许债权人在债务人违约时要求全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付
出售即到期条款 (Due-on-sale clause)允许债权人在债务人未经许可出售抵押财产时要求全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付
设定负担即到期条款 (Due-on-encumbrance clause)允许债权人在债务人获得第二抵押或以其他方式为财产设定负担时加速抵押债务的清偿
权利废止条款 (Defeasance clause)要求债权人在所有款项付清后，将财产的法定所有权交还给债务人并解除抵押权
抵押文件用于向贷款人转让不动产的权益以担保债务。这些文件可能包含出售即到期条款 (due-on-sale clause)，该条款允许贷款人在债务人未经贷款人同意而转让抵押财产时，要求全额偿付剩余的抵押贷款债务。如果债务人无法偿付，贷款人可以提起止赎诉讼 (foreclosure action)，强制出售该财产以清偿任何剩余债务。

在本案中，土地所有者试图未经银行同意，通过分期付款土地合同将抵押财产转让给邻居。但是，转让抵押财产所使用的方法对“出售即到期”条款的可执行性没有影响——即使抵押贷款保持按时偿付也是如此（选项A）。因此，律师应告知当事人，如果全额贷款未被偿付，银行可以要求加速清偿债务并进行止赎。

（选项C）“出售即到期”条款是对转让的限制 (restraints on alienation)，因为它们限制了债务人转让抵押财产的能力。然而，这些限制被认为是合理的，只有在贷款人行使该条款时存在不合情理的行为时，才可以对其提出异议。

（选项D）根据“出售即到期”条款，未经授权的转让将使土地所有者对债务承担个人责任，但仅当邻居明确同意承担该债务时，邻居才需承担责任。

教学目标：“出售即到期”条款允许贷款人在债务人未经许可转让抵押财产时，要求全额偿付剩余的抵押贷款债务。如果债务人无法偿付，贷款人可以提起止赎诉讼，强制出售该财产以清偿任何剩余债务。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 415 (2019) (due-on-sale clauses).

Rustic Hills Shopping Plaza, Inc. v. Columbia Sav. & Loan Ass'n, 661 P.2d 254, 256 - 57 (Colo. 1983) (holding that the unauthorized transfer of mortgaged property by an installment land contract triggered the due-on-sale clause).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

✅ 最佳建议 (选项 B) 律师应告知客户：即使通过分期付款土地合同（Installment Land Contract）进行转让，银行仍有权依据“出售即到期”条款（Due-on-Sale Clause）要求立即全额还款，否则可进行止赎（Foreclosure）。
1. 什么是“出售即到期”条款？

Due-on-Sale Clause 是抵押贷款合同中的常见条款。它规定如果借款人在未经贷款人（银行）同意的情况下出售或转让房产（或其任何权益），贷款人有权要求借款人立即偿还全部剩余贷款余额（Acceleration of debt）。

2. 联邦法律的强力支持

根据联邦法律 Garn-St. Germain Depository Institutions Act of 1982，除了极少数例外情况（如继承、配偶间转让等），“出售即到期”条款是完全可执行的 (Enforceable)。

这意味着，州法律不能阻止银行执行该条款。无论买家的信用有多好，或者银行的担保物是否安全，只要合同里有这个条款，银行就可以行使权利。

3. 为什么“分期付款土地合同”无法规避？

题目中提到的 Installment Land Contract（也称为 Contract for Deed）是一种特殊的融资方式：

  • 卖方保留法定所有权 (Legal Title)。
  • 买方获得衡平法所有权 (Equitable Title) 和占有权。

虽然法定所有权没有立即转移，但这仍然构成了“权益的转让” (Transfer of an interest)。因此，这种交易方式同样会触发 Due-on-Sale 条款。选项 A 错误，因为仅仅改变交易形式不能欺骗或阻止银行执行权利。

4. 为什么不是“非法转让限制”？

针对选项 C：虽然普通法（Common Law）通常厌恶对土地转让的限制（Restraints on Alienation），但法院和联邦法律认为 Due-on-Sale 条款是合理的限制 (Reasonable Restraint)。它保护了贷款人在利率上升环境下的利益，因此不是无效条款。

⚠️ MBE 考场陷阱

题目特意提到“邻居信用良好”且“付款记录完美”。不要被这些事实误导！

在早期的某些州判例（如 Wellenkamp 案）中，只有当银行的安全受到威胁时才能执行该条款。但 Garn-St. Germain 法案 已经推翻了这一观点。现在，银行不需要证明其担保物面临风险，仅凭合同条款即可执行。

questions.question:
A seller and a buyer signed a contract of sale for improved real property. The contract contained a financing contingency for a certain percentage of the purchase price. The buyer obtained the requisite financing from a bank.
At the closing, the buyer executed a note to the seller for a portion of the purchase price, which note was not secured by a mortgage. The buyer then executed a second note, secured by a mortgage to the bank, applying the bank loan proceeds to the purchase price of the property. The bank had actual knowledge of the prior note to the seller. The bank promptly recorded its mortgage.
The buyer is now in default on both notes.
There is no applicable statute.
Which party has priority?

choices.a: The bank, because its loan satisfied the financing contingency in the contract of sale.
choices.b: The bank, because its note is secured by a purchase-money mortgage.
choices.c: The seller, because he retained a vendor's lien that was first in time.
choices.d: The seller, because the bank had actual knowledge of the seller's note.

data.questionStem:
Q86824 A seller and a buyer signed a contract of sale for improved real property. The contract contained a financing contingency for a certain percentage of the purchase price. The buyer obtained the requisite financing from a bank.

At the closing, the buyer executed a note to the seller for a portion of the purchase price, which note was not secured by a mortgage. The buyer then executed a second note, secured by a mortgage to the bank, applying the bank loan proceeds to the purchase price of the property. The bank had actual knowledge of the prior note to the seller. The bank promptly recorded its mortgage.

The buyer is now in default on both notes.

There is no applicable statute.

Which party has priority? 卖方和买方就一处已改良的不动产签订了销售合同。该合同包含一项针对一定比例购买价格的融资应急条款。买方从一家银行获得了所需的融资。

在交割时，买方为一部分购买价格向卖方出具了一份票据，该票据没有抵押担保。然后，买方出具了第二份票据，并以向银行的抵押作为担保，将银行贷款收益用于支付该房产的购买价格。银行实际知晓先前给卖方的票据。银行及时登记了其抵押权。

买方现在对两份票据均已违约。

没有适用的成文法。

哪一方享有优先权？
options:
A. The bank, because its loan satisfied the financing contingency in the contract of sale.
银行，因为其贷款满足了销售合同中的融资应急条款。

B. The bank, because its note is secured by a purchase-money mortgage.
银行，因为其票据由购房抵押权作担保。

C. The seller, because he retained a vendor's lien that was first in time.
卖方，因为他保留了时间在先的卖方留置权。

D. The seller, because the bank had actual knowledge of the seller's note.
卖方，因为银行实际知晓卖方的票据。
data.explanation:
The seller received a promissory note—ie, a legal document that creates or memorializes a debt—but did not take a mortgage or other lien to secure the debt. However, when a seller transfers title to a buyer and any portion of the purchase price remains unpaid (as seen here), an equitable vendor's lien is implied by law.

Subsequently, the bank received a promissory note secured by a mortgage—ie, a lien against real property given to secure a debt. Since the mortgage was given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property, it is a purchase-money mortgage (PMM). PMMs have super priority over all other liens (whether the PMM or those liens are recorded or not). Therefore, the bank's mortgage has priority. This is true regardless of whether it knew of the seller's lien (Choices C & D).

(Choice A) The fact that the bank's loan satisfied the financing contingency in the contract of sale between the seller and buyer does not give the bank priority. Instead, it has priority because its note is secured by a PMM.

Educational objective: Equitable vendor's liens are implied by law when a seller transfers title to a buyer and any portion of the purchase price remains unpaid. Purchase-money mortgages are created when a mortgage is given to secure the purchase price of the mortgaged property, thereby giving them super priority over all other mortgages and liens.

Lien priority on real property


Purchase-money mortgages
(super priority)
First recorded liens
(senior priority)
All other recorded liens
(junior priority)
Unrecorded liens
(lowest priority)




卖方收到了一份本票——即一份创设或记录债务的法律文件——但没有取得抵押权或其他留置权来担保该债务。然而，当卖方将所有权转让给买方且任何部分的购买价格仍未支付时（如本案所示），法律上会默示一种衡平法上的卖方留置权。

随后，银行收到了一份由抵押担保的本票——即为担保一项债务而在不动产上设立的留置权。由于该抵押是为了担保被抵押财产的购买价格而设定的，因此它是一种购房抵押权（PMM）。购房抵押权比所有其他留置权（无论购房抵押权或其他留置权是否已登记）都具有超级优先权。因此，银行的抵押权具有优先权。这一点成立，无论银行是否知晓卖方的留置权（选项C和D）。

（选项A）银行的贷款满足了卖方和买方之间销售合同中的融资应急条款这一事实，并不赋予银行优先权。相反，银行享有优先权是因为其票据由购房抵押权担保。

教学目标： 当卖方将所有权转让给买方且任何部分的购买价格仍未支付时，法律上会默示衡平法上的卖方留置权。当为担保被抵押财产的购买价格而设定抵押时，即创设了购房抵押权，从而使其比所有其他抵押权和留置权都具有超级优先权。

不动产上的留置权顺位


购房抵押权
（超级优先权）
最先登记的留置权
（优先顺位）
所有其他已登记的留置权
（次级顺位）
未登记的留置权
（最低顺位）


References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (priority of purchase-money mortgages).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Mortgages & Priority

正确答案：B

银行享有优先权，因为其票据由购房抵押权 (Purchase Money Mortgage) 担保。

1. 购房抵押权 Purchase Money Mortgage (PMM)

PMM 是指为了担保购买不动产的资金而设立的抵押权。无论是卖方提供的融资，还是第三方（如银行）提供的用于购房的贷款，只要资金实际用于购买该房产，即构成 PMM。

法律效力： PMM 享有超级优先权 (Super Priority)。它优先于该房产上所有其他的留置权或权益，即使这些权益产生的时间更早（例如先前针对买方的判决留置权）。

2. 衡平法上的卖方留置权 Equitable Vendor's Lien

当卖方转让产权但未收到全额房款时，法律默示卖方对该房产拥有一个衡平法上的留置权。这是一种未登记的、隐性的权益。

本案关键： 卖方虽然持有票据，但没有设立抵押 (Mortgage)。因此，卖方仅拥有较弱的衡平法留置权，而非正式的抵押权。

抵押权顺位阶梯 Priority Ladder
1. 购房抵押权 (PMM)
(本案中的银行)
▼ 优先于 ▼
2. 衡平法上的留置权 / 先前判决
(本案中的卖方)
▼ 优先于 ▼
3. 普通后续抵押权
为什么“知情”不影响结果？ Notice vs. Priority

通常在录音法 (Recording Acts) 下，后手的“实际知情” (Actual Notice) 会导致其失去优先权。但在 PMM 的规则下情况特殊：

PMM 的超级优先权是为了鼓励贷款人提供购房资金。只要银行的钱确实用于买房，且银行设立了抵押，其 PMM 地位通常就优先于卖方的未登记衡平法留置权，即使银行知道卖方还有尾款未收。

注意：如果卖方也设立了 PMM（即卖方拿回了抵押权），那么通常卖方 PMM 优先于银行 PMM。但本题中卖方没有设立抵押，这是致命伤。

💡 MBE 破题技巧 在做抵押权顺位题目时，按以下步骤思考：
  1. 识别 PMM： 贷款是否用于购买该房产？如果是，它有超级优先权。
  2. 区分权益类型： 是一方有正式抵押 (Mortgage)，还是仅仅是留置权 (Lien) 或票据 (Note)？正式的 PMM 几乎总是胜过隐蔽的衡平法留置权。
  3. 不要被“知情”误导： 在涉及 PMM 对抗非抵押权益时，PMM 的结构性优先地位往往压倒“知情”要素。

A man wanted to downsize his home after his youngest child moved out to attend college. To finance the purchase, the man secured a loan from a bank and executed a promissory note in which he agreed to repay the bank's loan over a 30-year period. The loan was secured by a mortgage on the new home. The bank promptly and properly recorded the mortgage.
A year later, the man missed several mortgage payments and abandoned the home shortly thereafter. The bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings once it learned of the man's abandonment.
In a jurisdiction that follows the intermediate theory of mortgages, which of the following events first entitled the bank to take possession of the mortgaged property?

choices.a: The man executing the mortgage.
choices.b: The man defaulting on the mortgage.
choices.c: The man abandoning the property.
choices.d: The bank foreclosing on the property.

Q86033

A man wanted to downsize his home after his youngest child moved out to attend college. To finance the purchase, the man secured a loan from a bank and executed a promissory note in which he agreed to repay the bank's loan over a 30-year period. The loan was secured by a mortgage on the new home. The bank promptly and properly recorded the mortgage.

In a jurisdiction that follows the intermediate theory of mortgages, which of the following events first entitled the bank to take possession of the mortgaged property?

一名男子在他最小的孩子离家去上大学后，想换一所较小的房子。为了给购房融资，该男子从银行获得了一笔贷款，并签署了一份本票，同意在30年内偿还银行贷款。该贷款由新房的抵押权作担保。银行及时且适当地登记了该抵押权。

一年后，该男子拖欠了数期抵押贷款，并于此后不久遗弃了该房屋。银行在得知该男子遗弃房屋后，启动了司法止赎程序。

在一个遵循抵押的中间理论 (intermediate theory of mortgages) 的司法管辖区，以下哪一事件首先使银行有权占有该抵押房产？
options:
A. The man executing the mortgage.
该男子签署抵押合同时。

B. The man defaulting on the mortgage.
该男子对抵押贷款违约时。

C. The man abandoning the property.
该男子遗弃该房产时。

D. The bank foreclosing on the property.
银行对该房产行使止赎权时。
data.explanation:
A lender's (mortgagee's) right to take possession of mortgaged property depends on the mortgage theory followed in that jurisdiction:
  • Lien theory (majority rule) - the mortgagor (borrower) is considered the owner of the mortgaged property, so the lender cannot take possession prior to foreclosure.
  • Title theory - the lender is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until the mortgage has been paid in full, so the lender may take possession at any time.†
  • Intermediate theory - the mortgagor is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until default, so the lender obtains legal title (ie, the right of ownership and possession) to the property upon default.


Since this jurisdiction follows the intermediate theory of mortgages, the man was entitled to possession of the home until he defaulted on the mortgage (Choice A). Therefore, the bank first acquired the right of ownership and possession of the home upon default.

†However, mortgage agreements typically limit this right so that the lender may take possession only upon default.

(Choice C) Under any mortgage theory, a lender may take possession of mortgaged property if it is abandoned by the mortgagor. But here, the man defaulted on the mortgage loan before he abandoned the property, so the bank was entitled to possession prior to his abandonment.

(Choice D) The bank was first entitled to take possession of the home when the man defaulted on the mortgage, which occurred prior to foreclosure.

Educational objective: Under the intermediate theory of mortgages, a mortgagor is entitled to possession until default, at which time the lender acquires legal title (ie, the right to own and possess) to the mortgaged property.



选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 53%（正确选项），C选项 20%，D选项 20%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

贷款人（抵押权人）占有抵押房产的权利取决于该司法管辖区所遵循的抵押理论：
  • 留置权理论 (Lien theory)（多数规则）- 抵押人（借款人）被视为抵押房产的所有人，因此贷款人在止赎前不得占有房产。
  • 所有权理论 (Title theory) - 贷款人被视为抵押房产的所有人，直到抵押贷款全部还清，因此贷款人可在任何时候占有房产。†
  • 中间理论 (Intermediate theory) - 抵押人被视为抵押房产的所有人，直到发生违约，因此贷款人在抵押人违约时获得法定所有权（即所有和占有权）。


由于该司法管辖区遵循抵押的中间理论 (intermediate theory of mortgages)，该男子有权占有房屋直至其抵押贷款违约(选项A)。因此，银行在男子违约时首次获得了对房屋的所有权和占有权。

†但是，抵押合同通常会限制此项权利，因此贷款人只能在违约时才能占有房产。

(选项C) 在任何抵押理论下，如果抵押房产被抵押人遗弃，贷款人可以占有该房产。但在本案中，该男子在遗弃房产之前已经对抵押贷款违约，因此银行在他遗弃房产之前就已有权占有。

(选项D) 银行在男子对抵押贷款违约时就首次获得了占有房屋的权利，而这发生在止赎之前。

教学目标：根据抵押的中间理论 (intermediate theory of mortgages)，抵押人有权占有房产直至违约，届时贷款人将获得该抵押房产的法定所有权（即所有和占有的权利）。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

抵押权理论与占有权
(Mortgage Theories & Possession)
正确答案：选项 B 该男子对抵押贷款违约时 (The man defaulting on the mortgage)。
核心考点：三大抵押理论

在美国财产法中，贷款人（Mortgagee）何时有权占有房产，完全取决于该州采用哪种抵押理论：

  • 1. 留置权理论 (Lien Theory) ★ 多数州规则
    抵押只是房产上的一个留置权 (Lien)。借款人持有所有权。贷款人只有在止赎 (Foreclosure) 完成后才能获得占有权。
  • 2. 所有权理论 (Title Theory) ★ 少数州规则
    贷款人持有房产的法定所有权 (Legal Title)。理论上，贷款人可以在任何时候 (at any time) 占有房产，甚至在违约之前（虽然合同通常会限制这一点）。
  • 3. 中间理论 (Intermediate Theory) ★ 本题考点
    介于上述两者之间。借款人持有所有权，直到违约 (Default) 发生。一旦违约，法定所有权和占有权自动转移给贷款人。
本题逻辑推理

题目明确指出该司法管辖区遵循 中间理论 (Intermediate Theory)。

根据中间理论，在借款人违约之前，他保留所有权和占有权。然而，一旦借款人违约 (Default)，法定所有权 (Legal Title) 就转移给了银行。

因此，银行首先 (First) 获得占有权的时刻就是违约发生的时刻。

为什么其他选项是错的？

A (签署时): 这是所有权理论 (Title Theory) 下的结果。在中间理论下，签署时尚未发生违约，银行无权占有。

C (遗弃时): 虽然遗弃可能导致银行为了保护财产价值（防止废弃 Waste）而介入，但在时间线上，违约发生在遗弃之前。题目问的是“首先 (First)”有权占有的时间点。

D (止赎时): 这是留置权理论 (Lien Theory) 下的结果。在中间理论下，银行不需要等到止赎完成就能获得占有权。

💡 MBE 备考锦囊

遇到抵押权占有题目，先看题目设定的Jurisdiction (管辖区理论)：
  • 看到 Lien Theory → 选 Foreclosure (最晚)。
  • 看到 Title Theory → 选 Execution/Signing (最早)。
  • 看到 Intermediate Theory → 选 Default (中间)。
记住："Intermediate" 意味着权利转移发生在中间点，即违约时。

questions.question:
A brother and sister owned in fee simple a large piece of property as tenants in common, each owning an undivided one-half interest. The brother and sister joined in mortgaging the property to their cousin by a properly recorded mortgage that contained a general warranty clause. The brother became disenchanted with land-owning and notified the sister that he would no longer contribute to the payment of installments due to the cousin. After the mortgage was in default and the cousin made demand for payment of the entire amount of principal and interest due, the sister tendered to the cousin, and the cousin deposited, a check for one-half of the amount due to the cousin. The sister then demanded a release of her undivided one-half interest. The cousin refused to release any interest in the property. The sister promptly brought an action against the cousin to quiet title to an undivided one-half interest in the property.
In such action, should the sister win or lose?

choices.a: Lose, because the cousin's title had been warranted by an express provision of the mortgage.
choices.b: Lose, because there was no redemption from the mortgage.
choices.c: Win, because the co-tenancy of the mortgagors was in common and not joint.
choices.d: Win, because the sister is entitled to marshalling.

一对兄妹作为按份共有租户，以完全所有权共同拥有一大片地产，每人拥有不可分割的二分之一权益。兄妹二人通过一份经过适当登记且包含一般保证条款的抵押合同，将该地产共同抵押给了他们的表亲。哥哥对拥有土地感到厌倦，并通知妹妹他将不再分担支付给表亲的分期款项。在抵押违约且表亲要求支付全部到期本金和利息后，妹妹向表亲提交了一张金额为应付总额二分之一的支票，表亲收下了这张支票。随后，妹妹要求解除其不可分割的二分之一权益上的抵押。表亲拒绝解除该地产上的任何抵押权益。妹妹立即对表亲提起了确认产权诉讼，要求确认其在该地产上拥有的不可分割的二分之一权益。

在该诉讼中，妹妹应该胜诉还是败诉？
options:
A. Lose, because the cousin's title had been warranted by an express provision of the mortgage.
败诉，因为表亲的产权已由抵押合同的明示条款作出了保证。

B. Lose, because there was no redemption from the mortgage.
败诉，因为抵押未被赎回。

C. Win, because the co-tenancy of the mortgagors was in common and not joint.
胜诉，因为抵押人是按份共有而非联合共有。

D. Win, because the sister is entitled to marshalling.
胜诉，因为妹妹有权要求资产分配清偿。
data.explanation:
Right of redemption

(regaining title after default on loan)
TimingAssertion of right
Equitable right (always exists)At any time prior to foreclosure salePay full amount of debt due (including interest) to lender
Statutory right (if statute exists)Statutory period after property has been sold in foreclosurePay foreclosure sale price to purchasing party
Tenants who jointly mortgage co-owned property are responsible for repaying that debt in proportion to their respective ownership interests (unless they agree otherwise). If the mortgage goes into default, any tenant can avoid foreclosure by exercising the equitable right of redemption. This right allows a tenant to cure the default by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt - including any amount owed by the other tenants. The paying tenant can then seek contribution (ie, reimbursement) from the other tenants for their share of the debt.

Here, the brother and sister (tenants in common) jointly mortgaged their property to the cousin. When the brother stopped paying his share of the debt, the mortgage went into default. And though the sister tried to redeem her one-half interest in the property by paying half the amount due, she could only cure the default by paying the full amount due. Therefore, there was no redemption from the mortgage, and the sister's quiet title action will fail.

(Choice A) A general warranty clause in a mortgage (as in a deed) promises that title is free of any encumbrances or defects. Although this guarantees that the cousin will acquire clear title upon foreclosure, it does not extinguish the sister's right to redeem the property.

(Choice C) The sister had to pay the full amount of the debt to redeem the property, regardless of whether she was a tenant in common or joint tenant.

(Choice D) Marshalling applies when (1) a senior creditor has a security interest in multiple assets and (2) a junior creditor has an interest in one of those assets. It requires the senior creditor to first foreclose on the asset against which it holds an exclusive security interest to preserve the junior creditor's interest in the remaining asset. But since this case only involves one security interest (the mortgage), marshalling does not apply.

Educational objective: The equitable right of redemption allows a debtor to avoid foreclosure by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt. This means that a tenant can only redeem co-owned property by paying the amount owed by all tenants.

选项正确率统计：A选项 22%，B选项 30%（正确选项），C选项 39%，D选项 8%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

赎回权

(贷款违约后恢复产权)
时机权利主张
衡平法上的权利 (始终存在)在止赎出售前的任何时间向贷款人支付全部到期债务（包括利息）
法定权利 (如果存在法规)地产在止赎出售后的法定期限内向购买方支付止赎出售价格
将共有地产共同抵押的租户，有责任按其各自的所有权权益比例偿还该债务（除非他们另有约定）。如果抵押发生违约，任何租户都可以通过行使衡平法上的赎回权来避免止赎。该权利允许租户通过支付全部未偿债务——包括其他租户所欠的任何金额——来补救违约。支付方租户随后可以就其他租户的债务份额向他们寻求分摊（即要求偿还）。

在本案中，兄妹（按份共有租户）将其地产共同抵押给了表亲。当哥哥停止支付其债务份额时，抵押发生违约。尽管妹妹试图通过支付一半的到期款项来赎回她在地产中的二分之一权益，但她只有通过支付全部到期款项才能补救违约。因此，抵押并未被赎回，妹妹的确认产权诉讼将会败诉。

(选项A) 抵押合同中的一般保证条款（如同在契据中一样）承诺产权没有任何产权负担或瑕疵。尽管这保证了表亲在止赎后将获得洁净产权，但这并不会消灭妹妹赎回该地产的权利。

(选项C) 无论妹妹是按份共有租户还是联合共有租户，她都必须支付全部债务才能赎回该地产。

(选项D) 资产分配清偿原则适用于以下情况：(1) 优先债权人对多项资产拥有担保权益，且 (2) 次级债权人对其中一项资产拥有权益。该原则要求优先债权人首先止赎其拥有独家担保权益的资产，以保护次级债权人在剩余资产中的权益。但由于本案仅涉及一项担保权益（即该抵押），资产分配清偿原则不适用。

教学目标：衡平法上的赎回权允许债务人通过支付全部未偿债务来避免止赎。这意味着租户只有通过支付所有租户所欠的款项，才能赎回其共有的地产。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 392 (2018) (common law right of redemption).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

抵押赎回权与共有财产

✅ 正确答案：B

妹妹败诉，因为她未能完成抵押赎回 (Redemption)。

核心理由：抵押权具有不可分割性。要赎回抵押物，必须支付全部未偿债务，而不仅仅是共有人的份额。

⚖️ 法律原理深度解析

1. 衡平法赎回权 (Equitable Right of Redemption)

在止赎 (Foreclosure) 发生前的任何时间，债务人都有权通过支付债务来赎回房产。但是，普通法规则非常严格：

赎回必须支付全部债务 (Full Amount of Debt)。

这包括本金、利息以及相关的费用。

2. 共有人的连带责任

虽然兄妹是按份共有 (Tenants in Common)，且每人拥有50%的权益，但他们共同签署了抵押合同。对于贷款人 (Lender/Mortgagee) 而言：

  • 抵押权是对整个地产 (Whole Property) 的留置权 (Lien)。
  • 除非抵押合同中有特殊条款允许“部分释放 (Partial Release)”，否则贷款人有权要求全额付款才解除抵押。
债务总额：$100,000
⬇️
妹妹支付：$50,000 (50%)
⬇️
结果：债务未清偿，抵押权仍覆盖100%的土地

3. 妹妹的救济途径

妹妹正确的做法应该是支付全额债务以赎回房产，然后向哥哥行使分摊请求权 (Right of Contribution)，要求哥哥偿还他应付的那部分金额。

❌ 干扰项排除

选项 A (一般保证条款)

错误原因：一般保证 (General Warranty) 是关于产权质量的承诺（即没有未披露的瑕疵），它并不改变偿还债务的义务或赎回的规则。它不能用来对抗抵押权人本身的止赎权利。

选项 C (按份共有 vs. 联合共有)

错误原因：无论是按份共有 (Tenants in Common) 还是联合共有 (Joint Tenancy)，在面对共同签署的抵押贷款时，所有共有人对抵押债务都负有连带责任。共有形式不影响贷款人要求全额受偿的权利。

选项 D (资产分配清偿 Marshalling)

错误原因：Marshalling 是一项衡平法原则，通常适用于涉及多个债权人和多项资产的情况。本案只有一个债权人（表亲）和一项资产（该地产），因此该原则完全不适用。

💡 MBE 考试技巧
  • "All or Nothing" 原则： 在涉及抵押赎回 (Redemption) 的题目中，记住默认规则是“全额支付”。部分所有者不能只支付“自己的份额”来换取部分产权的释放。
  • 区分内部关系与外部关系： 兄妹之间的份额（内部关系）不影响他们对贷款人的整体责任（外部关系）。
  • 确认产权诉讼 (Quiet Title)： 只有在产权没有任何负担或负担已被解除时，原告才能胜诉。只要抵押未完全清偿，产权上就仍有“云翳 (Cloud on Title)”。
© MBE Property Law Review

questions.question:
A land developer executed and delivered a promissory note and a mortgage securing the note to a bank. The bank was named as payee in the note and as mortgagee in the mortgage. The note also included a statement that the indebtedness evidenced by the note was "subject to the terms of a contract between the maker and the payee of the note executed on the same day" and that the note was "secured by a mortgage of even date." The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded.
Subsequently, the bank sold the land developer's note and mortgage to an investor and delivered to the investor a written assignment of the land developer's note and mortgage. The assignment was promptly and properly recorded. The bank retained possession of both the note and the mortgage in order to act as collecting agent.
Later, being short of funds, the bank sold the note and mortgage to an asset management company at a substantial discount. The bank executed a written assignment of the note and mortgage to the asset management company and delivered to it the note, the mortgage, and the assignment. The asset management company paid value for the assignment without actual knowledge of the prior assignment to the investor and promptly and properly recorded the assignment. The principal of the note was not then due, and there had been no default in payment of either interest or principal.
If the issue of ownership of the land developer's note and mortgage is subsequently raised in an appropriate action by the investor to foreclose, for whom should the court hold?

choices.a: The asset management company as to both the note and the mortgage.
choices.b: The investor as to both the note and the mortgage.
choices.c: The asset management company as to the note and the investor as to the mortgage.
choices.d: The investor as to the note and the asset management company as to the mortgage.

一名土地开发商签署并向一家银行交付了一份本票以及一份担保该本票的抵押合同。该银行在本票中被指定为收款人，在抵押合同中被指定为抵押权人。该本票还包含一项声明，即该本票所证明的债务“受制于出票人与收款人于同日签订的合同条款”，并且该本票“由同日期的抵押合同担保”。该抵押合同被及时且适当地进行了登记。

随后，该银行将土地开发商的本票和抵押合同出售给了一名投资者，并向该投资者交付了一份土地开发商本票和抵押合同的书面转让文件。该转让被及时且适当地进行了登记。银行保留了本票和抵押合同的占有权，以便作为代收代理人。

后来，由于资金短缺，该银行以大幅折扣将本票和抵押合同出售给了一家资产管理公司。银行向该资产管理公司出具了一份本票和抵押合同的书面转让文件，并向其交付了本票、抵押合同及该转让文件。该资产管理公司为此次转让支付了对价，且对先前向投资者的转让没有实际知情，并及时且适当地登记了该转让。当时，该本票的本金尚未到期，且利息或本金的支付均未发生违约。

如果投资者在随后的止赎诉讼中，就土地开发商本票和抵押合同的所有权问题提起适当诉讼，法院应判决支持哪一方？
options:
A. The asset management company as to both the note and the mortgage.
资产管理公司，关于本票和抵押合同二者。

B. The investor as to both the note and the mortgage.
投资者，关于本票和抵押合同二者。

C. The asset management company as to the note and the investor as to the mortgage.
资产管理公司关于本票，以及投资者关于抵押合同。

D. The investor as to the note and the asset management company as to the mortgage.
投资者关于本票，以及资产管理公司关于抵押合同。
data.explanation:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage


Transfer of both documentsBoth documents are transferred unless:
Transfer of note without mortgageexpressly prohibited in note/mortgage forbidden by statute or public policy or increases mortgagor's duties, burdens, risks
Transfer of mortgage without noteTransfer is void Jurisdictions are split as to effect of transfer.
A mortgage is a document that gives the mortgagee (eg, bank) an interest in real property as security for an obligation owed by the mortgagor (ie, borrower). The obligation is typically memorialized in a promissory note. The mortgagee is generally free to transfer the promissory note and/or the mortgage securing that note unless:
  • the mortgage or note expressly states otherwise
  • the transfer is forbidden by statute or public policy or
  • the transfer will increase the duties, burdens, or risks on the mortgagor.


The recipient of the transferred note/mortgage (ie, transferee) then acquires the right of foreclosure. However, the transferee can lose this right to a bona fide purchaser - ie, one who pays value for the property interest without notice of another's prior interest in the property.

Here, the investor acquired the right of foreclosure when it purchased the note and mortgage from the bank. The investor promptly and properly recorded the assignment (ie, transfer), providing record notice to any subsequent purchasers of that note and mortgage - including the asset management company. Since the asset management company was not a bona fide purchaser, it did not acquire the investor's right of foreclosure. Therefore, the court should hold for the investor as to both the note and the mortgage (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective: The recipient of a promissory note and mortgage securing that note acquires the right of foreclosure. However, the recipient can lose this right if the note and mortgage are subsequently conveyed to a bona fide purchaser - ie, one who pays value without notice of another's prior interest.

选项正确率统计：A选项 23%，B选项 63%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 4%

本票与抵押合同的转让


两份文件均转让两份文件均被转让，除非：
转让本票但不转让抵押合同本票/抵押合同中明确禁止，或为法规或公共政策所禁止，或增加了抵押人的义务、负担、风险
转让抵押合同但不转让本票转让无效 不同法域对转让的效力有不同规定。
抵押合同是一份文件，它赋予抵押权人（例如银行）对不动产的权益，作为对抵押人（即借款人）所负债务的担保。该债务通常以本票的形式记录。抵押权人通常可以自由转让本票和/或担保该本票的抵押合同，除非：
  • 抵押合同或本票中另有明确规定
  • 转让为法规或公共政策所禁止或
  • 转让会增加抵押人的义务、负担或风险。


被转让的本票/抵押合同的接收人（即受让人）随后获得止赎权。然而，受让人可能会将此权利丧失给善意购买人——即为财产权益支付了对价，且对他人先前存在的财产权益没有收到通知的人。

在本案中，投资者在从银行购买本票和抵押合同时获得了止赎权。投资者及时且适当地登记了该转让，从而向该本票和抵押合同的任何后续购买人（包括资产管理公司）提供了登记通知。由于资产管理公司不是善意购买人，它没有获得投资者的止赎权。因此，法院应就本票和抵押合同二者判决支持投资者（选项A、C和D错误）。

教学目的：本票及担保该本票的抵押合同的接收人获得止赎权。然而，如果该本票和抵押合同随后被转让给善意购买人——即支付了对价且对他人先前存在的权益没有收到通知的人，则接收人可能会丧失此权利。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).

MBE 考点解析：抵押权转让与优先级

本题考察的是不动产抵押中债权转让的优先级以及票据流通性对所有权的影响。正确答案是 B。

⚠️ 关键陷阱：票据的措辞
题目中提到本票包含声明："subject to the terms of a contract..."（受制于合同条款）。

逻辑推演步骤

1
判定本票性质 (Nature of the Note)
根据 UCC Article 3，如果本票包含“受制于另一份书面文件” (subject to or governed by another writing) 的条款，它就是有条件承诺。
→ 结论：该本票不是流通票据 (Non-negotiable Instrument)。
这意味着后续购买者不能成为“正当持票人” (Holder in Due Course, HDC)，只能适用普通法下的转让规则。
2
分析第一次转让 (To Investor)
银行将本票和抵押权转让给投资者，并且投资者及时且适当地登记 (Recorded) 了该转让。
→ 登记构成了推定通知 (Constructive Notice)。
3
分析第二次转让 (To AMC)
银行虽然保留了本票（作为代理人），但无权再次出售。资产管理公司 (AMC) 虽然支付了对价且没有“实际知情” (Actual Knowledge)，但由于第一次转让已经登记，AMC 被法律视为已知情。
核心法律原则：
要切断先前的权益，后续购买者必须是善意购买人 (Bona Fide Purchaser, BFP)。
  • BFP 要求：支付对价 + 无通知 (Without Notice)。
  • 通知分为：实际通知 (Actual)、推定通知 (Constructive/Record)、调查通知 (Inquiry)。
4
最终裁决
因为投资者的转让已登记，AMC 具有推定通知，所以 AMC 不是 BFP。
根据“时间在先，权利在先” (First in time, first in right) 的普通法原则，投资者的权益优于 AMC。
即使 AMC 占有了本票，由于本票不可流通，占有并不能赋予其优于先前记录权益的权利。
法院应判决支持：
投资者 (The Investor)
关于本票和抵押合同二者

💡 MBE 考试技巧

在处理抵押贷款转让题目时，请务必检查本票的措辞：

  • 如果本票是可流通的 (Negotiable)：持有本票的 HDC 通常会胜诉，即使之前的转让已登记（因为 HDC 制度旨在促进流通）。
  • 如果本票是不可流通的 (Non-negotiable)（如本题）：适用财产法/合同法规则。登记 (Recording) 产生的推定通知是决定性的，先登记的受让人通常获胜。

A man obtained a bank loan secured by a mortgage on an office building that he owned. After several years, the man conveyed the office building to a woman, who took title subject to the mortgage. The deed to the woman was not recorded. The woman took immediate possession of the building and made the mortgage payments for several years.
Subsequently, the woman stopped making payments on the mortgage loan, and the bank eventually commenced foreclosure proceedings in which the man and the woman were both named parties. At the foreclosure sale, a third party purchased the building for less than the outstanding balance on the mortgage loan. The bank then sought to collect the deficiency from the woman.
Is the bank entitled to collect the deficiency from the woman?

choices.a: No, because the woman did not record the deed from the man.
choices.b: No, because the woman is not personally liable on the loan.
choices.c: Yes, because the woman took immediate possession of the building when she bought it from the man.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman was a party to the foreclosure proceeding.
