一名男子以其拥有的一栋办公楼作抵押，获得了一笔银行贷款。几年后，该男子将办公楼转让给一名女子，该女子在接受所有权时受该抵押权的约束。该转让给女子的契据未被登记。该女子立即占有了该建筑，并连续数年支付抵押贷款。

随后，该女子停止支付抵押贷款，银行最终启动了止赎程序，并将男子和女子都列为当事人。在止赎拍卖中，第三方以低于抵押贷款未偿余额的价格购买了该建筑。银行随后试图向该女子追讨差额。

银行是否有权向该女子追讨差额？
options:
A. No, because the woman did not record the deed from the man.
不可以，因为该女子没有登记从该男子处获得的契据。

B. No, because the woman is not personally liable on the loan.
不可以，因为该女子对该贷款不承担个人责任。

C. Yes, because the woman took immediate possession of the building when she bought it from the man.
可以，因为该女子从该男子处购买该建筑时立即占有了它。

D. Yes, because the woman was a party to the foreclosure proceeding.
可以，因为该女子是止赎程序的一方当事人。
data.explanation:
A mortgage is an interest in real property given to a lender (ie, mortgagee) to secure a debt. The debtor (ie, mortgagor) can freely transfer the mortgaged property to a grantee unless the mortgage states otherwise. After the conveyance, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the debtor remains personally liable for the debt secured by the mortgage. But the grantee's obligations depend on whether the grantee:

  • took subject to the mortgage - in which case, the grantee does not agree to pay and is not personally liable for the debt or
  • assumed the mortgage - in which case, the grantee agrees to pay and becomes primarily liable for the debt, and the debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.


Therefore, if a lender forecloses and the sale results in a deficiency - ie, the proceeds are insufficient to satisfy the debt - the lender cannot collect that deficiency from a grantee who took the property subject to the mortgage.

Here, the man (debtor) mortgaged his office building to a bank (lender). He then conveyed the office building to a woman, who took title subject to the man's mortgage. As a result, the woman did not assume personal liability for the man's mortgage debt. This means that the bank cannot collect the deficiency from the foreclosure sale from the woman - regardless of whether she took possession of the property or was a party to the foreclosure proceeding (Choices C & D).

(Choice A) Recording a deed in the land records puts others on record notice of a person's interest in the land. But it has no impact on a lender's right to foreclosure or ability to collect a deficiency.

Educational objective: A grantee who acquires property subject to a mortgage is not personally liable for the mortgage debt and therefore is not liable for any deficiency following a foreclosure sale.



选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 73%（正确选项），C选项 7%，D选项 18%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押权(mortgage)是为担保债务而授予贷款人（即抵押权人）的一种不动产权益。债务人（即抵押人）可以自由地将已抵押的财产转让给受让人，除非抵押合同另有规定。转让后，抵押权仍然附着于该财产上，债务人仍需对抵押担保的债务承担个人责任。但受让人的义务取决于受让人是：

  • 在受抵押权约束的情况下接受财产（took subject to the mortgage） - 在此情况下，受让人不同意偿还债务，也不承担个人责任；或者
  • 承担了该抵押债务（assumed the mortgage） - 在此情况下，受让人同意偿还债务，并成为债务的主要责任人，而原债务人则作为保证人承担次要责任。


因此，如果贷款人行使止赎权，而拍卖所得不足以清偿债务（即产生差额/deficiency），贷款人不能向在受抵押权约束的情况下接受财产的受让人追讨该差额。

在本案中，男子（债务人）将其办公楼抵押给银行（贷款人）。然后他将办公楼转让给一名女子，该女子在接受所有权时受男子抵押权的约束。因此，该女子并未承担男子抵押贷款的个人责任。这意味着银行不能向该女子追讨止赎拍卖产生的差额——无论她是否占有了该财产或是否是止赎程序的一方当事人（选项C和D）。

（选项A）在土地记录中登记契据，能使他人在备案记录中注意到某人对该土地的权益。但这对于贷款人行使止赎权或追讨差额的能力没有影响。

教学目标：在受抵押权约束的情况下取得财产的受让人，对抵押债务不承担个人责任，因此对止赎拍卖后产生的任何差额也不承担责任。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.2 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (receipt of property subject to mortgage).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
核心考点：抵押房产的转让

当抵押人（Mortgagor）将房产转让给受让人（Grantee）时，受让人对原抵押债务的责任取决于转让契据中的措辞。

Subject to
(受约束) 受让人不承担个人偿债责任。

银行可以拍卖房产（In rem），但不能追究受让人的个人财产。
Assume
(承担/接管) 受让人承担个人偿债责任。

受让人成为主债务人，原房主变成担保人（Surety）。

📝 案情分析

本题中，题目明确指出女子在接受房产所有权时是 "subject to the mortgage"（受该抵押权约束）。

  • 这意味着她承认该房产背负着债务，如果债务违约，房产会被没收。
  • 但是，她没有签署任何协议承诺用个人资产偿还这笔贷款。
  • 虽然她支付了几年贷款，但这并不构成对债务的“承担”（Assumption）。

🚫 为什么不能追讨差额？

差额判决 (Deficiency Judgment) 是针对债务人的个人诉讼 (In Personam)。

因为女子只是 subject to 抵押权，她与银行之间没有合同关系（Privity of Contract）。银行只能对“物”（房产）行使权利，拍卖所得不足的部分，只能找原房主（男子）追讨，不能找女子。

✅ 正确答案：B
因为该女子对该贷款不承担个人责任 (Not personally liable)。

❌ 选项 A (未登记): 登记 (Recording) 只是为了对抗第三人，不影响受让人与银行之间的债务责任关系。

❌ 选项 C (占有): 占有房产并不产生偿债义务。

❌ 选项 D (止赎当事人): 她是房产当前的所有者，是止赎诉讼的必要当事人 (Necessary Party)，但这并不意味着她要对债务负责。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 在做抵押权转让题目时，紧盯两个关键词：
1. "Subject to" = 仅房产担责，人无责。
2. "Assume" = 房产担责，人也担责。
如果没有明确说 "Assume"，默认通常是 "Subject to"。

questions.question:
A franchisee owned a hotel, subject to a mortgage securing a debt that the franchisee owed to a bank. The franchisee later acquired a nearby parking garage, financing a part of the purchase price by a loan from a credit union, secured by a mortgage on the parking garage. Two years thereafter, the franchisee defaulted on the loan owed to the bank, which caused the full amount of that loan to become immediately due and payable. The bank decided not to foreclose the mortgage on the franchisee's hotel at that time but instead brought an action, appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction and authorized by the mortgage loan documents, for the full amount of the defaulted loan. The bank obtained and properly filed a judgment for that amount.
A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." There is no other applicable statute, except the statute providing for judicial foreclosure of mortgages, which places no restriction on deficiency judgments.
The bank later brought an appropriate action for judicial foreclosure of its first mortgage on the hotel and of its judgment lien on the parking garage. The credit union was joined as a party defendant, and appropriately counterclaimed for foreclosure of its mortgage on the parking garage, which was also in default. All procedures were properly followed, and the confirmed foreclosure sales resulted as follows:
The bank purchased the hotel for $100,000 less than its mortgage balance.
The bank purchased the parking garage for an amount that is $200,000 in excess of the credit union's mortgage balance.
How should the $200,000 surplus arising from the bid paid by the bank for the parking garage be paid?

choices.a: $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the credit union.
choices.b: $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the franchisee.
choices.c: $100,000 to the credit union and $100,000 to the franchisee.
choices.d: $200,000 to the franchisee.

Q86010

A franchisee owned a hotel, subject to a mortgage securing a debt that the franchisee owed to a bank. The franchisee later acquired a nearby parking garage, financing a part of the purchase price by a loan from a credit union, secured by a mortgage on the parking garage. Two years thereafter, the franchisee defaulted on the loan owed to the bank, which caused the full amount of that loan to become immediately due and payable. The bank decided not to foreclose the mortgage on the franchisee's hotel at that time but instead brought an action, appropriate under the laws of the jurisdiction and authorized by the mortgage loan documents, for the full amount of the defaulted loan. The bank obtained and properly filed a judgment for that amount.

A statute of the jurisdiction provides: "Any judgment properly filed shall, for ten years from filing, be a lien on the real property then owned or subsequently acquired by any person against whom the judgment is rendered." There is no other applicable statute, except the statute providing for judicial foreclosure of mortgages, which places no restriction on deficiency judgments.

The bank later brought an appropriate action for judicial foreclosure of its first mortgage on the hotel and of its judgment lien on the parking garage. The credit union was joined as a party defendant, and appropriately counterclaimed for foreclosure of its mortgage on the parking garage, which was also in default. All procedures were properly followed, and the confirmed foreclosure sales resulted as follows:

The bank purchased the parking garage for an amount that is $200,000 in excess of the credit union's mortgage balance.

How should the $200,000 surplus arising from the bid paid by the bank for the parking garage be paid?

一名特许经营人拥有一家酒店，该酒店设有抵押权，用以担保该特许经营人欠银行的一笔债务。该特许经营人后来收购了附近的一个停车库，部分购买价款通过信用合作社的贷款融资，并以该停车库的抵押权作为担保。两年后，该特许经营人拖欠了应付给银行的贷款，导致该笔贷款全额立即到期应付。当时，银行决定不对此特许经营人酒店的抵押权进行止赎，而是根据该司法管辖区的法律和抵押贷款文件的授权，就拖欠贷款的全额提起了诉讼。银行获得了该金额的判决，并进行了妥善登记。

该司法管辖区的一项法规规定：“任何妥善登记的判决，自登记之日起十年内，均构成对被判决人当时拥有或随后获得的任何不动产的留置权。” 除规定司法止赎抵押权的法规外，没有其他适用的法规，而该法规对差额判决不加限制。

之后，银行提起了适当的诉讼，要求对酒店的第一顺位抵押权以及对停车库的判决留置权进行司法止赎。信用合作社作为共同被告加入诉讼，并就其对停车库的抵押权（该抵押权也已违约）适当地提出了止赎的反诉。所有程序均得到妥善遵守，经确认的止赎拍卖结果如下：

银行以低于其抵押贷款余额100,000美元的价格购买了该酒店。

银行购买该停车库的价格，比信用合作社的抵押贷款余额高出200,000美元。

银行竞拍停车库所支付的款项产生的200,000美元盈余应如何支付？
options:
A. $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the credit union.
100,000美元支付给银行，100,000美元支付给信用合作社。

B. $100,000 to the bank and $100,000 to the franchisee.
100,000美元支付给银行，100,000美元支付给特许经营人。

C. $100,000 to the credit union and $100,000 to the franchisee.
100,000美元支付给信用合作社，100,000美元支付给特许经营人。

D. $200,000 to the franchisee.
200,000美元支付给特许经营人。
data.explanation:
Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order of priority:
  • Expenses from the sale (eg, attorneys' fees, court costs)
  • Mortgage being foreclosed
  • Junior liens, in order of lien priority
  • Debtor, if any surplus remains
Here, the credit union had the senior lien on the parking garage since its mortgage was placed on the property first. The bank later acquired a judgment lien on all the franchisee's property - including a junior lien on the garage - when the franchisee defaulted on the bank's loan. And since the foreclosure sale of the garage satisfied the credit union's entire mortgage and created a $200,000 surplus, the bank (as the junior lienholder) should receive $100,000 to cover the balance still owed under its mortgage on the hotel. The remaining surplus ($100,000) should then be distributed to the franchisee (Choices A, C & D).

Educational objective: Proceeds from a foreclosure sale are typically distributed in the following order: expenses, foreclosed mortgage, junior liens, then the debtor.



选项正确率统计：A选项 34%，B选项 46%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 10%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

止赎拍卖的所得款项通常按以下优先顺序进行分配：
  • 拍卖费用（例如，律师费、法庭费用）
  • 被止赎的抵押权
  • 次级留置权，按留置权优先顺序排列
  • 债务人，如有任何盈余
在此案中，信用合作社对停车库拥有优先留置权，因为其抵押权首先在该房产上设立。当特许经营人拖欠银行贷款时，银行随后对该特许经营人的所有财产取得了判决留置权——包括对车库的次级留置权。由于车库的止赎拍卖清偿了信用合作社的全部抵押贷款并产生了200,000美元的盈余，银行（作为次级留置权人）应获得100,000美元，以弥补其酒店抵押权项下仍未偿还的余额。剩余的盈余（100,000美元）则应分配给特许经营人（选项 A、C 和 D 错误）。

教学目的：止赎拍卖所得通常按以下顺序分配：费用、被止赎的抵押权、次级留置权，然后是债务人。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 705 (2019) (distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：止赎收益分配

本题考察的核心法律原则是止赎拍卖所得款项的分配顺序（Distribution of Foreclosure Sale Proceeds）以及判决留置权（Judgment Lien）的效力。

⚖️ 核心法则 (The Rule)
止赎拍卖的收益通常按照以下严格顺序分配：
  1. 销售费用 (Expenses of the sale)：如律师费、法庭费用。
  2. 被止赎的债务本息 (Principal and accrued interest on the foreclosed loan)。
  3. 次级留置权人 (Junior Lienholders)：按照优先顺位（Priority）依次受偿。
  4. 债务人/业主 (The Debtor/Mortgagor)：如果还有剩余盈余 (Surplus)。

🔍 案情深度拆解

第一步：确定优先顺位 (Priority)

在停车库 (Parking Garage) 这一特定资产上，存在两个主要的担保权益：

  • 第一顺位 (Senior)： 信用合作社 (Credit Union) 的抵押权。它是购买价款抵押权，且设立最早。
  • 第二顺位 (Junior)： 银行 (Bank) 的判决留置权 (Judgment Lien)。银行起诉欠款并获得判决后，根据法规，该判决自动成为债务人所有不动产（包括车库）的留置权。
第二步：计算银行的剩余债权

银行对酒店的止赎拍卖结果是：
拍卖价 = 抵押余额 - $100,000。
这意味着银行还有 $100,000 的债权未被满足（即 Deficiency）。这笔剩余债务由银行在车库上的判决留置权继续担保。

第三步：分配车库拍卖的盈余

题目指出，车库的拍卖价格比信用合作社（第一顺位）的余额高出 $200,000。

这意味着第一顺位已经全额受偿，现在的任务是分配这 $200,000 的“盈余”。

总盈余池： $200,000
- 支付次级债权人(银行)： $100,000
---------------------------
= 剩余归债务人(特许经营人)：$100,000

💡 为什么选 B？

根据分配规则：

  1. 银行 (Bank) 作为次级留置权人，有权优先于债务人受偿。银行还缺 $100,000，所以先拿走 $100,000。
  2. 特许经营人 (Franchisee) 作为业主，享有所有次级债权被清偿后的剩余权益。剩下的 $100,000 归他所有。

因此，正确分配是：银行 $100,000，特许经营人 $100,000。

🚫 避坑指南
不要因为银行是“原告”或者因为银行在酒店上亏了钱，就认为银行可以拿走全部 $200,000。银行只能拿走它实际被亏欠的金额（即剩余的 $100,000）。留置权是为了担保债务，债权人不能通过止赎获得超过债权金额的暴利。
© MBE Property Law Review

questions.question:
A woman borrowed money from a bank in order to build a new barn on her 20-acre farm. The loan was secured by a 10-year mortgage on the farm. The mortgage contained an acceleration clause. After three years, the woman defaulted on the loan. The bank sent a certified letter to the woman notifying her of its intention to accelerate the loan unless she cured the default within 75 days.
The woman was unable to make the required payment by the 75-day deadline to cure the default. As a result, the bank accelerated the loan and initiated foreclosure proceedings against the woman. The day after being served with a summons and complaint, the woman informed the bank that she was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments, including late fees and interest. The woman then filed a motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings.
Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

choices.a: No, because the bank initiated the foreclosure, which terminated the woman's right to redemption.
choices.b: No, because the woman does not have enough money to force the bank to accept her payment.
choices.c: Yes, because the bank is clogging the equity of redemption by failing to accept her payment.
choices.d: Yes, because the woman has properly exercised the statutory right of redemption.

该驳回动议是否应被批准？

A. No, because the bank initiated the foreclosure, which terminated the woman's right to redemption.

B. No, because the woman does not have enough money to force the bank to accept her payment.

C. Yes, because the bank is clogging the equity of redemption by failing to accept her payment.
应批准，因为银行拒绝接受她的付款，从而妨碍了衡平法上的赎回权。

data.explanation:
Common mortgage provisions


Acceleration clauseAllows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor defaults
Due-on-sale clauseAllows creditor to demand entire loan due & payable if debtor sells mortgaged property without permission
Due-on-encumbrance clauseAllows creditor to accelerate mortgage obligation if debtor obtains second mortgage or otherwise encumbers property
Defeasance clauseRequires creditor to give debtor legal title to property & release mortgage lien once all payments are made
Mortgage documents often contain an acceleration clause, which allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt plus any accrued interest if the debtor (mortgagor) defaults on the mortgage loan. If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can move forward with foreclosure proceedings to recover any remaining debt.

However, the doctrine of equitable redemption gives the debtor an opportunity to retain the property and avoid foreclosure by paying the amount of the loan obligation currently owed at any time prior to the foreclosure sale. If the mortgage documents contain an acceleration clause, then the debtor must pay the full amount of the unpaid loan plus interest to redeem the property.

Here, the woman was unable to cure her default by the bank's 75-day deadline, so the bank initiated foreclosure proceedings. Although the woman was able to make the two outstanding mortgage payments plus late fees and interest, the acceleration clause required that she pay the full amount of the unpaid loan plus interest to redeem the property. Since the woman does not have enough money to do so, her motion to dismiss the foreclosure proceedings should be denied.

(Choice A) The foreclosure sale - not the initiation of the foreclosure proceedings - terminated the equitable right of redemption.

(Choice C) The principle of clogging the equity of redemption refers to a lender's attempt to deny the debtor the right to redemption after the mortgage is executed - eg, by including a waiver clause in the mortgage. Since no waiver occurred here, this principle does not apply.

(Choice D) Many states recognize a statutory right of redemption that allows a debtor to reclaim the property after a foreclosure sale - not before the sale, as the woman seeks to do here.

Educational objective:

An acceleration clause allows the lender to demand full payment of the remaining mortgage debt plus any accrued interest if the debtor defaults on the mortgage loan. If the debtor is unable to pay, then the lender can move forward with foreclosure proceedings.

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 37%（正确选项），C选项 18%，D选项 33%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

常见的抵押条款


加速清偿条款 (Acceleration clause)如果债务人违约，允许债权人要求全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付
售出时到期条款 (Due-on-sale clause)如果债务人未经许可出售抵押财产，允许债权人要求全部贷款立即到期并应予偿付
设定产权负担时到期条款 (Due-on-encumbrance clause)如果债务人获得第二抵押或以其他方式在财产上设定产权负担，允许债权人加速清偿抵押债务
废止条款 (Defeasance clause)要求债权人在所有款项付清后，将财产的法定所有权交予债务人并解除抵押权
抵押文件中通常包含一项加速清偿条款，该条款允许贷款人在债务人（抵押人）拖欠抵押贷款的情况下，要求全额支付剩余的抵押贷款债务外加任何应计利息。如果债务人无法支付，那么贷款人可以进行止赎程序以收回任何剩余债务。

然而，衡平法上的赎回权原则 (doctrine of equitable redemption) 给予债务人保留财产并避免止赎的机会，只要其在止赎出售之前的任何时间支付当前所欠的贷款债务金额即可。如果抵押文件中包含加速清偿条款，那么债务人必须支付未偿还贷款的全部金额外加利息才能赎回该财产。

在本案中，该女性未能在银行给出的75天期限内纠正其违约行为，因此银行启动了止赎程序。尽管该女性能够支付两笔逾期抵押贷款以及滞纳金和利息，但加速清偿条款要求她必须支付未偿还贷款的全部金额外加利息才能赎回财产。由于该女性没有足够的资金这样做，她请求驳回止赎程序的动议应被拒绝。

(选项A) 终止衡平法上赎回权的是止赎出售——而非止赎程序的启动。

(选项C) 妨碍衡平法上赎回权的原则 (clogging the equity of redemption) 指的是贷款人在抵押合同签订后试图剥夺债务人赎回权的行为——例如，在抵押合同中加入弃权条款。由于本案中没有发生弃权行为，该原则不适用。

(选项D) 许多州承认一种法定赎回权 (statutory right of redemption)，允许债务人在止赎出售之后收回财产——而不是像本案中该女性所寻求的在出售之前收回。

教学目标：

加速清偿条款允许贷款人在债务人拖欠抵押贷款的情况下，要求全额支付剩余的抵押贷款债务外加任何应计利息。如果债务人无法支付，那么贷款人可以进行止赎程序。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

核心考点：加速条款与赎回权

本题考察的是 Acceleration Clause（加速清偿条款）被触发后，对债务人行使 Equitable Right of Redemption（衡平法赎回权）金额的影响。

法律逻辑分析

在抵押贷款法中，一旦债务人违约，通常有两个阶段的“赎回”机会，但金额要求不同：

阶段 1：加速前 (Pre-Acceleration)
债务人只需补齐滞纳金和逾期款项 (Arrears) 即可恢复贷款正常状态。
阶段 2：加速后 (Post-Acceleration)
一旦银行有效行使了加速条款，全部剩余贷款本金立即到期。此时要行使“衡平法赎回权”以保住房子，必须支付全额债务 (Full Balance)，而不仅仅是补齐逾期款项。
阶段 3：止赎出售 (Foreclosure Sale)
出售发生瞬间，衡平法赎回权终止。

在本案中，银行已经给了75天的通知期，期限过后银行正式启动了加速程序。此时，贷款的“到期金额”已经从“两期欠款”变成了“全部剩余本金”。

✅ 正确答案：B

不应批准，因为该女性没有足够的资金来迫使银行接受她的付款。

深度解析：虽然该女性拥有衡平法赎回权（直到止赎出售前都有效），但该权利的行使条件是支付当前应付的全部债务。由于加速条款已生效，当前应付债务 = 全部剩余本金 + 利息 + 费用。

题目明确指出她只能支付“两笔逾期款项 (two outstanding mortgage payments)”，这远低于全额债务。因此，她的出价不足以赎回房产，银行有权拒绝并继续止赎。

为什么其他选项是错的？
A 错误 Equitable Right of Redemption（衡平法赎回权）是在止赎出售 (Foreclosure Sale) 那一刻才终止，而不是在提起诉讼 (Initiation) 时终止。她还有权赎回，只是钱没给够。
C 错误 Clogging the Equity of Redemption（妨碍衡平法赎回权）通常指贷款人在最初的抵押合同中加入条款，迫使借款人放弃赎回权。银行要求按合同全额付款并不是“妨碍”权利，而是在执行合同。
D 错误 Statutory Right of Redemption（法定赎回权）通常发生在止赎出售之后。本案尚处于诉讼阶段（出售前），适用的是衡平法赎回权，且她未满足全额支付的条件。
💡 MBE 提分技巧
做此类题目时，请务必画出时间轴：
  1. 加速前：只需补欠款 (Cure default)。
  2. 加速后、出售前：必须付全款 (Redeem in equity)。
  3. 出售后：如果有法规支持，按法定价格赎回 (Statutory redemption)。
本题的关键在于识别出“加速已经发生”这一事实，从而确定付款金额要求变了。

The jurisdiction follows the title theory of mortgages and allows for nonjudicial foreclosures.
Which of the following actions poses the most financial risk to the bank?

choices.a: Accepting a deed in lieu of foreclosure.
choices.b: Entering the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure.
choices.c: Foreclosing on the mortgage through a privately conducted public sale.

一对新婚夫妇，渴望开始共同生活，决定建造一栋新房子。他们通过向银行签署一份为期15年的本票和购房抵押贷款来为房屋融资。该抵押合同包含一项出售权条款，并已及时登记。

七年后，这对夫妇合法分居。由于各自的薪水都无法负担抵押贷款的还款，他们放弃了该房屋并停止支付抵押贷款。在夫妇错过两期还款后，银行决定启动止赎程序。

该司法管辖区遵循抵押的产权理论（title theory of mortgages），并允许非司法止赎。

以下哪项行为给银行带来最大的财务风险？
options:
A. Accepting a deed in lieu of foreclosure.
接受一份替代止赎的契据。

B. Entering the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure.
在止赎前进入房产进行维修。

C. Foreclosing on the mortgage through a privately conducted public sale.
通过私下举行的公开拍卖来对抵押进行止赎。

D. Leasing the home to a tenant.
将房屋出租给租户。
data.explanation:
This jurisdiction follows the title theory of mortgages, so a lender is considered the owner of the mortgaged property until the mortgage debt is fully satisfied. This gives the lender the right to take possession of the property at any time (unless the mortgage states otherwise). If the lender takes possession, then it assumes the duty to take reasonable care of the property until foreclosure proceedings end.

The duty of reasonable care includes the duty not to commit waste that would impair the value of the property. As a result, the lender is liable to the borrower if the value of the property is reduced because of the lender's actions during foreclosure proceedings.

Here, if the bank chooses to lease the home, it runs the risk that the tenant will damage the property. Damage to the property reduces any equity that the borrower (here, the couple) may have in the home. Such damage would amount to waste, for which the bank would have to account to the couple during the foreclosure proceedings. Therefore, leasing the home to a tenant poses the most financial risk to the bank.

(Choice A) A borrower may deed all interest in the property to the lender in lieu of foreclosure. This poses minimal financial risk to the lender because it allows the lender to take immediate possession of the property without any further legal formalities and to generally reserve the right to pursue a deficiency against the debtor.

(Choice B) The bank may enter the property to make repairs prior to foreclosure because this would likely increase the value of the property - not impair it.

(Choice C) In jurisdictions that permit nonjudicial foreclosure, a lender may foreclose on a mortgage through a privately conducted public sale when the mortgage contains a power-of-sale clause (as seen here). This allows the bank to foreclose without court intervention.

Educational objective: A lender has the right to take possession of mortgaged property but is liable to the borrower for any waste that the lender commits during foreclosure proceedings.

选项正确率统计：A选项 28%，B选项 14%，C选项 19%，D选项 36%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

该司法管辖区遵循抵押的产权理论（title theory of mortgages），因此贷款人被视为抵押财产的所有权人，直到抵押债务完全清偿为止。这赋予了贷款人随时占有该财产的权利（除非抵押合同另有规定）。如果贷款人占有该财产，那么他们就承担了采取合理注意照管该财产的义务，直到止赎程序结束。

合理注意的义务包括不实施会损害财产价值的损耗行为的义务。因此，如果在止赎程序中，由于贷款人的行为导致财产价值降低，贷款人需对借款人承担责任。

在本案中，如果银行选择出租房屋，则会面临租户损坏财产的风险。对财产的损害会减少借款人（在此案中为这对夫妇）在房屋中可能拥有的任何资产净值。这种损害将构成损耗行为，银行将不得不在止赎程序中就此向这对夫妇作出交待。因此，将房屋出租给租户给银行带来了最大的财务风险。

(选项A) 借款人可以将其在财产中的所有权益以契据形式转让给贷款人，以替代止赎。这对贷款人构成的财务风险极小，因为它允许贷款人无需任何进一步的法律手续即可立即占有财产，并且通常保留向债务人追索差额的权利。

(选项B) 银行可以在止赎前进入房产进行维修，因为这很可能会增加财产的价值，而不是损害它。

(选项C) 在允许非司法止赎的司法管辖区，当抵押合同中包含出售权条款时（如本案所示），贷款人可以通过私下举行的公开拍卖来对抵押进行止赎。这使得银行无需法院干预即可进行止赎。

教学目的：贷款人有权占有抵押财产，但需对在止赎程序中实施的任何损耗行为向借款人承担责任。

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
核心法律原则：产权理论 (Title Theory)

在遵循 Title Theory 的司法管辖区，抵押权人（银行）持有房产的法律所有权（Legal Title），直到债务还清。这意味着银行有权在借款人违约后，甚至在止赎完成前，就接管并占有（Possess）房产。

⚠️ 为什么选项 D 是最大风险？

选项 D：将房屋出租给租户 (Leasing the home)

当银行接管房产并将其出租时，银行成为了“占有抵押财产的抵押权人” (Mortgagee in Possession)。

这种身份带来极高的法律责任：

  • 管理义务 (Duty of Care)：银行必须像一个谨慎的所有者一样管理房产。
  • 损耗责任 (Liability for Waste)：如果租户损坏了房子（即发生了 Waste），导致房产价值下降，银行必须对借款人（夫妇）负责。
  • 后果：在最终的止赎清算中，银行可能因为房产贬值而被扣减可追偿的债务金额，甚至需要赔偿借款人的权益损失。
为何其他选项风险较低？
✅
选项 A (Deed in Lieu): 接受替代止赎的契据。这是最安全的做法之一。借款人自愿交出产权，债务通常被视为已解决或部分解决，银行立即获得完整所有权，不存在“管理不善”被起诉的风险。
✅
选项 B (Repairs): 进入房产进行维修。这履行了保护房产价值的义务，防止了损耗 (Waste)，实际上是降低了风险，而不是增加风险。
✅
选项 C (Private Sale): 非司法止赎拍卖。这是行使抵押合同中的 Power-of-Sale 条款的标准程序。只要程序合法，这是银行收回资金的正常途径，不涉及额外的管理责任风险。
🎓 MBE 答题技巧

在处理 Mortgages 题目时，如果看到银行在止赎（Foreclosure）完成之前就介入房产：

  1. 判断是 Lien Theory（通常不能占有）还是 Title Theory（可以占有）。
  2. 一旦银行占有 (Possession)，立即联想到 "Strict Duty to Account"（严格的会计义务）和 "Liability for Waste"（损耗责任）。
  3. 风险点：权利越大，责任越大。接管房产并出租，意味着银行要为房子的状况背书。

Against whom is the bank entitled to collect a deficiency judgment?

一名女子向银行借款50万美元。她向银行签署了一张本票，并用她拥有的一块商业地块的抵押权来担保贷款的偿还。该本票和抵押合同不包含“售出即付”条款。几个月后，该女子将该商业地块转让给了她的商业伙伴，转让“以银行的抵押权为负担，受让人承担并同意偿还”。该商业伙伴随后将地块转让给一位买家，“以银行的现有抵押权为负担”。每位受让人都收到了一份本票和抵押合同的副本。

在买家按时支付了几笔款项后，没有任何一方再进行支付。银行提起了止赎诉讼，将该女子、其商业伙伴和买家列为被告。止赎拍卖导致了差额。

本案没有适用的成文法。

银行有权向谁追讨差额判决？
options:
A. The business partner and the buyer.
商业伙伴和买家。

B. The woman.
该女子。

C. The woman and the business partner.
该女子和商业伙伴。

D. The woman, the business partner, and the buyer.
该女子、商业伙伴和买家。
data.explanation:
A debtor is free to sell mortgaged property unless the mortgage agreement states otherwise. After the sale, the mortgage remains attached to the property and the debtor remains personally liable for the debt secured by the mortgage. But the buyer's obligations with respect to the mortgage depend on whether he/she:
  • took the property subject to the mortgage - in which case the buyer does not agree to pay, and is not personally liable for, the debt (even if the buyer makes payments on the loan) or
  • assumed the mortgage - in which case the buyer expressly agrees to pay and becomes primarily liable for the debt, while the debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.
Therefore, if a creditor forecloses on mortgaged property and the sale results in a deficiency - ie, the proceeds are insufficient to satisfy the debt - the creditor can obtain a deficiency judgment against the original debtor and/or any party who has assumed the mortgage.

Here, the woman mortgaged the commercial tract to a bank and then conveyed the tract to her business partner, who assumed the mortgage. The business partner then conveyed the tract to the buyer, who took it subject to the mortgage. Although the buyer made payments on the loan, this did not constitute an assumption of liability for the debt. As a result, the bank is entitled to collect a deficiency judgment only against the woman and the business partner (Choices A, B & D).

Educational objective: When a foreclosure sale results in a deficiency, the creditor can obtain a deficiency judgment against (1) the original debtor and/or (2) any party who has assumed the mortgage.



选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 13%，C选项 50%（正确选项），D选项 17%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

除非抵押协议另有规定，否则债务人可以自由出售设有抵押的财产。出售后，抵押权仍然附着于该财产上，且债务人仍对由抵押担保的债务承担个人责任。但是，买家对于抵押权的义务取决于他/她是否：
  • 以抵押权为负担取得财产——在这种情况下，买家并不同意支付，也不承担债务的个人责任（即使买家支付了贷款）或者
  • 承担了抵押债务——在这种情况下，买家明确同意支付并成为债务的主要责任人，而债务人则作为保证人成为次要责任人。
因此，如果债权人对设有抵押的财产进行止赎，而拍卖导致了差额——即拍卖所得不足以清偿债务——债权人可以向原债务人和/或任何承担了抵押债务的一方获得差额判决。

在本案中，该女子将商业地块抵押给银行，然后将地块转让给她的商业伙伴，后者承担了抵押债务。该商业伙伴随后将地块转让给买家，后者在受让时以抵押权为负担。尽管买家支付了贷款，但这并不构成对债务责任的承担。因此，银行仅有权向该女子和其商业伙伴追讨差额判决（选项 A、B 和 D 错误）。

教学目的：当止赎拍卖产生差额时，债权人可以向（1）原债务人和/或（2）任何承担了抵押债务的一方获得差额判决。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 967 (2019) (deficiency judgments).

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.1 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (assuming a mortgage debt).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages: Liability on Transfer
💡 核心考点

当抵押房产被多次转让后，如果发生止赎（Foreclosure）且拍卖所得不足以偿还债务（Deficiency），谁需要对剩余债务承担个人责任？

1. 原借款人 (The Woman)
签署了本票 (Note)
承担个人责任 (Liable)
↓
转让方式：Assumption
2. 商业伙伴 (Partner)
"Assumes and agrees to pay"
承担个人责任 (Liable)
↓
转让方式：Subject to
3. 买家 (The Buyer)
"Subject to existing mortgage"
无个人责任 (Not Liable)

⚖️ 法律依据与推理

本题的关键在于区分两种房产转让条款：Assumption 与 Subject to。

1. 承担债务 (Assumption of Mortgage)
当受让人（Grantee）同意 "assume" 抵押贷款时，他明确承诺对债务承担个人责任。
👉 本案中：商业伙伴明确同意 "assumes and agrees to pay"，因此他对差额判决（Deficiency Judgment）负责。
2. 以抵押为负担 (Subject to Mortgage)
当受让人仅 "subject to" 抵押权取得房产时，他承认房产是债务的担保物，但拒绝承担个人还款责任。如果违约，银行可以拿走房子，但不能追究受让人的个人财产。
👉 本案中：买家仅是 "subject to"，因此不对差额负责。
3. 原债务人的责任
除非银行明确签署了债务更替协议 (Novation) 释放原债务人，否则原借款人永远对票据（Note）负责。
👉 本案中：没有 Novation，该女子始终承担责任（作为担保人/Surety）。

🚫 常见误区警示

误区： "买家支付了几期贷款，所以他默认承担了债务。"

修正： 在 Subject to 的情况下，买家为了保住房子通常会还款，但这并不构成对债务的法律承担（Assumption）。只要没有书面签署承担协议，买家就没有个人责任。

✅ 正确答案：C
银行可以向该女子（原签署人）和商业伙伴（承担者）追讨差额，但不能向买家追讨。

An aspiring dancer purchased an apartment near the theater district from a local real estate broker. To complete the sale, the dancer signed a document entitled "Contract for Deed." The document provided that the dancer was to pay the broker in monthly installments over a five-year period for the apartment, but it was silent as to remedies in the event of any default.
Four years later, after never missing a payment, the dancer suffered a severe injury and was out of work for many months. When she missed a monthly payment, the broker notified her that he intended to retake possession of the apartment. The dancer refused to surrender possession unless the broker refunded some of the money that she paid him over the years.
Which of the following outcomes is the court LEAST likely to impose?

choices.a: Require the broker to initiate judicial foreclosure proceedings on the property.
choices.b: Require the broker to refund the dancer's payments to the extent that they exceed the broker's actual damages upon forfeiture.
choices.c: Require the dancer to indemnify the broker for the delinquent payments in order to retain possession.
choices.d: Require the dancer to pay the remaining contract balance to retain possession and obtain ownership.

When she missed a monthly payment, the broker notified her that he intended to retake possession of the apartment. Which of the following outcomes is the court LEAST likely to impose?

一位有抱负的舞蹈演员从当地一名房地产经纪人处购买了一套靠近剧院区的公寓。为完成此次销售，该舞蹈演员签署了一份名为“契约合同”(Contract for Deed)的文件。该文件规定，舞蹈演员将在五年内以月度分期付款的方式向经纪人支付公寓款项，但对任何违约情况下的救济措施只字未提。

四年后，在从未错过任何一笔付款的情况下，该舞蹈演员受了重伤，好几个月无法工作。当她错过一次月度付款时，经纪人通知她，他打算收回公寓的占有权。舞蹈演员拒绝交出占有权，除非经纪人退还她多年来支付的部分款项。

以下哪项是法院最不可能裁定的结果？
options:
A. Require the broker to initiate judicial foreclosure proceedings on the property.
要求经纪人对该房产启动司法止赎程序。

B. Require the broker to pay the dancer restitution upon surrender.
要求经纪人在舞蹈演员交出房产时，向其支付返还款。

C. Require the dancer to indemnify the broker for the delinquent payments in order to retain possession.
要求舞蹈演员就拖欠的款项向经纪人作出补偿，以保留占有权。

D. Require the dancer to pay the remaining contract balance to retain possession and obtain ownership.
要求舞蹈演员支付剩余的合同余款以保留占有权并获得所有权。
data.explanation:
Mortgage alternatives


Absolute deedDebtor gives deed to creditor with intent to secure loan (ie, equitable mortgage)
Deed of trustDebtor gives deed of trust to third-party trustee as collateral for debt, & creditor can instruct trustee to foreclose upon default
Installment land contractDebtor agrees to buy land through installment payments & gets immediate possession, but seller keeps legal title until paid in full
Sale-leasebackSeller leases property from buyer immediately after sale, & seller's rental payments function as repayments on loan
Equitable vendor's lienSeller finances buyer's purchase with equitable vendor's lien when seller transfers title to buyer but purchase price not fully paid
A contract for deed (ie, installment land contract) is a type of mortgage alternative. Under this contract, the buyer may take immediate possession of the property, but the seller retains title until the buyer makes the final payment under an installment payment plan. Traditionally, a contract for deed allowed the seller to keep all installment payments and retake possession if the buyer failed to make a single payment - even if all but one payment was made. However, states now seek to assist a buyer in default by:

  • treating an installment land contract as a mortgage and requiring the seller to foreclose on the property to gain clear title (Choice A)
  • offering the buyer the equitable right of redemption by paying the remaining contract balance to retain possession and obtain ownership (Choice D) or
  • allowing the seller to retain ownership of the property but requiring some form of restitution to the buyer (Choice B).


However, a buyer cannot regain possession by merely indemnifying (ie, reimbursing) the seller for the missed payments. Therefore, the court is least likely to impose this outcome.

Educational objective: A contract for deed allows a buyer to take immediate possession of the property while the seller retains title until the final installment payment is made. The seller could traditionally keep all installment payments and retake possession upon default. But states now assist buyers in default by requiring a foreclosure, offering the equitable right of redemption, or granting the buyer restitution.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 0%，C选项 100%（正确选项），D选项 0%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押贷款替代方案


Absolute deed (绝对契据)债务人将契据交给债权人，意图担保贷款（即衡平法上的抵押）
Deed of trust (信托契据)债务人将信托契据交给第三方受托人作为债务的担保物，债权人可在违约时指示受托人进行止赎
Installment land contract (分期付款土地合同)债务人同意通过分期付款购买土地并立即获得占有权，但卖方保留法定所有权，直至款项全部付清
Sale-leaseback (售后回租)卖方在出售后立即从买方处租回房产，卖方的租金支付相当于偿还贷款
Equitable vendor's lien (衡平法上的卖方留置权)当卖方将所有权转让给买方但购买价款未完全支付时，卖方通过衡平法上的卖方留置权为买方的购买提供融资
契约合同（contract for deed，即分期付款土地合同）是一种抵押贷款的替代方案。根据此合同，买方可以立即占有该房产，但卖方保留所有权，直到买方根据分期付款计划支付最后一笔款项。传统上，契约合同允许卖方在买方未能支付任何一笔款项时——即使只差一笔未付——保留所有已付的分期款项并收回占有权。然而，现在各州通过以下方式寻求帮助违约的买方：

  • 将分期付款土地合同视为抵押，并要求卖方对房产进行止赎以获得清晰的所有权（选项A）
  • 通过支付剩余的合同余款来保留占有权并获得所有权，从而向买方提供衡平法上的赎回权（选项D）或
  • 允许卖方保留房产的所有权，但要求向买方提供某种形式的返还（选项B）。


然而，买方不能仅通过就逾期未付款项向卖方作出补偿（即偿付）来收回占有权。因此，法院最不可能裁定此结果。

教学目标： 契约合同允许买方立即占有房产，而卖方则保留所有权，直到最后一笔分期付款完成。传统上，卖方可以在（买方）违约时保留所有已付的分期款项并收回占有权。但现在各州通过要求止赎、提供衡平法上的赎回权或给予买方返还来帮助违约的买方。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 3.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (contract for deed).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property: Contract for Deed

核心考点：分期付款土地合同

本题考查的是分期付款土地合同 (Installment Land Contract / Contract for Deed) 违约后的救济措施。

这是一种融资方式，买方获得占有权，但卖方保留法定所有权 (Legal Title)，直到买方付清全部款项。

⚖️ 法律背景与推理

传统普通法对买方非常严苛：一旦违约（哪怕只差一期），卖方可以没收土地并保留所有已付款项（Forfeiture）。

但现代法院倾向于保护买方，特别是当买方已经支付了大部分款项（本题中支付了4/5，拥有大量权益 Equity）时，法院会极力避免不公平的没收。

题目问的是法院 最不可能 (LEAST likely) 采取的措施。

🔍 选项深度解析

A 可能的裁决

启动司法止赎 (Foreclosure)。
现代法院常将此类合同视为实质上的“抵押贷款”(Mortgage)。因此，要求卖方必须通过正常的止赎程序来变卖房产并受偿，这是保护买方权益的常见做法。

B 可能的裁决

支付返还款 (Restitution)。
如果法院允许卖方收回房产，为了避免卖方不当得利 (Unjust Enrichment)，通常会要求卖方退还买方已支付款项中超过“实际损失”或“公平租金”的部分。

D 可能的裁决

支付剩余全款以赎回 (Redemption)。
法院通常会给予买方一个宽限期，允许其支付剩余的全部合同余额（不仅仅是拖欠的月供）来获得完整的所有权。这被称为赎回权。

C 正确答案 (最不可能)

仅补偿拖欠款项以保留占有权。
这是法院最不可能强制执行的结果。虽然有些州的消费者保护法允许“补救”(Cure) 违约，但在一般普通法或衡平法原则下，一旦发生实质性违约，债务通常会加速到期。

法院很少会强迫卖方恢复原合同关系（即接受补交的月供并继续分期），除非合同有明确规定或有特定法规支持。通常的补救是“要么付清全款拿地(D)，要么止赎(A)，要么退钱走人(B)”。

💡 MBE 提分技巧

"Equity abhors forfeiture"（衡平法厌恶没收）。

遇到 Contract for Deed 的题目，如果买方已经支付了相当比例的款项（如本题的80%），一定要寻找保护买方的选项（如止赎、返还、赎回）。

陷阱提示：区分 Redemption（付清全款）和 Reinstatement（补交欠款）。法院乐于给买方机会付清全款(D)，但很少强迫卖方接受仅补交欠款而继续履行已违约的合同(C)。

© MBE Property Law Review

questions.question:
A man decided to purchase an apartment building. To finance this purchase, the man borrowed funds from a bank. The man executed a negotiable promissory note and a mortgage to the bank in order to secure repayment of the loan.
Two years later, the bank sold its promissory note to a mortgage company by endorsing and promptly delivering the note to the mortgage company. Shortly thereafter, the man stopped making payments on the mortgage, and the mortgage company initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings against him. The man has moved to dismiss the suit.
Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

choices.a: No, because the mortgage was not assigned and is unenforceable by anyone except the bank.
choices.b: No, because the mortgage will be deemed to have been transferred with the promissory note.
choices.c: Yes, because the promissory note could not be assigned independent of the mortgage.
choices.d: Yes, because the promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the mortgage company.

data.questionStem:
Q86029

A man decided to purchase an apartment building. To finance this purchase, the man borrowed funds from a bank. The man executed a negotiable promissory note and a mortgage to the bank in order to secure repayment of the loan.

Two years later, the bank sold its promissory note to a mortgage company by endorsing and promptly delivering the note to the mortgage company. Shortly thereafter, the man stopped making payments on the mortgage, and the mortgage company initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings against him. The man has moved to dismiss the suit.

Should the motion to dismiss be granted?

一名男子决定购买一栋公寓楼。为了为此购买融资，该男子向一家银行借款。为了担保贷款的偿还，该男子向银行出具了一份可转让本票和一份抵押合同。

两年后，银行通过背书并及时交付该本票的方式，将其出售给了一家抵押公司。此后不久，该男子停止偿还抵押贷款，抵押公司对他提起了司法止赎程序。该男子已动议驳回此诉讼。

该驳回动议是否应被批准？
options:
A. No, because the mortgage was not assigned and is unenforceable by anyone except the bank.
不应批准，因为抵押合同未被转让，除了银行之外，任何人都不能强制执行。

B. No, because the mortgage will be deemed to have been transferred with the promissory note.
不应批准，因为抵押合同将被视为已随本票一并转让。

C. Yes, because the promissory note could not be assigned independent of the mortgage.
应批准，因为本票不能独立于抵押合同进行转让。

D. Yes, because the promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the mortgage company.
应批准，因为本票的转让需要一份单独的文件才能转让给抵押公司。
data.explanation:
Transfer of promissory note & mortgage


Transfer of note without mortgageThe note can be transferred unless the transfer is expressly prohibited in the note/mortgage, forbidden by statute or public policy, or increases the mortgagor's duties, burdens, or risks.
Transfer of mortgage without noteTransfer is void. Jurisdictions are split as to the effect of transfer.
To finance the purchase of real property, a borrower typically executes two documents that serve as evidence of the debt:

  • Promissory note - a formal "IOU" that sets forth the terms of the loan. It is the primary evidence of the debt and is not recorded in the deed records.

  • Mortgage (or deed of trust) - a lien that secures the loan by attaching the debt to a real property interest and providing a means of enforcement (e.g., foreclosure). It is recorded in the deed records to provide notice of an outstanding debt attached to the real property.


If a lender decides to sell its security interest, the lender can assign the promissory note independent of the mortgage to an assignee (Choice C). A nonnegotiable promissory note requires a separate assignment document to transfer ownership (Choice D). However, a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by merely endorsing and delivering the note to the assignee. Once the promissory note is properly transferred, the mortgage automatically transfers with the note (unless the parties agreed otherwise) (Choice A).

Here, the negotiable promissory note was properly transferred to the mortgage company upon its endorsement and delivery. The mortgage will be deemed to have automatically transferred to the mortgage company, so the mortgage company can enforce the mortgage through foreclosure. Therefore, the man's motion to dismiss this foreclosure proceeding should be denied.

Educational objective: A nonnegotiable promissory note must be transferred by a separate document, while a negotiable promissory note can be transferred by endorsing and delivering the note. Either note can be transferred independent of the mortgage, and the mortgage will automatically transfer with the note (unless otherwise agreed).

选项正确率统计：A选项 5%，B选项 81%（正确选项），C选项 8%，D选项 3%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

本票与抵押合同的转让


无抵押合同的本票转让本票可以被转让，除非本票/抵押合同中明确禁止转让、被法规或公共政策所禁止，或增加了抵押人的义务、负担或风险。
无本票的抵押合同转让转让无效。各司法管辖区对转让的效力存在分歧。
为不动产购买进行融资，借款人通常会签署两份文件作为债务证明：

  • Promissory note - 一份规定了贷款条款的正式“借据”。它是债务的主要证据，且不被记录在契据档案中。

  • Mortgage (或 deed of trust) - 一种通过将债务附加于不动产权益之上以担保贷款的留置权，并提供强制执行的方式（例如，止赎）。它被记录在契据档案中，以公示附着于该不动产上的未偿债务。


如果贷款人决定出售其担保权益，贷款人可以独立于抵押合同将本票转让给受让人（选项C）。一份不可转让的本票需要一份单独的转让文件来转移所有权（选项D）。然而，一份可转让的本票仅通过向受让人背书并交付即可转让。一旦本票被恰当转让，抵押合同便自动随本票一同转让（除非当事人另有约定）（选项A）。

在本案中，该可转让的本票通过背书和交付被恰当地转让给了抵押公司。抵押合同将被视为已自动转让给抵押公司，因此该公司可以通过止赎来强制执行该抵押。因此，该男子提出的驳回此止赎程序的动议应被驳回。

教学目标：不可转让的本票必须通过一份单独的文件进行转让，而可转让的本票可以通过背书和交付本票的方式进行转让。无论哪种本票都可以独立于抵押合同进行转让，且抵押合同将自动随本票一同转让（除非另有约定）。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 5.4 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (transfer of mortgages).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
正确答案：B

不应批准，因为抵押合同将被视为已随本票一并转让。

核心法则：抵押权随债权走

在物权法中，有一条至关重要的原则："The Mortgage follows the Note"（抵押权跟随本票）。

本票（Promissory Note）代表主债权，而抵押合同（Mortgage）只是担保该债权的附属权益。只要主债权被有效转让，担保权益会自动随之转移。

📄 本票
(Note)
主 (Principal)
➡
🏠 抵押
(Mortgage)
从 (Accessory)
详细法律分析

1. 本票的转让 (Transfer of the Note)

题目中明确指出这是一份可转让本票 (Negotiable Promissory Note)。根据《统一商法典》(UCC) 第3条，这类本票可以通过以下方式有效转让：

  • 背书 (Endorsement)
  • 交付 (Delivery)

题目中银行已经完成了这两步，因此抵押公司（Mortgage Company）成为了本票的合法持有人 (Holder)。

2. 抵押权的自动转移

一旦本票被合法转让，担保该债务的抵押权自动转移给受让人。这不需要单独签署一份“抵押转让协议” (Assignment of Mortgage)。

因此，抵押公司现在既拥有债权（本票），也拥有担保权（抵押），完全有权提起止赎诉讼。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ 选项 A (No... unenforceable)
错误。抵押权不是必须单独转让才有效。它像影子一样跟随本票。
❌ 选项 C (Yes... independent)
错误。本票可以独立于抵押合同转让。实际上，转让本票是转移担保权益的主要方式。
❌ 选项 D (Yes... separate document)
错误。对于可转让本票 (Negotiable Note)，背书+交付即完成转让，不需要额外的书面转让文件。只有不可转让本票才必须通过单独的转让文件 (separate assignment document) 进行转让。
💡 MBE 拿分技巧

在遇到涉及 Note 和 Mortgage 分离的问题时，请记住：

  1. Note 是老大： 谁持有 Note，谁就拥有执行 Mortgage 的权利（通常情况下）。
  2. 物理分离不影响法律效力： 即使 Mortgage 文件还在银行手里，只要 Note 被卖给了抵押公司，抵押公司就是实际的抵押权人。
  3. 关键词： 注意题目说的是 "Negotiable" (背书+交付即可) 还是 "Non-negotiable" (需要单独文件)。

questions.question:
A landowner borrowed $100,000 from a lender and executed a valid mortgage on a commercial tract of land to secure the debt. The lender promptly recorded the mortgage.
A year later, the landowner conveyed the same tract to a developer by a deed that expressly stated that the conveyance was subject to the mortgage to the lender and that the grantee expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage obligation as part of the consideration for the purchase. The mortgage was properly described in the deed, and the deed was properly executed by the landowner; however, because there was no provision or place in the deed for the developer to sign, he did not do so. The developer promptly recorded the deed.
The developer made the monthly mortgage payments of principal and interest for six payments but then stopped payments and defaulted on the mortgage obligation. The lender properly instituted foreclosure procedures in accordance with the governing law. After the foreclosure sale, there was a $10,000 deficiency due to the lender. Both the landowner and the developer had sufficient assets to pay the deficiency.
There is no applicable statute in the jurisdiction other than the statute relating to foreclosure proceedings.
At the appropriate stage of the foreclosure action, which party will the court decide is responsible for payment of the deficiency?

choices.a: The developer, because he accepted delivery of the deed from the landowner and in so doing accepted the terms and conditions of the deed.
choices.b: The developer, because he is estopped by his having made six monthly payments to the lender.
choices.c: The landowner, because he was the maker of the note and the mortgage, and at most the developer is liable only as a guarantor of the landowner's obligation.
choices.d: The landowner, because the developer was not a signatory to the deed.

一位土地所有者从贷款人处借款100,000美元，并在一块商业用地上设立了有效的抵押以担保该债务。贷款人及时登记了该抵押。

一年后，该土地所有者通过一份地契将同一地块转让给一位开发商。该地契明确规定，此次转让受限于对贷款人的抵押，并且受让人明确承担并同意支付该抵押债务，作为购买对价的一部分。该抵押在地契中有恰当的描述，且地契由土地所有者正式签署；然而，由于地契中没有为开发商提供签署的条款或位置，他没有签署。开发商及时登记了该地契。

开发商支付了六期月度抵押贷款的本金和利息，但随后停止支付并对抵押债务违约。贷款人根据适用法律，合法启动了止赎程序。止赎出售后，尚有10,000美元的差额未偿还给贷款人。土地所有者和开发商均有足够资产支付此差额。

在该司法管辖区内，除了与止赎程序相关的法规外，没有其他适用的法规。

在止赎诉讼的适当阶段，法院将判定哪一方对支付该差额负有责任？
options:
A. The developer, because he accepted delivery of the deed from the landowner and in so doing accepted the terms and conditions of the deed.
开发商，因为他接受了土地所有者交付的地契，从而接受了地契的条款和条件。

B. The developer, because he is estopped by his having made six monthly payments to the lender.
开发商，因为他向贷款人支付了六个月的款项，构成禁止反言（estoppel）。

C. The landowner, because he was the maker of the note and the mortgage, and at most the developer is liable only as a guarantor of the landowner's obligation.
土地所有者，因为他是票据和抵押的设立人，而开发商最多只作为土地所有者债务的保证人承担责任。

D. The landowner, because the developer was not a signatory to the deed.
土地所有者，因为开发商没有在地契上签字。
data.explanation:
Transfer of mortgaged property


Effect on buyerEffect on seller
Subject to mortgageDoes not agree to pay loan & is not liable for debtRemains solely liable for debt
Assumption of mortgageAgrees to pay loan & is primarily liable for debtBecomes secondarily liable as surety
A mortgage is an interest in real property given to secure a debt. The debtor may freely transfer mortgaged property (unless otherwise agreed), but the mortgage will remain attached to that property even after it is transferred to another. The grantee's (eg, buyer's) obligations with respect to that mortgage depend on whether he/she either:

  • took subject to the mortgage - did not agree to pay and is not personally liable for the debt
  • assumed the mortgage - expressly agreed to pay and becomes primarily liable for the debt, while the original debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.


Here, the landowner's deed to the developer stated that the developer expressly assumed and agreed to pay the mortgage. And though the developer did not sign the deed, he assumed the mortgage by accepting delivery of that deed (Choice D). Therefore, the developer is primarily liable for the lender's $10,000 deficiency. And since the developer has sufficient assets to pay the deficiency judgment, the landowner need not pay anything.

(Choice B) Because the developer assumed the mortgage once he accepted the landowner's transfer of the deed, he is liable for the deficiency judgment regardless of whether, or for how long, he had paid the mortgage.

(Choice C) Although the landowner was the maker of the note and mortgage, the landowner (not the developer) became secondarily liable as a guarantor (ie, surety) when the developer assumed primary liability for that mortgage.

Educational objective: A grantee assumes a mortgage when he/she expressly agrees to pay the debt. The grantee then becomes primarily liable for that debt, while the original debtor becomes secondarily liable as a surety.

选项正确率统计：A选项 56%（正确选项），B选项 11%，C选项 17%，D选项 14%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

附抵押财产的转让


对买方的效力对卖方的效力
受限于抵押 (Subject to mortgage)不同意偿还贷款，且不对债务承担个人责任仍为债务的唯一责任人
承担抵押 (Assumption of mortgage)同意偿还贷款，并对债务承担主要责任成为次要责任人，作为保证人
抵押是为担保债务而设定的不动产权益。债务人可以自由转让附抵押的财产（除非另有约定），但即使财产转让给他人，抵押权依然附着于该财产。受让人（如买方）对该抵押的义务取决于其是：

  • 受限于抵押而接受 —— 不同意偿还债务，且不承担个人责任
  • 承担了抵押 —— 明确同意偿还债务，并成为债务的主要责任人，而原债务人则成为次要责任人，作为保证人。


在本案中，土地所有者给开发商的地契中声明，开发商明确承担并同意支付该抵押。尽管开发商没有签署地契，但他通过接受该地契的交付而承担了抵押（选项D）。因此，开发商对贷款人的10,000美元差额承担主要责任。并且由于开发商有足够资产来支付差额判决，土地所有者无需支付任何款项。

（选项B）因为一旦开发商接受了土地所有者转让的地契，他就承担了抵押，所以无论他是否支付过或支付了多久的抵押贷款，他都对差额判决负有责任。

（选项C）尽管土地所有者是票据和抵押的设立人，但当开发商承担了该抵押的主要责任时，土地所有者（而非开发商）成为了作为保证人（即surety）的次要责任人。

教学目标：当受让人明确同意偿还债务时，他/她便承担了抵押。受让人随后对该债务承担主要责任，而原债务人则作为保证人承担次要责任。

References

Restatement (Third) of Prop.: Mortgages § 5.1 (assumption of mortgage).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Mortgages
核心考点：抵押贷款的承担

当附带抵押的不动产被转让时，买方对债务的责任取决于他是“受限于抵押”还是“承担抵押”。

类型 买方责任 (Buyer) 卖方责任 (Seller)
Subject to Mortgage
(受限于抵押)		 不承担个人责任。
若违约，只会失去土地。		 仍承担主要责任。
Assumption of Mortgage
(承担抵押)		 承担主要责任 (Primary Liability)。
需偿还差额 (Deficiency)。		 转为次要责任 (Surety/Guarantor)。

📝 案情关键点

  • 地契 (Deed) 明确写明买方"expressly assumed and agreed to pay"（明确承担并同意支付）抵押债务。
  • 买方接受并登记了地契。
  • 买方没有在地契上签字。
  • 止赎后存在 $10,000 的差额 (Deficiency)。

✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 A)

结论：开发商（买方）需负责支付差额。

法律依据：

虽然根据《反欺诈法》(Statute of Frauds)，不动产转让文件通常需要签字，但在抵押承担 (Assumption of Mortgage) 的情境下，受让人 (Grantee) 不需要签署地契。

只要受让人接受了地契 (Accepted the deed)，即被视为接受了地契中的所有条款，包括承担抵押债务的承诺。开发商接受并登记了地契，因此他成为了债务的主要责任人 (Primary Obligor)。

❌ 错误选项分析

选项 D 错误原因：签字不是必须的。
这是本题最大的干扰项。许多考生认为合同必须签字才生效。但在地契转让中，受让人的“接受行为” (Acceptance) 足以使其受地契条款（包括承担债务条款）的约束。
选项 B 错误原因：理由不准确。
虽然“禁止反言” (Estoppel) 是一个法律概念，但开发商承担责任的根本原因是他接受了包含承担条款的地契（合同义务），而不仅仅是因为他支付了六个月的款项。即使他一个月都没付，只要接受了地契，他依然有责任。
选项 C 错误原因：责任顺序颠倒。
当买方“承担” (Assume) 抵押时，买方变成主要责任人，卖方变成次要责任人（保证人）。选项 C 错误地认为卖方仍是主要责任人。
💡 考试技巧 (Exam Tip)

在 MBE 考试中，看到 "Subject to" 和 "Assume" 这两个词要立刻警觉：

  • Subject to = 买方无个人债务责任 (No Personal Liability)。
  • Assume = 买方有个人债务责任 (Personal Liability)。
  • 签字陷阱：受让人(Grantee)通常无需在地契上签字，接受交付即生效。
© MBE Property Law Review

questions.question:
A baker borrowed funds from an investor to purchase a plot of land on which the baker planned to build a new bakery. In order to secure repayment of the loan, the baker signed a nonnegotiable promissory note and executed a mortgage to the investor.
Five years later, the investor sold her promissory note to a credit union by endorsing the note and promptly delivering it to the credit union. Due to a downturn in business, the baker was unable to make payments on the mortgage. The credit union now seeks to foreclose on the baker's plot of land.
If the court denies the credit union's foreclosure, what is the most likely reason?

choices.a: The mortgage required a separate written assignment in order for the transferee-credit union to enforce the mortgage.
choices.b: The nonnegotiable promissory note required a separate document for assignment to the credit union, so neither the note nor the mortgage transferred.
choices.c: The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note modified the terms of the loan, resulting in a release of the baker's personal liability.
choices.d: The transfer of the nonnegotiable promissory note without the mortgage was void.

questions.question:
A man owned property that he used as his residence. The man received a loan, secured by a mortgage on the property, from a bank. Later, the man defaulted on the loan. The bank then brought an appropriate action to foreclose the mortgage, was the sole bidder at the judicial sale, and received title to the property as a result of the foreclosure sale.
Shortly after the foreclosure sale, the man received a substantial inheritance. He approached the bank to repurchase the property, but the bank had decided to build a branch office on the property and declined to sell.
If the man prevails in an appropriate action to recover title to the property, what will be the most likely reason?

choices.a: He had used the property as his residence.
choices.b: He timely exercised an equitable right of redemption.
choices.c: The court applied the doctrine of exoneration.
choices.d: The jurisdiction provides a statutory right of redemption.

一名男子拥有一处用作其住所的房产。该男子从银行获得一笔贷款，并以该房产的抵押权作为担保。后来，该男子贷款违约。银行随后提起了适当的诉讼以对抵押物进行止赎，在司法拍卖中是唯一的竞标者，并通过这次止赎拍卖获得了该房产的所有权。

在止赎拍卖后不久，该男子获得了一大笔遗产。他联系银行希望回购该房产，但银行已决定在该地块上建造一个分行，因此拒绝出售。

如果该男子在收回房产所有权的适当诉讼中胜诉，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. He had used the property as his residence.
他曾将该房产用作其住所。

B. He timely exercised an equitable right of redemption.
他及时行使了衡平法上的赎回权。

C. The court applied the doctrine of exoneration.
法院适用了免除（遗产）负担原则 (doctrine of exoneration)。

D. The jurisdiction provides a statutory right of redemption.
该司法管辖区规定了法定赎回权。
data.explanation:
Right of redemption

(regaining title after default on loan)
TimingAssertion of right
Equitable right
(always exists)		At any time prior to foreclosure salePay full amount of debt due (including interest) to lender
Statutory right
(if statute exists)		Statutory period after property has been sold in foreclosurePay foreclosure sale price to purchasing party
When a debtor defaults on mortgage payments, the creditor may initiate foreclosure proceedings to force the sale of the mortgaged property to satisfy the unpaid debt. Once the property is sold, jurisdictions with a statutory right of redemption allow the original debtor to reacquire ownership of the property by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchasing party - even if that party is the creditor - within a designated time. Therefore, the man will successfully redeem his property from the bank if the jurisdiction provides this statutory right.

(Choice A) Unless otherwise noted, the statutory right of redemption applies to any real property - not just residential property.

(Choice B) The equitable right of redemption allows a debtor to reclaim mortgaged property before foreclosure by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt. Therefore, the man did not timely exercise this right by attempting to repurchase the property after foreclosure.

(Choice C) The doctrine of exoneration allows a will beneficiary to use the estate's general assets to pay off any encumbrances (eg, mortgages) on the devised property. But since the man did not receive devised mortgaged property (he placed the mortgage on the property himself), this doctrine does not apply.

Educational objective: The statutory right of redemption allows a debtor to reacquire ownership of property after foreclosure by paying the foreclosure sale price to the purchasing party within the designated statutory period.

选项正确率统计：A选项 0%，B选项 24%，C选项 2%，D选项 71%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

赎回权

(在贷款违约后重新获得所有权)
时机权利主张
衡平法上的权利
（始终存在）		在止赎拍卖前的任何时间向贷款人支付全部到期债务（包括利息）
法定权利
（如果存在相关法规）		在房产被止赎拍卖后的法定期限内向购买方支付止赎拍卖价格
当债务人拖欠抵押贷款时，债权人可以启动止赎程序，强制出售抵押房产以清偿未付债务。一旦房产被出售，设有法定赎回权的司法管辖区允许原债务人在指定期限内，通过向购买方（即使购买方是债权人）支付止赎拍卖价格来重新获得房产的所有权。因此，如果该司法管辖区提供了此项法定权利，该男子将成功地从银行赎回其房产。

（选项A）除非另有说明，法定赎回权适用于任何不动产——而不仅仅是住宅房产。

（选项B）衡平法上的赎回权允许债务人在止赎前通过支付全部未偿还债务来赎回抵押房产。因此，该男子在止赎后才试图回购房产，并未及时行使此项权利。

（选项C）免除（遗产）负担原则 (doctrine of exoneration) 允许遗嘱受益人使用遗产的一般资产来清偿遗赠房产上的任何产权负担（例如，抵押权）。但由于该男子并未收到遗赠的已抵押房产（他自己为该房产设定了抵押），因此该原则不适用。

教学目标：法定赎回权允许债务人在止赎后的指定法定期限内，通过向购买方支付止赎拍卖价格来重新获得房产所有权。

References

30 Am. Jur. 2d Executions and Enforcement of Judgments § 291 (2018) (statutory right of redemption).

MBE 考点解析

Real Property / Mortgages

本题考察的核心知识点是抵押贷款中的赎回权 (Right of Redemption)。在 MBE 考试中，区分“止赎前”和“止赎后”的权利是解题的关键。

核心考点：两种赎回权的区别

抵押人（借款人）试图保住或拿回房产，主要依据时间点分为两个阶段：

类型 衡平法赎回权
(Equitable Right)		 法定赎回权
(Statutory Right)
时间点 止赎拍卖前
(Before Foreclosure Sale)		 止赎拍卖后
(After Foreclosure Sale)
依据 所有州均承认
(Common Law)		 仅部分州通过立法规定
(Statute)
代价 支付全部欠款 + 利息 支付拍卖成交价

案件时间轴分析

阶段 1：违约 (Default)
男子违约，银行启动止赎程序。
此时男子拥有 Equitable Right of Redemption。
阶段 2：止赎拍卖 (Foreclosure Sale)
银行作为唯一竞标者买下房产，获得所有权 (Title)。
注意：拍卖落槌时刻，Equitable Right 终止。
阶段 3：拍卖后 (Post-Sale)
男子获得遗产，试图回购。
这是本题的关键节点。
正确答案解析 (选项 D)

题目明确指出，该男子是在止赎拍卖之后 (Shortly after the foreclosure sale) 才试图赎回房产。

在普通法下，一旦止赎拍卖完成，借款人的权益即告终止。要在拍卖后重新获得所有权，必须依赖该州具体的成文法 (Statute) 规定。这种权利被称为法定赎回权 (Statutory Right of Redemption)。

因此，如果该男子胜诉，唯一的原因只能是该司法管辖区提供了这种法定权利。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

❌ 选项 A (Residence)：
虽然某些州对家庭住宅 (Homestead) 有保护，但法定赎回权通常适用于各类不动产，并非仅限于住宅。且“用作住宅”这一事实本身不足以推翻有效的止赎拍卖结果。

❌ 选项 B (Equitable Right)：
衡平法赎回权 (Equitable Right of Redemption) 必须在止赎拍卖之前行使。一旦拍卖结束，这项权利就被切断 (Foreclosed) 了。题目中男子是在拍卖后才行动，因此时间太晚。

❌ 选项 C (Exoneration)：
免除负担原则 (Doctrine of Exoneration) 涉及继承法。它允许遗嘱受益人要求用遗产中的流动资产偿还继承房产上的债务。本题中，男子是自己抵押了自己的房产，而非继承了带有抵押的房产，且该原则与止赎后的赎回无关。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧

看到 "Redemption"（赎回）字眼时，立即在脑海中画一条线：止赎拍卖 (Foreclosure Sale)。

  • 线左边（拍卖前） = Equitable Right (支付债务全款)。
  • 线右边（拍卖后） = Statutory Right (支付拍卖价)。

如果题目发生在“线右边”，必须选带有 "Statutory" 字眼的选项。

A woman borrowed $100,000 from a bank and executed a promissory note to the bank in that amount. As security for repayment of the loan, the woman's brother gave the bank a mortgage on a tract of land solely owned by him. The brother did not sign the promissory note.
The woman subsequently defaulted on the loan, and after acceleration, the bank instituted foreclosure proceedings on the brother's land. The brother filed a timely objection to the foreclosure.
Will the bank succeed in foreclosing on the tract of land?

choices.a: No, because a mortgage from the brother is invalid without a mortgage debt owed by him.
choices.b: No, because the bank has an equitable mortgage rather than a legal mortgage.
choices.c: Yes, because the bank has a valid mortgage.
choices.d: Yes, because the bank is a surety for the brother's mortgage.

Q86012

A woman borrowed $100,000 from a bank and executed a promissory note to the bank in that amount. As security for repayment of the loan, the woman's brother gave the bank a mortgage on a tract of land solely owned by him. The brother did not sign the promissory note.

The woman subsequently defaulted on the loan, and after acceleration, the bank instituted foreclosure proceedings on the brother's land. The brother filed a timely objection to the foreclosure.

Will the bank succeed in foreclosing on the tract of land?

一名女子从银行借款100,000美元，并向银行出具了等额的本票。作为该笔贷款的还款担保，该女子的兄弟用其个人所有的一块土地为银行设定了抵押。该兄弟并未签署本票。

随后，该女子对贷款违约，在债务加速到期后，银行对其兄弟的土地启动了止赎程序。该兄弟对止赎及时提出了异议。

银行能否成功止赎该块土地？
options:
A. No, because a mortgage from the brother is invalid without a mortgage debt owed by him.
不会，因为在没有该兄弟所欠的抵押债务的情况下，他提供的抵押是无效的。

B. No, because the bank has an equitable mortgage rather than a legal mortgage.
不会，因为银行拥有的是衡平法上的抵押，而非普通法上的抵押。

C. Yes, because the bank has a valid mortgage.
会，因为银行拥有一个有效的抵押。

D. Yes, because the bank is a surety for the brother's mortgage.
会，因为银行是该兄弟之抵押的保证人。
data.explanation:
Mortgage documents


Mortgage deedA writing that conveys an interest in collateral to secure a debt
Promissory noteA formal "IOU" in which the borrower promises to repay the debt according to the listed terms
A mortgage is a lien against real property given to secure repayment of a debt. If the debt (evidenced by a promissory note) belongs to someone other than the mortgagor , then the mortgagor is not personally liable for repaying that debt.† However, the mortgagee can foreclose on the mortgaged property if the debtor defaults.

Here, the woman received a $100,000 loan from the bank, which was evidenced by a promissory note. The brother did not sign the promissory note, so he is not personally liable for the debt. But since he used his tract of land to secure repayment of the woman's debt, the bank has a valid mortgage on that land. Therefore, the bank will succeed in foreclosing on the brother's land after the woman defaulted on the loan.

†The mortgagor would be personally liable for the debt if the mortgage itself contained language to that effect.

(Choice A) The fact that the mortgage debt is owed by someone else does not render the mortgage from the brother invalid. It merely means that the brother is not personally liable for repaying the mortgage debt.

(Choice B) An equitable mortgage is a mortgage alternative that arises when a party takes possession of the original deed to property with the intent that the property serve as security for a debt (not seen here).

(Choice D) A surety is a party who guarantees to pay another's debt in the event that person fails to do so. Here, the bank has not agreed to pay the debt for the woman if she defaults, so the bank is not a surety.

Educational objective: A mortgage can be given to secure repayment of a debt owed by someone other than the mortgagor, and the mortgagee can foreclose on the mortgaged property if the debtor defaults.

选项正确率统计：A选项 10%，B选项 11%，C选项 68%（正确选项），D选项 9%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押文件


抵押契据一种为担保债务而转让担保物权益的书面文件
本票一种正式的“借据”，借款人在其中承诺按所列条款偿还债务
抵押是为担保债务偿还而对不动产设定的一种担保物权。如果债务（由本票证明）属于抵押人以外的其他人，则抵押人对偿还该债务不承担个人责任。† 但是，如果债务人违约，抵押权人可以对抵押财产进行止赎。

在此案中，女子从银行获得了100,000美元的贷款，并有本票为证。其兄弟没有签署本票，因此他对该债务不承担个人责任。但由于他用自己的土地来担保该女子的债务偿还，银行对该土地拥有有效的抵押权。因此，在该女子贷款违约后，银行将成功止赎其兄弟的土地。

†如果抵押合同本身包含具有此效力的条款，抵押人将对债务承担个人责任。

(选项A) 抵押债务由他人所欠这一事实，并不会使该兄弟提供的抵押无效。这仅意味着该兄弟对偿还抵押债务不承担个人责任。

(选项B) 衡平法上的抵押是一种抵押的替代形式，当一方为使财产作为债务担保而占有该财产的原始契据时产生（本案中未出现此情况）。

(选项D) 保证人是保证在他人未能偿还债务时为其偿还的一方。在此案中，银行并未同意在该女子违约时为她偿还债务，因此银行不是保证人。

教学目标：可以为担保非抵押人所欠的债务而设立抵押，并且在债务人违约时，抵押权人可以对抵押财产进行止赎。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 1.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (mortgages securing obligations of nonmortgagors).

data.htmlContent:
MBE 考点解析：第三人抵押

核心结论 (Correct Answer C)：
即使抵押人（Mortgagor）不是债务人（Debtor），抵押依然有效。银行可以对土地进行止赎（Foreclose）。

1. 法律原理：债与抵押的分离

在不动产担保法中，必须区分两份关键文件：

  • 本票 (Promissory Note)：代表债务，产生对人的责任 (Personal Liability / In Personam)。
  • 抵押契据 (Mortgage Deed)：代表担保，产生对物的责任 (In Rem Liability)。

关键规则： 抵押是为了担保债务的履行。虽然通常情况下债务人和抵押人是同一人，但法律允许第三人（Third Party）用自己的财产为他人的债务提供担保。

这种情况下，该第三人被称为 物上保证人 (Accommodation Mortgagor)。

2. 本案案情分析

女子 (The Woman)：
签署了本票。她是债务人，承担偿还 $100,000 的个人责任。
兄弟 (The Brother)：
没有签署本票 $\rightarrow$ 无个人责任（银行不能起诉他要求赔钱）。
签署了抵押契据 $\rightarrow$ 有财产责任（他的土地是债务的担保物）。
结果：
当女子违约 (Default) 时，银行虽然不能找兄弟要钱，但完全有权根据有效的抵押契据，对兄弟的土地进行止赎 (Foreclosure) 以清偿债务。

3. 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A 错误：
它声称没有债务就没有有效的抵押。虽然抵押必须依附于债务（Debt），但这笔债务可以是他人欠下的。兄弟不需要自己欠债，他只需要同意用自己的地担保他人的债。

选项 B 错误：
衡平法抵押 (Equitable Mortgage) 通常发生在形式有瑕疵或仅通过交付地契意图设立担保的情况。本案中，兄弟“executed a mortgage”（签署了抵押），这意味着这是一个符合法定形式的普通法抵押 (Legal Mortgage)，而非衡平法抵押。

选项 D 错误：
这搞反了角色。银行是债权人 (Creditor/Mortgagee)。兄弟才是那个通过提供土地充当“保证人” (Surety) 角色的一方。

🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
在处理抵押题时，永远要问自己两个问题：
  1. 谁签了本票？ (决定谁会被起诉赔钱)
  2. 谁签了抵押？ (决定谁的房子会被拍卖)
如果某人只签了抵押没签本票，他不会背负债务，但他的房子会“背负”债务。这就是所谓的 Non-recourse (无追索权) 责任，仅限于抵押物的价值。

Reference: Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 1.3

questions.question:
A woman borrowed money from her local credit union to purchase an undeveloped lot on which to build her dream home. She executed a promissory note agreeing to repay the loan over a 10-year period. The loan was secured by a deed of trust that contained a power-of-sale clause. The deed of trust was promptly recorded.
After the woman missed five loan payments, the credit union accelerated the debt and instructed the trustee to initiate nonjudicial foreclosure proceedings as permitted by the jurisdiction. The trustee followed the jurisdiction's notice requirements and procedures. At the foreclosure sale, the credit union was the sole bidder. The winning bid was equal to the remaining obligation on the note, amounting to only 60% of the fair market value of the property.
The woman immediately filed an action against the credit union to set aside the foreclosure sale.
Is the woman likely to prevail?

choices.a: No, because a court cannot overturn a nonjudicial foreclosure on a deed of trust.
choices.b: No, because there is no indication that the procedure or price would shock the conscience of the court.
choices.c: Yes, because a deed of trust can be foreclosed upon only by judicial foreclosure.
choices.d: Yes, because a lender may not purchase the mortgaged property at a nonjudicial foreclosure.

Is the woman likely to prevail?

一名女性从当地信用合作社贷款，用于购买一块未开发的土地，以建造她梦想中的家园。她签署了一份本票，同意在10年内偿还贷款。该贷款由一份包含售卖权条款的信托契约（deed of trust）作为担保。该信托契约被及时登记。

在该女性拖欠五期贷款后，信用合作社宣布债务加速到期，并指示受托人根据该司法管辖区的许可，启动非法定止赎程序。受托人遵守了该司法管辖区的通知要求和程序。在止赎拍卖中，信用合作社是唯一的出价人。中标价格与本票上剩余的债务金额相等，仅为该房产公平市场价值的60%。

该女性立即对信用合作社提起诉讼，要求撤销此次止赎拍卖。

该女性是否可能胜诉？
options:
A. No, because a court cannot overturn a nonjudicial foreclosure on a deed of trust.
不会，因为法院不能推翻基于信托契约的非法定止赎。

B. No, because there is no indication that the procedure or price would shock the conscience of the court.
不会，因为没有迹象表明程序或价格会冲击法院的良知。

C. Yes, because a deed of trust can be foreclosed upon only by judicial foreclosure.
会，因为信托契约只能通过法定止赎来执行。

D. Yes, because a lender may not purchase the mortgaged property at a nonjudicial foreclosure.
会，因为在非法定止赎中，贷款人不得购买抵押房产。
data.explanation:
Foreclosure methods


Judicial saleJudicially supervised public sale of mortgaged property (all states)
Nonjudicial salePrivately conducted public sale of mortgaged property (permitted only if mortgage contains power-of-sale clause) (half of all states)
Strict foreclosureForeclosure without sale of mortgaged property (few states)
A debtor may give his/her interest in real property to a lender to secure a debt - usually through a mortgage or a deed of trust. A deed of trust is created when the debtor conveys the property interest to an impartial third party, as trustee, who holds title to the property for the lender's benefit. If the debtor pays the debt in full, then the trustee must reconvey the property to the debtor. But if the debtor defaults on loan payments, the trustee can initiate foreclosure proceedings (see table above).

The trustee can initiate nonjudicial foreclosure in about half of all states if the mortgage or deed of trust contains a power-of-sale clause - as seen here (Choice C). This allows the trustee to sell the property at a public auction without requesting permission from the court. However, the debtor can ask a court to overturn the foreclosure if the auction or sales process violated due process or the purchase price was grossly inadequate† (Choice A).

Courts have consistently been unwilling to impose a "fair market value" standard on the purchase price, so the lender can credit bid up to the amount of the outstanding debt without paying additional cash (Choice D). Therefore, the winning bid is often below fair market value.

Here, there was no due process violation because the jurisdiction's notice requirements and procedures were followed. And though the credit union's winning bid was only 60% of the property's fair market value, it was equal to the remaining obligation on the note. Therefore, this credit bid was not grossly inadequate. Because neither the procedure nor the price would shock the conscience of the court, the woman is not likely to prevail in her action to set aside the foreclosure sale.

†Purchase prices have been deemed grossly inadequate if they are below 20% of the fair market value.

Educational objective: Nonjudicial foreclosures are allowed in most states if the mortgage or deed of trust contains a power-of-sale clause. However, the court can overturn the foreclosure if the auction or sales process violated due process or the purchase price was grossly inadequate.

选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 52%（正确选项），C选项 10%，D选项 22%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

止赎方法


Judicial sale (法定拍卖)经司法监督的抵押房产公开拍卖（所有州）
Nonjudicial sale (非法定拍卖)私下进行的抵押房产公开拍卖（仅当抵押合同包含售卖权条款时才被允许）（半数州）
Strict foreclosure (严格止赎)不经拍卖的止赎（少数州）
债务人可将其不动产权益交给贷款人以担保债务——通常通过抵押合同（mortgage）或信托契约（deed of trust）的方式。当债务人将财产权益转让给一个中立的第三方（作为受托人），由其为贷款人的利益持有该财产的所有权时，便设立了信托契约 (deed of trust)。如果债务人全额偿还债务，则受托人必须将财产归还给债务人。但如果债务人拖欠贷款，受托人可以启动止赎程序（见上表）。

如果抵押合同或信托契约中包含售卖权条款，在大约半数的州，受托人可以启动非法定止赎 (nonjudicial foreclosure)——如此案所示（选项C）。这允许受托人在未经法院许可的情况下，通过公开拍卖出售该房产。然而，如果拍卖或销售过程违反了正当程序或购买价格严重不充分†（选项A），债务人可以请求法院推翻该止赎。

法院一向不愿对购买价格强制采用“公平市场价值”标准，因此贷款人可以以其未偿债务金额进行信用出价（credit bid），而无需支付额外的现金（选项D）。因此，中标价格通常低于公平市场价值。

在本案中，由于遵守了该司法管辖区的通知要求和程序，因此不存在违反了正当程序的情况。而且，尽管信用合作社的中标价仅为房产公平市场价值的60%，但它与本票上的剩余债务金额相等。因此，该信用出价并非严重不充分。因为无论是程序还是价格都不会冲击法院的良知，所以该女性要求撤销止赎拍卖的诉讼不太可能胜诉。

†如果购买价格低于公平市场价值的20%，则被视为严重不充分。

教学目标： 在大多数州，如果抵押合同或信托契约包含售卖权条款，则允许进行非法定止赎。然而，如果拍卖或销售过程违反了正当程序或购买价格严重不充分，法院可以推翻该止赎。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages §8.3 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (adequacy of foreclosure sale price).

MBE 考点解析

抵押与担保设备 (Mortgages)
正确答案：B

理由：因为没有迹象表明止赎程序存在瑕疵，或者成交价格低到足以“冲击法院的良知”（Shock the Conscience）。

核心法律规则解析

1. 撤销止赎拍卖的标准

在非法定止赎（Nonjudicial Foreclosure）中，法院通常非常尊重拍卖结果的终局性。要撤销（Set aside）一场已经完成的止赎拍卖，原告通常需要证明以下两点同时存在：

  • 程序违规：拍卖过程未遵守法律规定或合同条款（如通知未送达）。
  • 价格严重不充分 (Grossly Inadequate Price)：成交价极低，低到令人发指的程度。
2. 价格多少才算“严重不充分”？

仅仅是“低价”或“低于市场价”不足以撤销拍卖。法院通常采用的标准是：

只有当价格低至冲击良知 (Shock the conscience) 的程度时，法院才会干预。

Restatement (Third) of Property 建议的参考线是：如果售价低于公平市场价值（FMV）的 20%，通常被视为严重不充分。

本案案情分析

在本题中：

  • 程序方面：题目明确指出受托人遵守了所有的通知要求和程序（followed notice requirements and procedures）。
  • 价格方面：中标价是市场价值的 60%。虽然这对借款人来说很亏，但在法律上，60% 远未达到“严重不充分”的标准（通常需低于20%）。

因此，法院不会仅仅因为价格只有60%就撤销拍卖，这就是为什么选项 B 是正确的。

为什么其他选项是错误的？

选项 A 错误 虽然法院很少干预，但并非“绝对不能”推翻。如果存在严重的程序欺诈配合极低的价格，法院有权介入。
选项 C 错误 信托契约 (Deed of Trust) 的核心特征之一就是包含售卖权条款 (Power-of-Sale Clause)。这正是允许进行非法定止赎（即不需要法院判决的私下拍卖）的法律依据。
选项 D 错误 贷款人（Lender/Mortgagee）完全有权在止赎拍卖中竞买房产。实际上，贷款人通常会进行信用出价 (Credit Bid)，即用借款人欠的债务金额作为出价，而不需要支付现金。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
在处理止赎（Foreclosure）题目时，请记住：
1. 价格低不是理由：除非价格低得离谱（<20% FMV），否则法院不会管。
2. 程序是关键：如果题目说程序合法（Notice given, etc.），借款人几乎不可能胜诉。
3. 信用出价：贷款人买回房子是常态，只要出价不超过债务总额，通常被视为合理。

questions.question:
A man who owned property in fee simple mortgaged the property to a bank to secure a loan of $100,000. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The man later mortgaged the property to his mother to secure a loan of $50,000. This mortgage was also promptly and properly recorded. Subsequently, the man conveyed the property to a purchaser. About a year later, the purchaser borrowed $100,000 from an elderly widow and gave her a mortgage on the property to secure repayment of the loan. The widow did not know about the mortgage held by the mother. The understanding between the purchaser and the widow was that the purchaser would use the $100,000 to pay off the mortgage held by the bank and that the widow would therefore have a first mortgage on the property. The widow's mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The purchaser paid the $100,000 received from the widow to the bank and obtained and recorded a release of the bank's mortgage.
The $50,000 debt secured by the mother's mortgage was not paid when it was due, and the mother brought an appropriate action to foreclose, joining the man, the purchaser, and the widow as defendants and alleging that the mother's mortgage was senior to the widow's mortgage on the property.
If the court rules that the widow's mortgage is entitled to priority over the mother's mortgage, which of the following determinations are necessary to support that ruling?

choices.a: The bank's mortgage was originally senior to the mother's mortgage.
choices.b: The widow is entitled to have the bank's mortgage revived for her benefit, and the widow is entitled to be subrogated to the bank's original position as senior mortgagee.
choices.c: There are no countervailing equities in favor of the mother.
choices.d: All of the above.

Q86017

A man who owned property in fee simple mortgaged the property to a bank to secure a loan of $100,000. The mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The man later mortgaged the property to his mother to secure a loan of $50,000. This mortgage was also promptly and properly recorded. Subsequently, the man conveyed the property to a purchaser. About a year later, the purchaser borrowed $100,000 from an elderly widow and gave her a mortgage on the property to secure repayment of the loan. The widow did not know about the mortgage held by the mother. The understanding between the purchaser and the widow was that the purchaser would use the $100,000 to pay off the mortgage held by the bank and that the widow would therefore have a first mortgage on the property. The widow's mortgage was promptly and properly recorded. The purchaser paid the $100,000 received from the widow to the bank and obtained and recorded a release of the bank's mortgage.

The $50,000 debt secured by the mother's mortgage was not paid when it was due, and the mother brought an appropriate action to foreclose, joining the man, the purchaser, and the widow as defendants and alleging that the mother's mortgage was senior to the widow's mortgage on the property.

If the court rules that the widow's mortgage is entitled to priority over the mother's mortgage, which of the following determinations are necessary to support that ruling?

一名拥有房产完全所有权（fee simple）的男子将该房产抵押给一家银行，以担保一笔10万美元的贷款。该抵押权被及时并适当地进行了登记。随后，该男子又将该房产抵押给他的母亲，以担保一笔5万美元的贷款。这笔抵押权也同样被及时并适当地进行了登记。之后，该男子将房产转让给了一名买方。大约一年后，该买方向一位年迈的寡妇借款10万美元，并将该房产抵押给她以担保贷款的偿还。该寡妇并不知道其母亲持有的抵押权。买方与寡妇之间的约定是，买方将用这10万美元来清偿银行持有的抵押贷款，因此寡妇将获得该房产的第一顺位抵押权。寡妇的抵押权被及时并适当地进行了登记。买方将从寡妇处收到的10万美元支付给了银行，并获得及登记了银行抵押权的解除文件。

由母亲的抵押权所担保的5万美元债务到期未付，于是母亲提起了适当的止赎诉讼，并将该男子、买方和寡妇列为被告，声称母亲的抵押权优先于寡妇对该房产的抵押权。

如果法院裁定寡妇的抵押权有权优先于母亲的抵押权，那么以下哪项裁定是支持该判决所必需的？
options:
A. The bank's mortgage was originally senior to the mother's mortgage.
银行的抵押权最初优先于母亲的抵押权。

B. The widow is entitled to have the bank's mortgage revived for her benefit, and the widow is entitled to be subrogated to the bank's original position as senior mortgagee.
寡妇有权为其利益而使银行的抵押权复活，并且寡妇有权代位取得(subrogated to)银行作为优先顺位抵押权人的原始地位。

C. There are no countervailing equities in favor of the mother.
不存在对母亲有利的、足以抗衡的衡平法权益(countervailing equities)。

D. All of the above.
以上所有选项。
data.explanation:
Lien priority is generally determined by who records first (ie, first in time, first in right). However, subrogation allows a third party who fully pays off a senior mortgage to take that senior mortgage's priority so long as the third party had no actual knowledge of junior interests.† This does not harm junior interests because they retain the same lien priority.

Here, the bank's mortgage was recorded first, so it had priority over the mother's mortgage. The widow's mortgage was recorded last. However, the widow's loan was used to fully pay off the bank's senior mortgage, and the widow did not know about the mother's mortgage. As a result, the widow acquired the bank's senior mortgage through subrogation. Also, there are no equities in the mother's favor because she has retained her second-in-priority status (Choices A, B & C).

†In a minority of jurisdictions, record notice is also sufficient to preclude subrogation.

Educational objective: Subrogation allows a third party to take a senior mortgage's priority when the third party (1) fully pays off the senior mortgage and (2) has no actual knowledge of junior interests.



选项正确率统计：A选项 15%，B选项 22%，C选项 7%，D选项 55%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押权的优先顺位通常由谁先登记决定（即，时间在先，权利在先）。然而，代位求偿权(subrogation)允许第三方在完全清偿了顺位在先的抵押贷款后，取得该顺位在先抵押权的优先地位，只要该第三方对顺位在后的权益没有实际知晓。†这并不会损害顺位在后的权益，因为它们的抵押权优先顺位保持不变。

在本案中，银行的抵押权最先登记，因此它优先于母亲的抵押权。寡妇的抵押权最后登记。然而，寡妇的贷款被用于完全清偿银行的顺位在先的抵押贷款，并且寡妇并不知道母亲的抵押权。因此，寡妇通过代位求偿权(subrogation)取得了银行的顺位在先的抵押权。此外，不存在对母亲有利的衡平法权益，因为她保留了其第二顺位的地位（选项A、B和C）。

†在少数司法管辖区，登记推定知晓(record notice)也足以排除代位求偿权的适用。

教学目标：代位求偿权(Subrogation)允许第三方在以下情况下取得顺位在先抵押权的优先地位：(1) 该第三方完全清偿了顺位在先的抵押贷款，并且 (2) 对顺位在后的权益没有实际知晓。

References

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 7.6 (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (doctrine of subrogation).
