MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
核心考点：衡平法代位权 (Equitable Subrogation) 当第三方为了保护自己的利益或基于协议，全额偿还了某项抵押债务后，他可以“穿上”原债权人的鞋子，取得原抵押权的优先顺位。
案情优先顺位演变
1
银行 (Bank)：$100k (第一顺位)
2
母亲 (Mother)：$50k (第二顺位)
3
寡妇 (Widow) 借出 $100k 偿还了银行，银行抵押解除。
4
寡妇 (Widow)：主张代位取得银行的第一顺位。
为什么选 D (All of the above)?

本题考查的是法院判决寡妇胜诉（获得第一顺位）背后的必要法律逻辑。衡平法代位权是一种基于公平原则的救济，要适用该原则，必须同时满足以下三个条件（对应选项A、B、C）：

选项 A 的必要性：
"银行的抵押权最初优先于母亲的抵押权。"
代位权是“取代”原债权人的位置。如果银行原本就在母亲之后，那么寡妇取代银行的位置对她没有任何帮助。寡妇要获得优先于母亲的地位，前提是她所偿还的那个债务（银行的）本身就是优先的。
选项 B 的必要性：
"寡妇有权使银行抵押权复活并代位..."
这是法律技术的实现路径。通常情况下，债务偿清后抵押权即消灭。法院必须运用 Subrogation 这一法律拟制（legal fiction），视作银行的抵押权“复活”并转移给了寡妇，否则寡妇只是一个新登记的、顺位在最后的抵押权人。
选项 C 的必要性：
"不存在对母亲有利的衡平法权益。"
这是衡平法（Equity）的核心。代位权不能损害中间债权人（母亲）的既得利益。
  • 如果母亲在银行抵押解除后，善意地借出了更多钱，或者改变了她的法律地位，那么允许寡妇插队就是不公平的。
  • 但在本案中，母亲只是回到了她原本预期的“第二顺位”，并没有因为寡妇的介入而变得更糟。因此，必须认定“没有不公平情形”，法院才能判决代位。
💡 MBE 避坑指南 注意题目中的“知情” (Notice)：
  • 实际知情 (Actual Knowledge)： 如果寡妇明确知道母亲有抵押权，大多数法院会拒绝给予代位权。
  • 推定知情 (Constructive Notice)： 即使母亲的抵押权已登记（即寡妇“应当”知道），现代趋势（如 Restatement）和本题逻辑认为，只要没有实际知情，且不损害中间人利益，仍可适用代位权。
© MBE Property Law Review | 2025

questions.question:
A landowner in fee simple mortgaged the land to an investor to secure repayment of the loan she made to him. The loan was due at the end of the growing season of the year in which it was made. The landowner maintained and operated an orchard on the land, which was his sole source of income. Halfway through the growing season, the landowner experienced severe health and personal problems and, as a result, left the state; his whereabouts were unknown. The investor learned that no one was responsible for the cultivation and care of the orchard on the land. She undertook to provide, through employees, the care of the orchard and the harvest for the remainder of the growing season. The net profits were applied to the debt secured by the mortgage on the land.
During the course of the harvest, the landowner's friend, a business invitee, was injured by reason of a fault in the equipment used. Under applicable tort case law, the owner of the premises would be liable for the friend's injuries. The friend brought an appropriate action against the investor to recover damages for the injuries suffered, relying on this aspect of tort law.
In such lawsuit, for whom should the court render judgment?

choices.a: The friend, because the investor was a mortgagee in possession.
choices.b: The friend, but only if the state is a title theory state, because in other jurisdictions a mortgagee has no title interest but only a lien.
choices.c: The investor, because she acted as agent of the landowner only to preserve her security interest.
choices.d: The investor, but only if the mortgage expressly provided for her taking possession in the event of danger to her security interest.

data.questionStem:
Q86003

A landowner in fee simple mortgaged the land to an investor to secure repayment of the loan she made to him. The loan was due at the end of the growing season of the year in which it was made. The landowner maintained and operated an orchard on the land, which was his sole source of income. Halfway through the growing season, the landowner experienced severe health and personal problems and, as a result, left the state; his whereabouts were unknown. The investor learned that no one was responsible for the cultivation and care of the orchard on the land. She undertook to provide, through employees, the care of the orchard and the harvest for the remainder of the growing season. The net profits were applied to the debt secured by the mortgage on the land.

During the course of the harvest, the landowner's friend, a business invitee, was injured by reason of a fault in the equipment used. Under applicable tort case law, the owner of the premises would be liable for the friend's injuries. The friend brought an appropriate action against the investor to recover damages for the injuries suffered, relying on this aspect of tort law.

In such lawsuit, for whom should the court render judgment?

一位拥有土地完全所有权的土地所有者将土地抵押给一位投资者，以担保她向他提供的贷款的偿还。贷款应在贷款发放当年的生长季末偿还。该土地所有者在土地上维护并经营一个果园，这是他唯一的收入来源。在生长季过半时，土地所有者遇到了严重的健康和个人问题，因此离开了该州；其下落不明。投资者得知无人负责土地上果园的种植和照料。她着手通过雇员，为果园提供剩余生长季的照料和收割。净利润被用于偿还土地抵押所担保的债务。

在收割过程中，土地所有者的朋友，一名商业受邀人，因所用设备的故障而受伤。根据适用的侵权法判例，房产的所有者将对该朋友的伤害承担责任。该朋友依据侵权法的这一方面，对投资者提起了适当的诉讼，以就其所受伤害索取损害赔偿。

在此诉讼中，法院应为谁作出判决？
options:
A. The friend, because the investor was a mortgagee in possession.
该朋友，因为投资者是占有中的抵押权人。

B. The friend, but only if the state is a title theory state, because in other jurisdictions a mortgagee has no title interest but only a lien.
该朋友，但前提是该州为所有权理论州，因为在其他司法管辖区，抵押权人没有所有权权益，只有一项担保权。

C. The investor, because she acted as agent of the landowner only to preserve her security interest.
投资者，因为她仅作为土地所有者的代理人行事，以保护其担保权益。

D. The investor, but only if the mortgage expressly provided for her taking possession in the event of danger to her security interest.
投资者，但前提是抵押合同明确规定，在她的担保权益受到威胁时，她可以占有该房产。
data.explanation:
Mortgage theories


Lien theoryLender receives security interest in property. Mortgagor retains title & possession unless lender forecloses.

(majority rule)
Title theoryLender receives legal title & mortgagor retains right of possession. Title reverts to mortgagor once debt is paid.
Intermediate theoryMortgagor retains title & possession until default, then full title passes to lender without foreclosure.
A mortgage is a lien against real property given to secure a debt. Under the lien theory of mortgages (adhered to by a majority of jurisdictions), a mortgage creates a security interest only and confers no right to possession of the mortgaged property. Regardless of the applicable mortgage theory, however, the mortgagee is entitled to take possession if the mortgagor abandons the mortgaged property (Choice B). A mortgagee who does so incurs liability as if he/she were the owner (eg, tort liability to anyone injured on the property).

Here, the landowner mortgaged land to the investor. When the landowner abandoned the property due to severe health and personal problems, the investor rightfully took possession - regardless of whether the mortgage expressly permitted her to do so (Choice D). And since the facts stipulate that the owner of the premises would be liable for the friend's injuries, the investor is liable. The court should therefore render judgment for the friend.

(Choice C) In lieu of taking possession, most mortgagees attempt to preserve their security interest by getting a court-appointed receiver (ie, agent) to manage the property. This shields the mortgagee from the liability risks of being a mortgagee in possession. But no receivership was created on these facts.

Educational objective: The mortgagee can take possession of the mortgaged property if the mortgagor abandons it. Once in possession, the mortgagee incurs liability as if he/she were the owner.

选项正确率统计：A选项 33%（正确选项），B选项 39%，C选项 20%，D选项 7%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

抵押理论


担保权理论 (Lien theory)贷款人获得财产的担保权益。除非贷款人行使止赎权，否则抵押人保留所有权和占有权。

(多数规则)
所有权理论 (Title theory)贷款人获得法定所有权，抵押人保留占有权。一旦债务清偿，所有权归还给抵押人。
中间理论 (Intermediate theory)抵押人保留所有权和占有权直至违约，届时全部所有权无需止赎即转移给贷款人。
抵押是为担保债务而设定的不动产上的一种担保权。根据抵押的担保权理论（多数司法管辖区采用），抵押仅产生担保权益，不授予占有抵押财产的权利。然而，无论适用何种抵押理论，如果抵押人放弃抵押财产，抵押权人有权占有该财产（选项B）。如此行事的抵押权人将承担如同所有者一样的责任（例如，对在财产上受伤的任何人承担侵权责任）。

在本案中，土地所有者将土地抵押给了投资者。当土地所有者因严重的健康和个人问题而放弃该财产时，投资者合法地占有了该财产——无论抵押合同是否明确允许她这样做（选项D）。并且，由于案件事实规定房产所有者应对该朋友的伤害负责，因此投资者应承担责任。因此，法院应作出对该朋友有利的判决。

（选项C）大多数抵押权人会选择通过获得法院指定的接管人（即代理人）来管理财产以保护其担保权益，而不是亲自占有。这可以使抵押权人免于承担作为占有中抵押权人的责任风险。但在本案件事实中，并未设立接管人制度。

教学目标：如果抵押人放弃抵押财产，抵押权人可以占有该财产。一旦占有，抵押权人将承担如同所有者一样的责任。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 153 (2019) (specifying rights and liabilities of mortgagee in possession).

Essex Cleaning Contractors, Inc. v. Amato, 317 A.2d 411, 412 (N.J. Super. 1974) (discussing tort liability of mortgagees in possession).

Restatement (Third) of Property: Mortgages § 4.1(c) (Am. Law Inst. 1997) (identifying mortgagee rights to take possession).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices
核心考点：占有中的抵押权人 Mortgagee in Possession
当抵押权人（贷款人）合法接管并占有抵押房产时，其在法律上被视为该房产的“准所有者”，必须承担与所有者相同的管理责任，包括对第三方的侵权责任。
案情逻辑分析

本题考察的是抵押权人接管房产后的法律后果：

  1. 放弃与接管：土地所有者（Mortgagor）放弃了果园，投资者（Mortgagee）为了保护担保利益，主动介入并接管了果园的运营。
  2. 身份转变：一旦投资者接管并开始运营（雇佣员工、收割庄稼），她就成为了占有中的抵押权人 (Mortgagee in Possession)。
  3. 责任承担：作为占有者，她承担了维护房产安全的责任。题目明确指出“根据侵权法，房产所有者应对伤害负责”。由于投资者现在处于“准所有者”的地位，她必须对因设备故障导致的商业受邀人（Business Invitee）的伤害负责。
选项深度解析
✅ 选项 A (正确答案)
理由：投资者通过接管果园的管理和运营，成为了“占有中的抵押权人”。在此身份下，她对房产上的受邀人负有与所有者相同的注意义务（Duty of Care）。
❌ 选项 B (干扰项：抵押理论)
理由：这是一个经典的干扰项。虽然美国各州对抵押分为“所有权理论” (Title Theory) 和“担保权理论” (Lien Theory)，但这主要影响谁持有法定所有权。侵权责任来源于“占有和控制” (Possession and Control)，而不是抽象的所有权归属。无论在哪个理论下，实际占有者都要对访客安全负责。
❌ 选项 C (干扰项：代理关系)
理由：投资者是为了保护自己的担保利益（Security Interest）而行事，并非作为失踪土地所有者的代理人。如果是代理人，责任可能归于被代理人；但作为占有中的抵押权人，她是为自己利益行事，需独立承担责任。
❌ 选项 D (干扰项：合同条款)
理由：当抵押人（Mortgagor）放弃 (Abandon) 房产时，抵押权人有权接管房产以防止其废弃贬值，这不需要抵押合同中有明确条款授权。
💡 MBE 备考小贴士
在 Real Property 的抵押题中，注意区分“接管人” (Receiver) 和 “占有中的抵押权人” (Mortgagee in Possession)。

聪明的银行通常会向法院申请指定一个 Receiver 来管理房产，因为 Receiver 是法院的官员，银行可以借此规避侵权责任。如果题目中银行（或投资者）自己直接上手管理（Self-help），他们通常要背锅。

questions.question:
An individual purchased a residence for $200,000. The individual paid $25,000 of the purchase price from her own funds and the remaining $175,000 with the proceeds of a loan she obtained from a bank. She signed a promissory note payable to the bank in the principal amount of $175,000 and gave the bank a mortgage on the residence. The bank promptly and properly recorded this mortgage.
Several years later, the individual borrowed $35,000 from a credit union to finance the construction of an addition to the residence. She signed a promissory note payable to the credit union in the principal amount of $35,000 and gave the credit union a mortgage on the residence. Because of a clerical oversight, the credit union failed to record this mortgage.
Subsequently, the individual defaulted on the bank note. This note contained an acceleration clause, pursuant to which the full unpaid balance of the note became immediately due. The fair market value of the residence was slightly less than the amount owed on the note, so the bank offered to accept the deed to the residence in exchange for cancellation of the note. The individual agreed, and also agreed to waive her equitable right to redeem the property. Shortly after title to the residence was transferred to the bank, the bank learned of the credit union's mortgage.
The bank has brought a foreclosure action to which the credit union was made a party. The credit union contests the bank's right to bring this action.
If the court rules in favor of the bank, what is the most likely reason?

choices.a: The jurisdiction recognizes a statutory right of redemption.
choices.b: The jurisdiction recognizes the principle of clogging the equity of redemption.
choices.c: The jurisdiction does not recognize the doctrine of caveat emptor.
choices.d: The jurisdiction does not recognize the doctrine of merger with regard to mortgages.

某人以20万美元的价格购买了一处住宅。该人从其自有资金中支付了2.5万美元的购房款，其余17.5万美元则通过其从一家银行获得的贷款支付。她签署了一份以银行为收款人、本金为17.5万美元的本票，并将该住宅的抵押权授予银行。银行及时且适当地登记了该抵押权。

几年后，该人从一家信用合作社借款3.5万美元，用于住宅的扩建工程。她签署了一份以信用合作社为收款人、本金为3.5万美元的本票，并将该住宅的抵押权授予信用合作社。由于文书疏忽，信用合作社未能登记该抵押权。

随后，该人对银行的本票违约。该本票包含一条加速到期条款，据此，未付清的全部票据余额立即到期。该住宅的公平市场价值略低于票据上的欠款金额，因此银行提出接受该住宅的契据以换取票据的注销。该人同意了，并同意放弃其衡平法上的财产赎回权。在该住宅的所有权转移给银行后不久，银行获悉了信用合作社的抵押权。

银行提起了一项止赎诉讼，并将信用合作社列为当事人。信用合作社对银行提起此项诉讼的权利提出异议。

如果法院作出有利于银行的裁决，最可能的原因是什么？
options:
A. The jurisdiction recognizes a statutory right of redemption.
该司法管辖区承认法定的赎回权。

B. The jurisdiction recognizes the principle of clogging the equity of redemption.
该司法管辖区承认禁止阻碍衡平法赎回权的原则。

C. The jurisdiction does not recognize the doctrine of caveat emptor.
该司法管辖区不承认caveat emptor（买方自慎）原则。

D. The jurisdiction does not recognize the doctrine of merger with regard to mortgages.
该司法管辖区不承认关于抵押权的混同原则。
data.explanation:
The doctrine of merger applies to mortgages when the same person acquires both: a mortgagee's (lender's) interest in real property and the mortgagor's (borrower's) interest in that same property.

When this occurs, the mortgage merges into the fee estate and is thereby extinguished.

Here, the bank held a mortgage on the residence when it acquired the individual's ownership interest in that residence. If the doctrine of merger applied, the mortgage would have been extinguished upon that transfer and the bank would have no right to bring this foreclosure action. So if the court rules in the bank's favor, it is likely because the jurisdiction does not recognize the doctrine of merger with regard to mortgages.

(Choice A) The statutory right of redemption allows a mortgagor to regain ownership of real property after it has been sold in foreclosure. This right does not apply here because the credit union is contending that the bank no longer has a mortgage on the property needed to bring this foreclosure action.

(Choice B) The principle of clogging the equity of redemption allows courts to reject a mortgagee's attempt to deny the mortgagor the ability to waive the right to redemption after the mortgage is executed - eg, by including a waiver clause in the mortgage. Here, the individual was able to waive her right to redeem the residence after the mortgage was executed, and that waiver is not at issue. Therefore, this principle does not apply.

(Choice C) The common-law doctrine of caveat emptor (meaning "let the buyer beware") provides that a seller has no duty to disclose property defects to the buyer unless otherwise agreed. Since this doctrine is related to warranties, it has no effect on the bank's right to foreclose on a mortgage.

Educational objective: Under the doctrine of merger, when the same person acquires a mortgagee's interest and the mortgagor's interest in the same property, the mortgage merges into the fee estate and is extinguished.



选项正确率统计：A选项 17%，B选项 25%，C选项 10%，D选项 46%（正确选项）
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

当同一个人同时获得对同一不动产的抵押权人（出借人）的权益和抵押人（借款人）的权益时，混同原则（doctrine of merger）适用于抵押权。

当此情况发生时，抵押权与完全所有权地产（fee estate）合并，并因此消灭。

在本案中，银行在获得个人对该住宅的所有权权益时，已持有该住宅的抵押权。如果适用混同原则，该抵押权将在所有权转让时消灭，银行将无权提起此项止赎诉讼。因此，如果法院作出有利于银行的裁决，很可能是因为该司法管辖区不承认关于抵押权的混同原则。

(选项A) 法定赎回权允许抵押人在不动产被止赎出售后重新获得其所有权。此权利在此处不适用，因为信用合作社主张银行已不再拥有提起此项止赎诉讼所需的对该财产的抵押权。

(选项B) 禁止阻碍衡平法赎回权的原则允许法院驳回抵押权人在抵押合同执行后，试图剥夺抵押人放弃赎回权能力的企图——例如，在抵押合同中包含放弃条款。在本案中，该个人能够在抵押合同执行后放弃其赎回住宅的权利，且该放弃行为并非争议点。因此，该原则不适用。

(选项C) 普通法上的caveat emptor（意为“买方自慎”）原则规定，除非另有约定，卖方没有义务向买方披露财产瑕疵。由于该原则与担保相关，因此它对银行行使抵押权止赎的权利没有影响。

教学目的：根据混同原则，当同一个人获得对同一财产的抵押权人权益和抵押人权益时，抵押权与完全所有权地产合并并因此消灭。

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

抵押权混同原则 (Doctrine of Merger)

🔍 案情核心梳理

本案涉及一个典型的“以契代偿”（Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure）陷阱：

1. 银行持有第一顺位抵押权 ($175k)
↓
2. 信用社持有第二顺位抵押权 ($35k)
↓
3. 借款人违约，将房屋产权直接转让给银行
↓
冲突点：银行现在既是所有者又是抵押权人

银行随后发现信用社的抵押权，试图通过止赎（Foreclosure）来清除这个次级留置权。

⚖️ 核心考点：混同原则
混同原则 (Doctrine of Merger)
当同一人同时获得同一财产的“抵押权人权益”（Mortgagee's interest）和“所有权权益”（Fee title）时，抵押权通常会融入所有权中而消灭。

如果适用混同原则：

  • 银行的抵押权消失。
  • 银行成为房主，但房子上仍背负着信用社的抵押权。
  • 信用社的抵押权顺位上升成为第一顺位。
  • 银行不能起诉止赎（因为你不能止赎自己的房子）。

如果不适用混同原则：

  • 银行的抵押权保持独立。
  • 银行可以基于其第一顺位抵押权发起止赎，从而清除信用社的次级抵押权。
✅ 正确答案解析 (选项 D)

题目问：如果法院判决银行胜诉，理由是什么？

银行要胜诉（即成功止赎并清除信用社的权益），前提必须是银行的抵押权没有因为混同而消灭。

因此，最合理的法律依据是：该司法管辖区不承认（或在该情况下不适用）抵押权的混同原则。

注：现代法院通常会设立“反混同例外”（Anti-Merger Exception），即如果混同会损害抵押权人的利益（例如存在中间顺位的次级抵押权），则推定抵押权人不希望发生混同。

❌ 干扰项排除
  • 选项 A (Statutory Redemption): 法定赎回权发生在止赎之后。本案还在讨论银行是否有权止赎，时间点对不上。
  • 选项 B (Clogging Equity of Redemption): 禁止阻碍衡平法赎回权是为了保护借款人。本案中借款人已经自愿放弃并转让了产权，且争议双方是两个贷款机构，与此原则无关。
  • 选项 C (Caveat Emptor): “买者自慎”通常用于房屋买卖中的物理瑕疵披露问题，与抵押权的优先顺位和存续无关。
🎓 考试通关技巧

遇到 Deed in Lieu of Foreclosure（以契代偿）的题目时，请立即警惕以下逻辑链：

  1. 检查是否有次级抵押权 (Junior Lien)： 如果有，银行直接拿产权是非常危险的。
  2. 混同风险 (Merger Risk)： 银行拿产权会导致其第一顺位抵押权消失，次级抵押权上位。
  3. 银行的救济： 银行若想补救，必须主张“无混同意图”或法院不适用混同原则，从而保留其抵押权以进行止赎。

记住：为了让银行赢，必须阻止“混同”发生。

questions.question:
A man purchased a house that needed substantial repairs. The man financed the purchase of the house by borrowing funds from a bank. He signed a note to the bank and secured repayment of the loan with a mortgage. After purchasing the house, the man borrowed money from his credit union to make the repairs. The man signed a note to the credit union; this note was also secured by a mortgage on the house. Both mortgages were promptly recorded in the order granted. The man was personally liable on both loans.
The man moved into the house and made the necessary repairs. He later defaulted on the debt to the bank, and the bank initiated judicial foreclosure proceedings, naming both the man and the credit union as parties to the action. An outside party acquired the house at the foreclosure sale.
After the expenses of the sale and the balance due the bank have been paid, $5,000 remains in the sale proceeds. The outstanding balance of the credit union loan is $20,000. The man and the credit union both claim the $5,000.
There is no applicable statute.
Who is entitled to the $5,000?

choices.a: The credit union, because the credit union has priority.
choices.b: The credit union, because the man is personally liable on the debt.
choices.c: The man, because of his equitable right of redemption.
choices.d: The man, because the outside party received title to the house subject to the second mortgage.

Who is entitled to the $5,000?

一名男子购买了一栋需要大量维修的房屋。该男子通过向银行借款来为购房融资。他向银行签署了一张票据，并以抵押方式担保该贷款的偿还。购房后，该男子又向其信用社借款进行维修。该男子向信用社签署了一张票据；该票据也由该房屋的抵押权作担保。两项抵押均按授予顺序及时进行了登记。该男子对两笔贷款均承担个人责任。

该男子搬入该房屋并进行了必要的维修。后来，他对银行的债务违约，银行启动了司法止赎程序，将该男子和信用社均列为诉讼当事人。一名外部第三方在止赎拍卖中购得了该房屋。

在支付了拍卖费用和欠银行的余款后，拍卖收益还剩下5000美元。信用社贷款的未偿余额为20000美元。该男子和信用社都主张这5000美元的所有权。

没有适用的成文法。

谁有权获得这5000美元？
options:
A. The credit union, because the credit union has priority.
信用社，因为信用社有优先权。

B. The credit union, because the man is personally liable on the debt.
信用社，因为该男子对债务承担个人责任。

C. The man, because of his equitable right of redemption.
该男子，因为他拥有衡平法上的赎回权。

D. The man, because the outside party received title to the house subject to the second mortgage.
该男子，因为外部第三方获得的房屋所有权受第二抵押权的约束。
data.explanation:
Foreclosure is the process in which the creditor forces the sale of the mortgaged property to satisfy the debt. After the foreclosure sale, proceeds are typically distributed in the following order of priority :
  • Costs from the foreclosure sale (eg, attorneys fees, court costs)
  • Mortgage being foreclosed
  • Junior mortgages (or other junior liens), in the order of priority
  • Debtor, if any surplus remains
Here, the man mortgaged his house, first to the bank and then to the credit union. When the man defaulted on his debt to the bank, the bank foreclosed on his house. After the costs from the foreclosure sale and the bank's mortgage were paid, $5,000 remained. Since the credit union has the second (junior) mortgage and is still owed $20,000, it has priority over the man. Therefore, the credit union is entitled to the $5,000. And the man is still personally liable for (and must repay) the remaining $15,000 owed to the credit union (Choice B).

(Choice C) The equitable right of redemption allows a debtor who has defaulted on a mortgage to cure the default before the foreclosure sale by paying the full amount of the outstanding debt. But this right is irrelevant to determining who is entitled to the proceeds after the foreclosure sale.

(Choice D) Since the credit union was a party to the bank's foreclosure action, the purchaser took the house free and clear of (not subject to) the second mortgage. But had the credit union not been a party, the purchaser would have taken the house subject to that mortgage.

Educational objective: The proceeds of a foreclosure sale are distributed in the following order of priority: (1) the costs from the foreclosure sale, (2) the mortgage being foreclosed, (3) junior liens in order of priority, and (4) the debtor.



选项正确率统计：A选项 69%（正确选项），B选项 25%，C选项 0%，D选项 4%
正确率基于先前软件用户的统计（以美国本地法学生为主），仅供参考。

止赎是债权人强制出售抵押财产以清偿债务的程序。止赎拍卖后，收益通常按以下优先顺序进行分配：
  • 止赎拍卖产生的费用（如律师费、法庭费用）
  • 被执行的抵押权
  • 次级抵押权（或其他次级留置权），按其优先顺序
  • 债务人，如有任何剩余款项
在本案中，该男子先将房屋抵押给银行，然后再抵押给信用社。当该男子对银行的债务违约时，银行对他的房屋进行了止赎。在支付了止赎拍卖的费用和银行的抵押贷款后，还剩下5000美元。由于信用社拥有第二（次级）抵押权，且仍有20000美元的债务未被偿还，因此其优先于该男子。因此，信用社有权获得这5000美元。并且，该男子仍对欠信用社的剩余15000美元承担个人责任（且必须偿还）（选项B）。

（选项C） 衡平法上的赎回权允许在抵押上违约的债务人通过在止赎拍卖前支付全部未偿债务来补救违约。但该权利与确定谁有权获得止赎拍卖后的收益无关。

（选项D） 由于信用社是银行止赎诉讼的当事人，因此购买者获得的房屋不受第二抵押权的约束（即产权是清晰的）。但如果信用社不是当事人，购买者获得的房屋将受该抵押权的约束。

教学目标： 止赎拍卖的收益按以下优先顺序进行分配：（1）止赎拍卖的费用，（2）被执行的抵押权，（3）按优先顺序排列的次级留置权，以及（4）债务人。

References

55 Am. Jur. 2d Mortgages § 705 (2019) (distribution of foreclosure sale proceeds).

MBE 考点解析

Mortgages & Security Devices

核心考点：止赎收益的分配顺序 在司法止赎（Judicial Foreclosure）中，拍卖所得款项必须严格按照特定的优先顺序（Priority）进行分配。

当房屋被强制拍卖后，资金流向就像瀑布一样，必须先填满上一层，溢出的部分才能流向下一层：

1. 止赎费用 (Expenses of Sale)
律师费、法庭费用
↓
2. 发起止赎的抵押贷款 (Foreclosing Lien)
本金 + 利息
↓
3. 次级留置权 (Junior Liens)
按登记顺序 (本题考点)
↓
4. 债务人/房主 (Mortgagor)
仅在所有留置权被清偿后
本案法律分析

本题中，银行是第一顺位抵押权人（Senior Mortgagee），信用社是第二顺位抵押权人（Junior Mortgagee）。

关键事实：

  • 银行止赎并已获得全额偿付。
  • 剩余盈余（Surplus）：$5,000。
  • 信用社（次级债权人）被欠款：$20,000。

根据分配规则，盈余必须先用于偿还次级留置权人（Junior Lienholders），然后才轮到债务人。

因为 $5,000 远不足以偿还信用社的 $20,000 债务，所以信用社拿走全部 $5,000。债务人（该男子）在本阶段拿不到任何钱。

选项深度解析
正确 选项 A (Choice A)
"The credit union, because the credit union has priority."
这是最准确的法律表述。信用社作为次级抵押权人，其对拍卖收益的权利优先于债务人。虽然止赎消灭了信用社在房子上的抵押权（Lien on the land），但该权益转移到了剩余的收益金上。
陷阱 选项 B (Choice B)
"...because the man is personally liable..."
虽然男子确实承担个人责任（Personal Liability），但这并不是信用社获得这 $5,000 的直接法律依据。信用社之所以能拿走这笔钱，是因为它是担保债权人（Secured Creditor）。个人责任意味着信用社可以就剩余的 $15,000 缺口起诉男子，但这与分配止赎款的优先权逻辑不同。
错误 选项 C (Choice C)
衡平法赎回权 (Equitable Right of Redemption)
此权利允许债务人在止赎拍卖之前通过还清所有债务来赎回房产。一旦拍卖结束，该权利即告终止（除非有法定赎回权 Statutory Redemption，但题目说没有适用法规）。这与拍卖后的收益分配无关。
错误 选项 D (Choice D)
受第二抵押权约束 (Subject to...)
这是一个重要的MBE考点：如果次级抵押权人（信用社）被列为止赎诉讼的当事人（Necessary Party），止赎拍卖将清洗掉该房产上的次级抵押权。买家获得的是产权清晰的房子。因此，信用社必须从收益中受偿，而不能再对房子主张权利。
